articles.title: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
articles.content: We introduce Gen4P, a unified framework for recovering 4D geometry and motion from monocular video. We show that a pretrained video generator can be repurposed into a feed-forward 4D perceiver without iterative denoising. Building on on-demand querying, Gen4P processes clean video latents in a single encoder pass and predicts the requested 4D attributes through a lightweight cross-attention decoder. The on-demand query formulation enables flexible spatial sampling, and our proposed continuous-time queries further provide temporal flexibility. To strengthen geometric knowledge, we propose a straightforward plug-in solution by incorporating a pretrained video-depth LoRA as a frozen geometry prior, improving overall performance without adding extra trainable parameters. Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on tasks of 3D point tracking, video depth and camera pose estimation. Qualitative results on in-the-wild videos illustrate its capability of tracking complex motion while maintaining the delicate structure. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of video generative pretraining for unified 4D perception. See https://gen4p.github.io for more visual results.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Gen4P: 视频生成器为 4D 接收器
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了Gen4P,从单相机视频中恢复4D几何和运动的统一框架. 我们显示,经过预先训练的视频生成器可以重新使用到向导的4D感知器,而无需迭代去诺. Gen4P在点播查询的基础上,在单个编码器通过中处理干净的视频潜伏,并通过轻量级交叉意向解码器来预测所请求的4D属性. 点播查询的制定能够灵活地进行空间取样,我们提议的连续时间查询进一步提供了时间灵活性。 为加强几何知识,我们提出一个直接的插接解决方案,将经过预先训练的视频深度LORA作为被冷冻的几何前置,改善整体性能,而不会增加额外的可训练参数. Gen4P在3D点跟踪,视频深度和相机等任务上实现最先进的或有竞争力的性能来进行估计. 现场视频的定性结果说明了它在保持微妙结构的同时跟踪复杂运动的能力. 这些结果共同表明视频基因预训对统一4D感知的潜力. 见 https://gen4p.github.io 更多视觉效果.

articles.title: Which Tokens to Merge? Diffusion Dynamics for Efficient Image Generation
articles.content: Token merging has emerged as an effective training-free strategy for accelerating diffusion models by reducing redundant token computation while minimizing generation degradation. A key challenge is determining which tokens can be safely merged and which should be preserved for subsequent computation. Existing method addresses this by preserving prompt-aligned foreground regions, thereby protecting semantically relevant structures. However, this text-relevance criterion overlooks background objects, local details that are not explicitly mentioned in the prompt, leading to degraded structural coherence. In this work, we propose Dynamics-aware Token Merging (DaTMe), a training-free framework that grounds token merging in the underlying diffusion dynamics. Our key insight is that token importance should reflect whether a token remains unresolved during denoising and whether it carries structural information. To this end, DaTMe constructs a dynamics- aware importance map from the Tweedie denoised estimate. The map combines a temporal signal, measuring inter-step changes in the predicted clean image, with a structural signal, capturing local high-frequency content such as boundaries and fine details. Using this map, DaTMe adaptively assigns tokens into merging roles under a given compression ratio: important tokens are preserved as anchors, while tokens that are both temporally stabilized and structurally homogeneous are selected as safe merge candidates. Experiments on PixArt-a and FLUX demonstrate that DaTMe maintains visual fidelity across the entire image, highlighting diffusion dynamics as an effective token-level merging decision in efficient generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/SeungJuCha/DaTMe.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 哪个托肯合并? 高效图像生成的传播动态
articles.content_zh: Token合并已经成为一种有效的无培训战略,通过减少冗余符号计算并尽量减少生成退化来加快传播模式。 一个关键的挑战是如何确定哪些信使可以安全地合并,哪些信使应当保留,以便随后进行计算。 现有方法通过保护迅速相通的前景区域来解决这一问题,从而保护具有高度相关性的结构。 然而,这一文本相关标准忽略了背景对象,即当下未明确提及的地方细节,导致结构一致性退化. 在这项工作中,我们提出“动态认识”合并(DaTMe),这是一个无培训框架,它使基本的传播动态具有象征意义。 我们的主要见解是,象征性的重要性应反映一个象征是否在发号施令期间仍未解决,以及它是否载有结构信息。 为此,DaTMe从Tweedie去声化的估计中构建出一张动态——意识到重要性的地图. 地图将时间信号结合起来,测量所预测的清洁图像的相继变化,并带有结构信号,捕捉出边界等局部高频内容和细微细节. 使用此地图,DaTMe在给定的压缩比下适应性地将指使符指定为合并角色:重要指使被保留为锚地,而同时在时间上稳定并结构上均匀的指使被选为安全的合并候选人. 在PixArt-a和FLUX上的实验表明,DaTMe在整个图像中保持视觉忠心,强调扩散动态是高效生成中有效的符号级合并决定. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/SeungJucha/DaTMe上查阅。

articles.title: SoftCache: Adaptive Step Size Caching for Diffusion Transformers
articles.content: Diffusion and flow models generate a sample over iterative steps, each a full pass through a large network, and that pass dominates generation cost. Training-free caching accelerates them by reusing activations from recent evaluations instead of recomputing them. Dynamic caching methods decide when to refresh by accumulating a cheap probe of the network input into a staleness signal and spending a fresh evaluation once it crosses a threshold. They perform hard caching: the signal is a binary switch between refresh and reuse, and every step, fresh or cached, advances by the prescribed step size. We observe that the signal carries much more than this switch. How far it sits below the threshold, its headroom, predicts the error induced by reuse. We propose SoftCache, which performs soft caching: instead of a binary switch, the headroom sets how far each cached step goes. Where the headroom is large, the sampler jumps past several scheduled nodes, and as a refresh nears, its steps shrink back toward the original step. These adaptive jumps may land between the scheduled nodes, taking the sampler off its fixed grid. SoftCache requires no training and adds no per-backbone settings: on FLUX for images and on HunyuanVideo and Wan2.1 for video, at speedups from $3.5\times$ to $6.9\times$, it is ahead of every baseline on all four fidelity metrics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SoftCache:用于扩散变形器的可适应步骤大小缓存
articles.content_zh: 分流和流出模型在迭代步骤上生成一个样本,每一个都通过一个大型网络,而通过这个模式则支配了生成成本. 无训练的缓存通过重新使用最近评价的活化物而不是重算来加速它们。 动态缓存方法通过将网络输入的廉价探测器积累到停滞信号中,然后在超过阈值后花费新的评价,决定何时刷新. 它们执行硬缓冲:信号是介于刷新和再利用之间的二进制开关,每个步骤,新鲜或缓冲,按规定的步长前进. 我们发现信号比这个开关要多得多 它坐落到阈值以下多远,它的头室,预测了再利用引起的出错. 我们提出SoftCache,它执行软缓存: 而不是二进制开关, 头室设定每个缓存步骤的去向。 在主室很大的地方,采样器会跳过几个预定的节点,而作为一个新鲜的接近点,它的台阶会缩回原来的台阶. 这些适应性跳跃可能降落在预定的节点之间,使采样器脱离了固定的网格. SoftCache不需要训练,也不增加每背骨设置:FLUX上用于图像,而HunyuanVideo和Wan2.1上用于视频,速度从3.5\times$到6.9\times$,在所有四个忠义度度度量的每个基准值上都领先.

articles.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
articles.content: Predicting how the world responds to an action requires more than what can be seen: robots must account for environmental factors that are neither directly observable nor explicitly specified, from physical properties such as friction and mass to human-defined environmental rules. We introduce T2-Z for test-time optimization of environment latents, which augments a robotic world model with a learnable environment latent to condition world predictions. This compact latent captures underlying environmental variation without supervision of what environmental factors exist or what values they take. During training, T2-Z alternates between two stages: a world-model optimization stage that fixes the latents and learns general action-conditioned dynamics across environments; and an environment-latent optimization stage that freezes the world model and optimizes the conditioning latents, allowing latent structure to emerge purely through world prediction. At test time, the world model remains frozen and a newly initialized environment latent is optimized from one or more test-time interactions, adapting the model to previously unseen environmental configurations. Across 7 simulated settings and 4 real-world robotic tasks, T2-Z reduces object prediction error metric from 15.20 to 7.00 and raises action success from 33.73% to 72.96%. Its emergent latents capture structured representations of individual and compounded factors across diverse visual scenes. Ablations further show that T2-Z can efficiently infer environment latents from as little as a single test-time interaction trajectory.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: T2-z : (韩语) 机器人世界模型环境模型的试验-时间优化
articles.content_zh: 预测世界如何对某项行动作出反应,需要的不仅仅是可以看到的情况:机器人必须说明从摩擦和质量等物理特性到人类定义的环境规则等既非直接可观测又非明确指明的环境因素。 我们引入了T2-Z,用于测试时间优化环境潜伏物,这可以增强一个机器人世界模型,并具有可学习的环境潜伏性,以制约世界的预测。 这种紧凑的潜在环境变化捕捉到潜在的环境变化,而无需对存在何种环境因素或其价值进行监督。 在培训期间,T2-Z在两个阶段之间的替代:一个世界模型优化阶段,可以修复潜在因素并学习各种环境的一般行动条件动力;另一个环境条件优化阶段,可以冻结世界模型并优化各种条件潜在因素,使潜在结构完全通过世界预测出现。 在试验时,世界模型依然被冻结,从一次或多次试验时的相互作用中优化了新初始化的环境潜伏,使模型适应以前未见的环境配置。 在7个模拟设置和4个现实世界的机器人任务中,T2-Z将对象预测出错的度量从15.20降至7.00,并将动作成功率从33.73%提高到72.96%. 它的出现潜伏性捕捉到不同视觉场景中个人和复合因素的结构化表现. 缩放进一步表明,T2-Z能够从一个单一的试验-时间相互作用轨迹中有效推断出环境潜伏.

articles.title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
articles.content: We introduce P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning through three complementary modes: Perceive, which reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from video; Predict, which generates visual futures under prescribed actions; and Plan, which jointly generates action trajectories and their anticipated visual consequences conditioned on an initial image, a language instruction, and an optional visual goal. Our model integrates a compact, structured 3D action representation into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers architecture with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions serve as either conditioning context or prediction targets across the three modes. Experiments show that unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training, including gains in planning quality under a vision-language model evaluation. Through unified training, our model outperforms specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets, while producing goal-directed manipulation videos with stronger instruction adherence and action progression than video-generation baselines. Project Page: https://p3-wam.pages.dev/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 认知、预测和计划:以Egocentre Dexterous Manipulation的统一世界行动模式
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了P$3}$-WAM, 一种以自负为核心的自负式操纵的统一世界行动模式,通过三种互补模式学习了3D感知,行动有条件的预测,以及目标导向规划: 视觉,它从视频中重建清晰的手动和相机轨迹; 预测,它根据规定的动作产生视觉未来; 计划,它联合生成动作轨迹及其预期的视觉后果,以初始图像,语言指示,以及可选的视觉目标为条件. 我们的模型将一个紧凑,结构分明的3D动作表现器通过一个具有共享基重,模式特异性改造,双向可视化动作注意的转换器,整合到一个经过预先训练的视频传播变压器中. 随机模式的能见度让视频和3D动作成为三种模式的上下文或预测目标。 实验显示,统一培训比单一模式培训提高所有三种能力,包括在愿景语言模式评价下规划质量方面的进步。 通过统一培训,我们的模型在三维手部重建和行动条件视频预测方面超越了专门的基线,在四个数据集中,同时制作目标导向的操纵视频,比视频生成基线更能遵守指令和行动进展。 项目网页:https://p3-wam.pages.dev/

articles.title: Grounding Generative Verification in 3D Content
articles.content: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and 3D generation have expanded 3D understanding and synthesis. However, beyond visual fidelity, task-specific correctness grounded in 3D evidence remains a major challenge. We argue that building reliable 3D systems requires not only stronger generation and reasoning, but also verification feedback that identifies unmet requirements and explains their violations, allowing systems to reflect on and refine their outputs. Such feedback must integrate multi-view observations and distinguish genuine inconsistencies from projection-dependent appearances. We make three contributions. First, we introduce 3DVerifierBench, a benchmark spanning 10 tasks that evaluates decisions, rejection explanations, and responses to controlled changes in specifications and candidates. A human study reveals a 21.6 percentage-point gap between humans and the strongest tested model, GPT-6 Astra, while explanation-aware analysis exposes weaknesses in rejection reliability. Second, we analyze verification across fine-grained factual categories, exposing errors in values and target binding. We develop a scalable pipeline combining multi-view fact extraction, controlled 3D editing, and native annotations to produce 14,126 training examples with contradiction explanations and linked counterfactuals. Third, we examine how verification could support 3D generation through candidate selection and recursive refinement. In human-labeled sixteen-candidate pools, oracle selection improves complete factual success from 26.7% to 90.0%. In a separate eight-input study, human-guided recursive refinement satisfies all seven requirements for every input, compared with three under parallel Oracle@8. Together, our benchmark, analysis, and data pipeline establish a foundation for models to reflect on 3D content through reliable verification feedback.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 三维内容中的基因验证
articles.content_zh: 最近在多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)和3D生成方面的进步已经扩大了3D的理解和合成. 然而,除了视觉忠贞外,基于三维证据的具体任务正确性仍然是一个重大挑战。 我们主张,建设可靠的三维系统不仅需要更强大的生成和推理,还需要核查反馈,找出未满足的要求并解释其违规情况,使系统能够反思和完善其产出. 这种反馈必须结合多观点观察,区分真正的不一致和依赖预测的外观. 我们作出了三项贡献。 首先,我们引入了3D验证器Bench, 这个基准涵盖10项任务, 评估决定,拒绝解释, 以及对控制下的规格和候选人变化的反应。 一项人类研究揭示出人类与最强测试模型GPT-6 Astra之间21.6%的差距,而解释-认识分析则暴露出拒绝可靠性的弱点. 第二,我们分析各种精细事实类别的核查,揭露价值错误和目标约束。 我们开发了可伸缩的管道,将多视图事实提取,控制3D编辑,以及本土说明结合起来,以产生14,126个培训例子,并附有自相矛盾的解释和相联的反事实. 第三,我们审查核查如何能够通过候选人的甄选和递归完善来支持3D生成。 在标有人类标记的16名候选人的集合中,甲骨文选择使完全的事实成功率从26.7%提高到90.0%。 在一项单独的八种输入法研究中,由人指导的递归性改进满足了每项输入的所有七项要求,而平行的甲骨文@8项下有三项要求。 我们的基准、分析和数据管道共同为模型打下基础,通过可靠的核查反馈对3D内容进行反思。

articles.title: DK-VLM: Geometry as Position for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models still struggle to understand 3D spatial relations across views and update spatial judgments as the observer moves. A common approach fuses 3D reconstruction features into visual tokens, but aligning these features with pretrained semantic representations remains challenging under limited spatial supervision. We propose DK-VLM with Dual-Kernel Attention, which computes attention from both a visual token's input position and its geometric position in the scene. A semantic kernel retains the pretrained model's native attention and positional encoding, while a separate geometric kernel uses estimated 3D points and camera poses to directly modulate attention through point displacements and relative view transformations. Then, a learned gate fuses their outputs. Geometry thus enters attention as position rather than as fused reconstruction features. We further introduce Reference-Frame Composition (RC) supervision to train the model to update its reference frame across successive judgments. It provides stepwise turn and heading targets derived from verified single-step annotations. Among the compared methods, DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest average score across six spatial benchmarks and the highest overall scores on VSI-Bench (74.33) and ReVSI-32 (58.28). RC supervision further improves multi-step spatial reasoning, while the full model preserves general video understanding. Project page: https://sumuru789.github.io/DK-VLM-website/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DK-VLM: 几何在视觉语言模型中作为空间理由的位置
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型仍然在挣扎着理解三维空间关系跨视角,并随着观察者的移动而更新空间判断. 一种共同的方法将3D重建特征融入视觉符号,但在有限的空间监督下,将这些特征与事先经过训练的语义表现相配合仍然是有挑战性的。 我们提出DK-VLM 具有双核注意, 它计算出注意力 从视觉符号的输入位置 及其在现场的几何位置。 语义内核保留了被预先训练的模型的本土注意力和位置编码,而单独的几何内核则使用估计的3D点和相机来通过点位移和相对取景转换来直接调节注意力. 然后,一个有学识的大门 将他们的输出融合起来。 因此,几何作为位置而非被引信接通的重建特征而引起注意。 我们进一步引入参照-Frame组成(RC)监督,以培训该模型,以更新其历任判决的参照框架。 它提供由已核实的单步说明衍生的相向转动和方向目标. 在比较方法中,DK-VLM-8B在6个空间基准中达到最高平均分,在VSI-Bench(74.33)和ReVSI-32(58.28)上达到最高总分. RC监督进一步改善了多步空间推理,而完整的模型则保留了一般的视频理解. 项目网页:https://sumuru789.github.io/DK-VLM-website/.

articles.title: SUPRA-TEX: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Texture
articles.content: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: (原始内容存档于2013-10-12). SUPRA-TEX: 带有超对齐纹理的 3D 生成
articles.content_zh: 单一图像 3D 生成旨在为给定的 3D 网目穿戴可发光的材料,同时忠实地保存参考图像的视觉细节. 现有方法要么在调和不一致的多视图预测时引入了文物,要么通过隐含的图像地貌条件努力保存精细细节. 为了应对这些挑战,我们采用了SUPRA-Tex,它建立在可视材料估算、地表对接和观察制导3D完成脱钩的原则上。 这种分工使得经过有限三维数据培训的三维生成器能够将能力集中到保存可见证据并完成无观测到的表面. 具体来说,我们首先培训一个基于MLLM的图像编辑模型,在参考视图中预测被照明分隔的PBR地图. 然后把这些地图投放到可见的地表 并用经过预先训练的材料 VAE编码器 编码成本地观测潜质 共享生成目标的潜在空间 一个相接的流变器将这些潜伏物作为固定的,只读的锚地,同时交替进行未观测的区域和全地表更新以产生完整的物质潜伏物. 这个设计实现了与参考物的超对接,在可见区域上传递出"你所看到的"(What You See Is What What You Get)"忠贞"(We's T忠贞"What"),在未观测到的地表上连贯地完成. SUPRA-Tex只接受公共数据集的培训,在几何条件的纹理和端到端的资产生成方面都实现了SOTA的性能,比对甚至超过了最领先的商业系统在闪烁的图像上. 项目网页:https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/

articles.title: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
articles.content: Few-step autoregressive video generators enable streaming generation, yet they run every token through the final denoising step, regardless of how much refinement it needs. We find this uniform computation is often unnecessary: many tokens already closely match their eventual full-step outputs in the initial steps, while others require refinement until the end. We introduce Speculative Forcing, a framework that treats intermediate clean estimates as drafts and predicts when individual tokens can be safely accepted early. Once accepted, a token is frozen as its final output and undergoes no further denoising, while its cached keys and values remain available as context for the remaining tokens. We explore two alternative verifier designs: a training-free one based on similarity to clean content and stability across steps, and a learned one that reads the frozen generator's intermediate features to estimate each token's remaining gap to its full-step output. Across short-video, long-video, and world generation, Speculative Forcing preserves the quality of full-step sampling while substantially reducing computation. On LongLive, it matches the four-step generator with ~1.7 denoising steps per token, running over 1.5x faster at 41.7 and 37.8 fps. On Lingbot-World 2.0, where camera motion continually changes the visible content, it maintains quality with ~2.5 denoising steps per token and runs 1.35x faster at 24.5 fps.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高效自动回放视频生成的频谱强制
articles.content_zh: 很少步骤自回式视频生成器可以使流体生成,然而它们通过最终去名步骤运行了每一个符号,无论它需要多少改进. 我们认为这种统一的计算常常是不必要的:许多符号已经在初始步骤中与最终的全步输出紧密相匹配,而其他符号则需要完善直至结束. 我们引入了Speculative Forcing,这个框架将中间清洁估计作为草稿处理,并预测单个活物何时能早日安全地被接受. 一旦被接受,一个令牌被冻结作为最终输出,不再被取消,而其缓存的密钥和值作为剩余令牌的上下文仍然可用. 我们探索两种替代的验证器设计:一种是免费的训练,基于与清洁内容的相似性和跨步骤的稳定性;另一种是学习的,读取被冷冻的生成器的中间特性,以估计出每个符号的剩余缺口与它的全步输出. 纵观短视频、长视频和世界一代,Speculative Forcing保持了全步采样的质量,同时大大减少了计算。 在"LongLive"上,它与四步发电机相匹配为~1.7去诺音阶每令牌,以41.7和37.8英尺的速度跑得快于1.5x. 在Lingbot-World 2.0上,相机运动持续地改变可见内容,它保持质量,每令牌为~2.5去诺音阶并运行速度快于24.5英尺.

articles.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
articles.content: Recent 3D world models increasingly use features from geometry foundation models (GFMs) as predictive world states, benefiting from their rich geometric priors. However, the view dependence of these features entangles scene dynamics with camera-induced variation, making the resulting state evolution harder to predict. We propose GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation. Specifically, a scene tokenizer aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state, which a geometry decoder queries using camera rays. An autoregressive world model then predicts future scene states, while camera motion is modeled separately. The predicted states can therefore be decoded under either predicted or externally specified cameras, while retaining a single context-derived scale throughout the rollout without per-frame scale alignment. Experiments show that GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo, supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying, and generalizes zero-shot to KITTI and nuScenes. Project page: https://hongchang-liu.github.io/GeoState-project-page/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GeoState:用于三维世界建模的学习视图十进制几何状态
articles.content_zh: 最近的3D世界模型越来越多地使用从几何基础模型(GFMS)中的特征作为预测性世界状态,受益于其丰富的几何前身. 然而,这些特征的取景依赖将场景动态与相机所引发的变异相纠缠在一起,使由此而来的状况进化更难预测. 我们提出GeoState,一种视差分解的几何表示法,用于预测3D世界模型,将景态演化与相机依赖的观测区分开来. 具体来说,一个场景示意器将多视图的GFM特征集成到一个取景解码的场景状态,这个场景状态是使用相机射线进行几何解码的查询. 一个自相回转的世界模型然后预测出未来的场景状态,而相机运动则被单独地建模. 因此,预测的状态可以在预测或外部指定的相机下进行解码,同时在整个推出过程中保持一个单一的上下文生成的尺度,而无需按帧比对. 实验显示,GeoState在Waymo上超越了之前的3D世界模型,支持几何相容的交叉视图查询,并概括为KITTI和nuScens的零射入. 项目网页:https://hongchan-liu.github.io/Geole State-project-page/ 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.

articles.title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
articles.content: We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First, we construct 3DCodeVerse-2M, a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representations, and generating new programs with coding agents. Each program is packaged with the source files and associated assets required for execution in its declared environment, along with available descriptions and verification records. Second, we develop the 3DCodeVerse Harness, a multi-agent directed acyclic graph framework for generating and refining 3D content. It uses execution checks, spatial measurements, and visual feedback to automatically evaluate and revise generated programs without human feedback during generation. Third, we conduct systematic empirical studies of 3D coding, establishing baselines with fine-tuned open models and deriving practical guidance through component-level analyses of our harness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning on our dataset significantly improves the 3D coding capabilities of open-source models. Notably, our 3DCodeVerse harness achieves a 90% win rate against Claude Design (3D Object) in pairwise human evaluations, when both are utilized by Claude Opus 5.5.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 3 代码 Verse: 将 三维世界作为代码探索
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了3DCodeVerse,一个研究生态系统,它使编码剂能够大规模地创建可编辑和可核查的3D内容. 3DCodeVerse包含可执行的3D代码的大规模高质量数据集,用于空间推理和自动化验证的编码工具,以及3D编码实用指南. 首先,我们构建了3DCodeVerse-2M,一个由独立3D可执行代码组成的大规模编译数据集. 我们通过收集开源数据,转换专门表述,以及用编码代理生成新程序来建立这个工具。 每个程序都装有在其申报环境中执行所需的源文件和相关资产以及现有的描述和核查记录。 第二,我们开发出3DCodeVerse Harness,这是一个多剂定向的循环图框架,用于生成和精炼3D内容. 它利用执行检查,空间测量,和视觉反馈,在生成过程中自动评价和修改生成的程序而无需人类反馈. 第三,我们对三维编码进行系统的经验性研究,确定基线,采用经过微调的开放模型,并通过对我们的利用情况进行组件层面的分析,获得实际指导。 广泛的实验表明,我们数据集的微调可大大提高开源模型的3D编码能力. 值得注意的是,我们的3DCodeVerse控制带在Claude Design(3D Object)的双向人类评价中实现了90%的胜率,而Claude Opus 5.5则使用了两者。

articles.title: ACEdit: Stable Multi-Turn Image Editing via Asymmetric Conditioning
articles.content: Image editing models produce impressive results for individual edits, but their quality often deteriorates over multiple editing turns. Each editing turn introduces small distribution shifts that accumulate over successive edits, creating a gap between the input distributions encountered during the editor's original training and multi-turn inference. We introduce a training scheme that makes multi-turn image editing stable under this accumulating distribution shift. A key is to force the editor to operate on its own outputs from previous editing turns during training, bringing the principle of Self-Forcing to image editing. The main challenge is that self-generated editing trajectories deviate from ground-truth trajectories, making direct supervision unreliable. We address this challenge through a distillation objective that leverages a teacher image editor to provide a reliable training signal when the model operates on its own previous outputs. We introduce an asymmetric conditioning scheme: while the student performs edits sequentially on its own outputs, the teacher remains anchored to the original clean image and receives a compound editing instruction. Experiments show substantially reduced degradation over long multi-turn sequences while maintaining editing quality and instruction adherence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ACEdit: 通过非对称性平稳多翻转图像编辑 条件
articles.content_zh: 图像编辑模型为个人编辑带来了令人印象深刻的结果,但其质量往往会因为多个编辑转折而恶化. 每个编辑回合都引入了在相继编辑后相继积累的小型发行分班,在编辑员原始训练期间遇到的输入分班和多回合推论之间造成了差距. 我们推行了一项培训计划,在这种累积的分布转变下,使多回合图像编辑稳定。 一个关键是迫使编辑者在训练期间根据之前的编辑回合的自己产出进行操作,将"自强"原则带入图像编辑. 主要挑战在于自发产生的编辑轨迹偏离了地上真实轨迹,使得直接监管不可靠. 我们通过一个提炼目标来应对这一挑战,该目标利用教师图像编辑器,在模型按自己以往产出运作时提供可靠的培训信号。 我们引入了一个不对称的调节方案:虽然学生根据自己的产出依次进行编辑,但教师仍然固定在原始的清洁图像上,并接受复合编辑指导。 实验表明,在长期多回合序列中,降解程度大大降低,同时保持了编辑质量和指令的坚持性。

articles.title: Dense4D: Pixel-Level 4D Human Correspondence
articles.content: Reconstructing human motion in 4D requires identifying the same surface points through articulation, deformation and changes in visibility. We introduce Dense4D, to our knowledge the first feed-forward model dedicated to dense 4D correspondence across the body, clothing and hair from a set of monocular RGB images, without a body template. Trained specifically for human geometry, Dense4D jointly processes person-centred crops with known image-to-crop transforms to predict Human Point Maps (HPMs) and depth for each image. An HPM assigns each person pixel the 3D position of its observed surface point at a common reference time. These maps support amodal correspondence: points hidden in the reference image can be localised from observations in other frames. Matching HPM coordinates across crops establishes correspondence without predicting camera poses or large scene displacements; per-image depth then lifts the matches into 3D tracks. Experiments on real people demonstrate substantially higher tracking accuracy and closer agreement with scanned surfaces than the evaluated baselines. Points from different frames assemble into coherent human geometry in the reference pose, providing visible evidence of consistent dense correspondence through articulation and clothing deformation. Additional qualitative results, videos, and an interactive viewer are available at https://alpguler.com/dense4d.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Dense4D:像素级4D人类通信
articles.content_zh: 在4D中重新构建人的运动需要通过发音,变形和能见度的变化来识别相同的地表点. 我们介绍Dense4D, 据我们所知,第一个Feed-forward的模型 专门处理全身密集的4D通信, 服装和发型来自一组单相机的 RGB 图像,没有身体模板. Dense4D专门为人类几何学进行训练,通过已知的图像到作物变换,共同处理以人为中心的作物,以预测人点地图(HPM)和每个图像的深度。 一个HPM在共同的参考时间为每个人分配其所观测到的地表点的3D位置像素. 这些地图支持一个模式对应:在参考图像中隐藏的点可以从其他框架的观察中定位. 匹配不同作物的HPM坐标可以建立通信,而无需预测相机的外观或大场景的相位;再将相克深度提升到3D轨道. 对真人进行的试验显示,与所评估的基线相比,跟踪准确度高得多,对被扫描的地表更接近一致。 来自不同框架的分点在参考姿势中组装成连贯的人类几何,通过表达和服装变形,提供了一致的密集相通的明显证据. 可在https://alpguler.com/dense4d上查阅更多的定性结果、录像和互动取景器。

articles.title: AVC-Reward: Event-Centric Audio-Video Consistency Evaluation
articles.content: As joint audio-video generation models become more capable, they can generate audio-visual scenes exhibiting three forms of complexity: multi-event composition, multi-layer audio mixture, and asymmetric cross-modal relations. However, current evaluations largely reuse metrics from earlier simple and unidirectional tasks. They typically evaluate an audio-video clip as a whole and rely on simple predefined relations, making them unsuitable for these increasingly complex scenes. We propose an event-centric evaluation framework that disentangles audio and visual events at the event level, analyzes each event independently, cross-validates relations across modalities, and aggregates the judgments into a coarse-to-fine, three-level consistency metric. The metric assesses global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment, providing a general formulation for audio-video consistency evaluation across diverse generation settings and cross-modal relations. We instantiate the metric as AVC-Reward, a trainable audio-video reward model. To evaluate the agreement between automatic judgments and human perception across generation paradigms and relation complexities, we construct AVC-Benchmark, which is primarily built from diverse positive and negative samples generated by various types of audio-video generation models. AVC-Reward achieves state-of-the-art alignment with human judgment among automatic methods, provides interpretable rationales that localize failures, and improves the audio-video consistency of a joint generation model when used as an online reinforcement-learning signal. Project page: https://tsuki0512.github.io/AVC-Reward.github.io/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AVC-奖励 : 活动-中央视听一致性评价
articles.content_zh: 随着联合音频-视频生成模型的能力增强,它们可以生成显示三种形式复杂性的视听场景:多事件组成,多层音频混合,以及不对称的跨模式关系. 然而,目前的评价基本上重复使用早先简单和单向任务的衡量标准。 他们通常会整体评价一个音频-视频剪辑,并依靠简单的预先定义的关系,使它们不适合这些日益复杂的场景. 我们提出一个以事件为中心的评价框架,将事件层面的视听事件分解,独立分析每个事件,跨模式交叉验证关系,将判断汇总为一个粗糙到精细的,三级的一致性度量. 衡量标准评估了全球的叙事和谐、事件层面的时间同步和精细的属性协调,为不同代间环境和跨模式关系的音频-视频一致性评价提供了一般的表述。 我们用AVC-Reward作为衡量标准, 一个训练有素的音频视频奖励模式。 为了评价自动判断与人类对代际范式的看法和关系复杂性之间的一致,我们构建了AVC-Benchmark,它主要是由各种音频视频生成模型生成的各种正反分样而来. AVC-Reward在自动方法中实现了与人类判断的先进一致,提供了可解释的将故障本地化的理由,并改进了联合生成模型作为在线增强学习信号时的音频-视频一致性. 项目网页:https://tsuki0512.github.io/AVC-Reward.github.io/

articles.title: Not Just a Subject: Capturing Adaptive Scene-Specific Variance for Visual Storytelling
articles.content: Recent advancements in diffusion models have significantly improved text-to-image generation, enabling their application to visual storytelling, where coherent image sequences are generated from narrative prompts. However, existing methods primarily focus on identity preservation and often fail to adapt to diverse scene variations, resulting in semantic misalignment and structural inflexibility. We propose EOS-Story, a training-free framework that harmonizes identity consistency with scene-specific adaptation across text and vision spaces. In the text space, we decouple the narrative into identity and scene sub-prompts to prevent information dilution, but this leaves the scene without access to appearance cues. To bridge this gap, we introduce Cross-Contextual Bridging, which softly injects a phrase-level appearance residual into the scene's <EOS> embedding. In the vision space, we find that scale mismatch between identity and scene subjects causes a few identity tokens to be repeatedly transferred, producing structural artifacts. We address this with Adaptive Identity Preservation, which anchors identity features at the scene-specific scale (Identity Anchoring) and integrates them via Identity-Aware Self-Attention. To evaluate performance under varied spatial compositions, we extend the Consistory+ benchmark with diverse framing scenarios (Consistory+_+). Extensive experiments show that EOS-Story achieves competitive or superior performance on both benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 不只是一个主题: 视觉故事描述的可适应场景差异
articles.content_zh: 最近传播模型的进步大大地改善了文字到图像生成,使得它们能够被应用到视觉故事讲解中,从叙事提示中产生出连贯的图像序列. 然而,现有方法主要注重身份保护,往往无法适应不同的场景变化,导致语义错位和结构上不灵活. 我们提议采用EOS-Story,这是一个无培训框架,将身份一致性与不同文本和视觉空间的场景适应性相协调。 在文本空间中,我们把叙述解为身份和场景子瞬间,以防止信息被稀释,但这让场景无法进入外观提示. 为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了跨文字连接(cross-Contextal Britching),它软地将一个短语级外观残留注入了场景的"EOS"嵌入. 在视觉空间中,我们发现身份和场景主体的尺度不匹配导致一些身份标志被反复地转移,产生出结构文物. 我们用适应性身份保护来解决这个问题,它将身份特征定位在具体地点的尺度(身份识别)上,并通过身份识别-意识自我识别加以整合。 为了评估在各种空间构成下的业绩,我们扩展了Consory+基准,采用不同的框架设想(Consory +_+)。 广泛的实验显示,EOS-Story在两个基准上都取得了有竞争力或优异的表现.

articles.title: Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient
articles.content: Video world models turn actions and camera motion into long visual rollouts, making video a natural interface for interactive simulation. Such interaction requires responsive generation, yet coherent rollouts must retain visual memory of what has already been generated. Chunked video diffusion models usually keep this context in growing KV caches, so later chunks become progressively slower. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Velox, a training-free attention router for region-level context selection using frustum slab correspondences from streaming geometry. Velox represents historical blocks as camera frustum slabs with depth intervals and obtains current-block depth through recency-priority multiwarp. For well-covered regions, frustum slab overlap softly modulates each layer's model-derived block importance. Uncovered regions retain the model-derived route without geometric bias. The fixed token-block granularity matches FlashAttention-style tiled execution and reduces the attention term that grows with rollout length. Frustum slab construction runs asynchronously with denoising on the same H200. At chunk 48, Velox accelerates attention by $4.36\times$ and denoising by $2.43\times$. On the full 158-case WBench navigation split, it remains within 0.15 API-free average points of dense LingBot-Fast-Cam. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/velox/ for more details.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Velox:空间记忆使世界模式高效
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型将动作和相机运动转化为长视展开,使视频成为互动模拟的自然界面. 这种互动需要反应迅速的生成,但连贯的推出必须保留已产生的视觉记忆。 被剪切的视频传播模型通常会将这种上下文保留在不断增长的KV缓存中,因此后期块会逐渐变慢. 为了解决这一瓶颈,我们引入了Velox,一个无训练的注意路由器,用于区域级上下文选择,使用流出几何的frustum slab对应. Velox代表历史区块作为有深度间隔的相机frustum slabs,通过Recency优先多瓦得到流块深度. 对于覆盖范围很广的区域,frustum slab软地将每层模型产生的块重要性相重叠. 未覆盖区域保留模型衍生的路线,没有几何偏差. 固定的符号块颗粒性匹配了FlashAttenty风格的平板执行并减少了随推出长度而增长的注意名词. Frustum slab 的构造与同一H200上的去诺音同步运行. 在48分时,Velox的注意力加速了4.36分秒, 并且取消了2.43分秒。 在完整的158克W Bench导航分出时,它保持在0.15的API无密度LingBot-Fast-Cam平均点以内. 详情请见我们的项目网页https://velox-world.com/velox/。

articles.title: ARC-SORT: Adaptive, Robust, Compensated Multi-Object Tracking with Interacting Multiple Models
articles.content: Multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts is hard for two reasons: athletes move fast and change direction abruptly, and the camera pans and zooms at the same time. We present ARC-SORT (Adaptive, Robust, Compensated SORT), a tracking-by-detection tracker that trains nothing and runs in real time. Its design rule: the tracker measures its own uncertainty, and that measurement decides how it acts. An Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) Kalman filter gives every track a predictive covariance, and we turn it into a per-track search region: the less reliable the motion prediction, the larger the region in which a detection may match (uncertainty-adaptive Expansion IoU, EIoU). On identical inputs, this continuous coupling is what matters: the same covariance used as a hard Mahalanobis gate hurts at every threshold we swept, and richer covariance summaries add nothing measurable. When two tracks cross, the assignment cost itself reports whether the decision was close. ARC-SORT keeps such pairs under review and applies at most one corrective identity swap once post-crossing appearance evidence shows the first decision was wrong; this adds +1.0 HOTA (higher order tracking accuracy) on both the SportsMOT and DanceTrack test sets at under a millisecond per frame. For players who leave the frame for seconds, motion extrapolation carries no information, so our offline re-identification drops the usual motion gate and links tracklets by appearance alone. ARC-SORT reaches 81.82 HOTA on the SportsMOT test set with the fewest identity switches of the 69 leaderboard entries as of August 2026 and tied-third multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA, 97.09), and 62.1 HOTA on DanceTrack test with the same association settings. On Deep-EIoU's public detections and embeddings it reaches 80.31 HOTA, +3.1 over Deep-EIoU. It runs at about 50 frames per second on a laptop RTX 3060 GPU. Code will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ARC-SORT:适应性,强力,与交互多模型的补偿多对象跟踪
articles.content_zh: 体育广播中的多对象跟踪由于两个原因很难进行:运动员动作快而突然改变方向,相机平板和缩放同时进行. 我们介绍ARC-SORT(英语:Adaptive, Robust, Confensated SORT),是一款逐一检测的跟踪跟踪器,不进行实时的训练并运行. 其设计规则: 追踪者测量自己的不确定性,测量决定它如何行动. 交互多模型(IMM)卡尔曼滤波器使每个轨道都具有预测共变性,我们把它变成每道搜索区域:运动预测越不可靠,检测可能匹配的区域越大(不确定-可适应扩展IoU,EIoU). 在相同的输入上,这种连续的接合是最重要的:同样的共变作为坚硬的马哈拉诺比斯门在我们所扫过的每一个阈值上都会受伤,而更丰富的共变总结则没有增加任何可测量的. 当两个轨道交叉时,任务本身就报告决定是否接近。 ARC-SORT不断审查这些配对,一旦交叉后的外观证据显示第一个决定是错误的,最多一次更正身份交换;这增加了SportsMOT和DanceTrack测试机的+1.0 HOTA(更高订单跟踪精度),每帧在一毫秒下。 对于离开帧数秒的玩家,运动外推带没有信息,因此我们离线的再识别会单独将通常的运动门降下并链接出轨迹. 截止2026年8月,ARC-SORT在SportsMOT测试装置上达到了81.82 HOTA,其中69个领跑板条目中身份开关最少,并有捆绑-第三多对象跟踪精度(MOTA,97.09),62.1 HOTA在DanceTrack测试上达到了相同的关联设置. 在Deep-EIoU的公测上并嵌入到80.31 HOTA,+3.1在Deep-EIoU上方. 它运行在一台笔记本电脑RTX 3060 GPU上,每秒约50帧. 代码将发布。

articles.title: Grounded Human-Attributed Description and Activity Recognition in Videos
articles.content: Understanding characteristics and activities of individuals in complex multi-person environments is crucial for real-world applications. However, existing datasets often simplify this problem to grounded group activity recognition, single-person activity recognition, or close-set activity recognition, thus limiting the generalizability of models trained on these datasets. In this work, we introduce the task of Grounded Human-Attributed Description and Activity Recognition (GHADAR), which involves describing the characteristics and activity descriptions of \textbf{every} person in a video, provided the location of the person in the video, which is more practical for real-world applications. To facilitate this, we introduce a new dataset derived from AVA-Actions by generating open-set captions for the person description and activity. In addition, we propose a novel method to effectively utilize the information contained in grounding during training by constraining the cross-attention masks during training in VLMs to improve performance for this task. Our experiments show that our method outperforms SOTA VLMs on this task. Finally, we demonstrate the limitations of existing evaluation metrics, which are overly reliant on human-annotations and exact text-text matching. As an added video-based evaluation, we propose a holistic VLM-based evaluation schema that compares concepts {\em directly} between the video and the generated predictions. Thus, in this work, we develop a complete framework for GHADAR, including a dataset, a novel method and an evaluation schema, thereby establishing a strong foundation for future research in this domain.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视频中人类属性描述和活动识别
articles.content_zh: 了解个人在复杂的多人环境中的特点和活动对于现实世界的应用至关重要。 然而,现有的数据集往往将这个问题简化为基于群体活性识别,单人活性识别,或近地设定活性识别,从而限制了在这些数据集上接受过培训的模型的通俗性. 在这部作品中,我们引入了"地基人类属性描述和活动识别(GHADAR)"(GHADAR)的任务,该任务涉及在视频中描述\textbf{Every}人物的特征和活动描述,提供视频中人物的位置,这对现实世界的应用更为实用. 为了促进这一点,我们采用了从AVA-Actions中衍生出的新数据集,为人物描述和活动生成开放的设置标题. 此外,我们建议采用一种新的方法来有效利用培训期间的入地信息,在培训期间限制交叉注意力口罩,以提高这项工作的绩效。 我们的实验表明,我们的方法在这项工作上超过了SOTA VLM. 最后,我们显示了现有评价衡量尺度的局限性,它们过分依赖人文说明和准确的文本匹配。 作为额外的基于视频的评价,我们提出一个基于VLM的整体评价计划,在视频和生成的预测之间将概念作一比较。 因此,在这项工作中,我们为GHADAR开发了一个完整的框架,包括一个数据集,一个新的方法和一个评价计划,从而为该领域的未来研究奠定坚实的基础.

articles.title: Routing Policy Optimization for Online Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Reinforcement learning can align visual generators with reward signals beyond their pretraining objectives, but existing score-function methods typically introduce stochasticity by perturbing the reverse denoising trajectory, leading to costly rollout-based optimization. We instead ask whether stochastic exploration can be introduced inside the generator while preserving its original sampler. Routing Policy Optimization (RPO) answers this question by turning attention routing into a stochastic exploration action. At a few selected denoising levels, each query block keeps its own block and samples further key blocks in proportion to the generator's native attention mass, or keeps dense attention. The sampled route perturbs the velocity of that transition, and a Gaussian likelihood around the dense velocity scores the perturbation with a score-function objective. RPO further uses a controlled two-rollout estimator: two rollouts share the same prompt, initial latent, routed denoising levels, and dense anchor layers, differing only in their sampled attention routes. Their reward difference provides an advantage signal for the routed transitions. Because the likelihood differentiates the dense velocity itself, the learned updates remain effective after routing is removed. At inference, RPO restores dense attention and retains the original deterministic sampler. Experiments on text-to-image and text-to-video generation show that RPO improves generation quality while achieving nearly 4x higher training efficiency than Flow-GRPO-style methods. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/rpo for visual results.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在线传播强化学习的运行政策优化
articles.content_zh: 强化学习可以使视觉发电机与超越其前期训练目标的奖励信号相配合,但现有的分数功能方法通常通过扰动倒向去诺分道扬镳的轨迹来引入分色,导致代价高昂的以推出为基础的优化. 相反,我们询问是否可以在发电机内部引入有花样的勘探,同时保留其原始取样器。 Routing Political Observation(RPO)通过将注意力的去向化为有花样的探索行动来回答这个问题. 在少数选定的去诺化水平上,每个查询块会保持自己的块并按生成器的原生关注质量比例对更多的关键块进行取样,或者保持密集的注意. 被取样的路线扰动了这种过渡的速度,在密集速度周围的一种高斯概率以得分函数目标来给扰动打分. RPO还使用了受控的双滚出计数器:两个出计数器共享相同的即时,初始潜伏,路由去诺能水平,以及密集的锚地层,仅在被取样的注意路线上有所不同. 他们的奖励差异为路由过渡提供了优势信号. 由于概率会区分密度速度本身,所学的更新在去除路由后依然有效. 推断出,RPO恢复了密集的注意力并保留了原来的定型采样器. 关于文本到图像和文本到视频生成的实验表明,RPO提高了生成质量,同时实现了近4x高的培训效率,超过了Flow-GRPO风格的方法. 请在https://velox-world.com/rpo上查看我们的项目网页,了解视觉效果。

articles.title: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
articles.content: Spatial intelligence lets an agent perceive and act in the physical world, and many of its judgments must be made at interaction rates: which spatial relation holds, how far an object is, or where to place it. Vision-language models (VLMs) produce these answers by free-form text generation, paying for autoregressive decoding and answer parsing even though the output space is compact: one of a few options, a scalar, or a 2D point. In light of this, we introduce MJev-Spatial, a System 1 multimodal decision model that tackles all three types of spatial understanding tasks within a unified classification framework. Specifically, MJev-Spatial treats each candidate as a class and scores it using the backbone's pretrained query and key projections, without adding parameters. The candidates are the given options for choice tasks, or value bins and image regions refined through coarse-to-fine classification for numerical and point prediction, respectively. At inference, each classification decision takes a single forward pass and generates no answer tokens. To train on heterogeneous spatial data efficiently, we supervise all coarse-to-fine stages jointly with teacher forcing in one forward pass, and combine this with length-aware global batching and cross-GPU load balancing, raising training throughput by 30.8% over the original batching strategy. Built on Qwen3.5-4B and trained on 12.3M question-answer pairs converted from existing spatial datasets, MJev-Spatial achieves the highest overall score (65.64%) among eight tested models, ranks first on seven of twelve benchmarks, and outperforms its unmodified autoregressive base model on all twelve, while running 2.5 times faster than the fastest autoregressive baseline and 5.6 times faster than the base model.
