articles.title_zh: MJev-Spatial:通过原住民关注匹配的系统一个空间智能
articles.content_zh: 空间智能让一个物剂在物理世界中感知并采取行动,其许多判断必须以相互作用的速度做出:空间关系是何等的,物体是多远的,或者放在哪里. Vision-language models (VLMs) 通过自由格式的文本生成来生成这些答案,支付自旋解码和解答解析,即使输出空间是紧凑的:少数选项之一,是平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面 有鉴于此,我们引入了MJev-Spatial,一种系统1的多模式决定模型,在统一的分类框架内处理所有三类空间理解任务. 具体来说,MJev-Spatial将每个考生视为一个类,并使用骨干预先训练的查询和关键预测来评分,而不增加参数. 候选人是选择任务的指定选项,或者通过粗细的分类分别对数值和分数预测进行精细的分数和图像区域进行精细的估价. 推论,每个分类决定都采取单一前传,不产生答题符. 为了高效地培训不同的空间数据,我们对所有粗糙的到精细的阶段进行联合监督,教师在一次前行中强迫进行,并将这与长视全球分批和跨GPU负载平衡结合起来,使培训吞吐量比原来的分批战略提高了30.8%。 MJev-Sparadial以Quen3.5-4B为主,并接受从现有空间数据集转换而来12.3M问答对等的训练,在被测试的8个模型中取得了最高的总分(65.64%),在12个基准中的7个中排名第一,并且在所有12个基准中都超过了其未经修改的自递式基准模型,同时运行速度快于最快自递式基准,快于基准模型的5.6倍.

articles.title: Unsupervised Clustering of Public Transport Vehicles Using Deep Morphological Features and Color Histograms
articles.content: Surveillance cameras along urban roads produce large volumes of unlabeled video that could support the monitoring of public transport, but grouping the observed vehicles into meaningful categories without manual annotation remains challenging, since buses from different routes often share the same body structure and differ mainly in their color schemes. This study presents an unsupervised clustering methodology for public transport vehicles that combines morphological features extracted with a frozen DINOv2 Vision Transformer and handcrafted HSV color histograms through weighted early fusion, followed by UMAP projection and K-Means clustering. The method was evaluated on 7,972 bus images extracted from about 1,460 hours of video of an arterial road in Mexico City, with the goal of isolating the buses of the city's public bus network (RTP) without supervision. With a fusion of 65\% morphological and 35\% color features, the pipeline produced 14 clusters that separate distinct routes and vehicle types, and it increased the precision of the target cluster with respect to morphological features alone. These results show that color complements self-supervised features for route-level clustering, provided that it does not dominate the representation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用深层口腔特征和彩色直方图对公共交通车辆进行无监督的分组
articles.content_zh: 沿城市道路的监控相机产生大量无标签的视频,可以支持对公共交通的监控,但将所观测到的车辆分为有意义的类别而不进行人工注释仍然是有挑战性的,因为来自不同路线的公交车通常具有相同的车体结构,并且主要在它们的配色方案上有所不同. 本研究为公交车辆提出了一种无监督的集群方法,将所提取的形态特征与被冷冻的DINOv2视觉变形器和手动的HSV色直方图通过加权早期聚变,再由UMAP投影和K-Means集群. 从墨西哥城一条动脉道约1,460小时的视频中提取出7,972辆公交车的图像对这种方法进行了评价,目标是在没有监督的情况下隔离该市公共公交网络(RTP)的公交车. 管道以65-Q的形态特征和35-Q的颜色特征相融合,产生了14个将不同的路线和车辆类型相分离的集群,它提高了目标集群仅就形态特征而言的精度. 这些结果显示,色彩是对路由级集群自我监督的特征的补充,前提是它不主导代表.

articles.title: Beyond Pairwise Repulsion: Collective Diversity via Determinant Maximization in Diffusion Sampling
articles.content: Strong guidance in text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models concentrates sampling toward high-density modes of the conditional distribution, collapsing independently sampled noise vectors onto nearly identical visual prototypes. This limits utility for tasks that demand distributional breadth, most critically synthetic data augmentation. Diversity, however, is a collective property of the whole batch: a set can preserve every pairwise distance yet still collapse onto a low-dimensional subspace. Existing sum-of-pairwise noise-optimization and repulsion objectives respond only weakly to this higher-order failure. We propose DetNO (Determinant Noise Optimization), which formulates diverse generation as RKHS volume maximization on the initial noise, maximizing the log-determinant of an RBF Gram matrix over one-step Tweedie predictions. This set-level functional equals the squared batch volume; its repulsion is strongest when the batch is most collapsed and self-attenuates as diversity is achieved. An anchor-based fidelity term keeps the optimized noises near plausible regions, and Lagrangian relaxation gives a two-term objective with a single hyperparameter $λ$ governing the diversity-quality trade-off, without training or sampler modification. Across three backbones (SD1.5, SDXL, SD3), DetNO achieves leading intra-batch diversity in VendiScore and Mean Self-Similarity, and a downstream few-shot classification experiment confirms that broader mode coverage brings statistically significant accuracy gains for synthetic data augmentation in the low-shot regime. Fixing the pipeline and varying only the batch objective, both RBF-based aggregators outperform InfoNCE, and the log-determinant attains the best downstream accuracy on both benchmarks. Its diversity advantage over InfoNCE widens as the batch grows. Code is available at https://github.com/mobled37/DetNO.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Pairwise Republision:通过分散抽样中的最大化实现集体多样性
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型的有力指导将取样集中在有条件分发的高密度模式上,将独立取样的噪声矢量倒向几乎相同的视觉原型上。 这限制了那些需要分布宽度的任务的效用,最关键的是合成数据增强. 然而,多样性是整个批次的一个集体财产:一个集可以保持每一个对等相距,但仍会倒塌到一个低维子空间上. 现存的平时噪声优化和回击等总和只能对这种更高级的故障作出微弱的反应. 我们提出DetNO(定点噪声优化),它以RKHS体积在初始噪声上最大化,在一步步的Tweedie预测中将RBF Gramma矩阵的日志决定力最大化,从而形成多样的生成. 此设置级功能等同平方批量;当批量最倒塌并随着多样性的实现而自适应时,其反作用最强. 基于锚地的忠诚度术语使最优化的噪声接近可能存在的区域,而拉格朗日放松则给出了一个双时目标,一个单一的超参数美元,用于管理多样性质量的取舍,而无需经过培训或采样者修改。 跨越了三个主干(SD1.5,SDXL,SD3),DetNO在"VendiScore"和"Mean自相仿"中实现了领先的批内多样性,下游的"几发分级"实验证实,更广泛的模式覆盖为低发分制中合成数据增强带来了统计学上显著的精度提高. 修复管道,只改变分批量目标,基于溴化阻燃剂的聚合物都优于InfoNCE,而日志决定剂在两个基准上都达到最佳下游准确度。 随着批量的增加,其相对于InfoNCE的多样性优势会扩大. 代码见https://github.com/mobled37/DetNO。

articles.title: SCOPE: Semantic Bounded Credit Optimization for Prompt Engineering in Text-to-image Generation
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables language models to improve text-to-image (T2I) generation by rewriting prompts for a frozen image generator. Existing methods typically apply a single signal derived from the image to individual subword tokens, although objects, counts, attributes, and relations form coherent semantic spans. We propose SCOPE, an objective based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that aligns update weighting with this structure. The rewriter jointly generates an enhanced prompt and its semantic partition. SCOPE pools shifts in policy log probabilities within each span to derive a shared coefficient for its token losses while retaining a single advantage for each completion. It requires neither separate span rewards nor additional image renders. Across Qwen-Image, SD3, and FLUX.1-dev, SCOPE achieves average relative gains over vanilla GRPO of 9.48% on GeneVal and 7.62% on T2I-CompBench. Ablation studies show that both semantic boundaries and pooling within spans contribute to these gains, supporting semantic structure as a practical inductive bias for prompt engineering with RL.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SCOPE: 文字到图像生成中快速工程的语义学 BB 信用优化
articles.content_zh: 强化学习(RL)使语言模型能够通过重写被冻结的图像生成器的提示来改进文本到图像(T2I)生成. 现有方法通常将从图像得到的单一信号应用到单个子词符上,尽管对象,计数,属性,关系组成了连贯的语义跨度. 我们提出SCOPE,这是一个基于集团相对政策优化(GPRO)的目标,它使更新的权重与这一结构保持一致. 重写器联合生成一个增强的快取及其语义分区. SCOPE 集合在每个范围内政策日志概率的变化,以得出其象征性损失的共享系数,同时为每次完成保留单一优势。 它既不需要单独的跨度奖励,也不需要增加形象。 在Quen-Image、SD3和FLUX.1-dev中,SCOPE在GeneVal和T2I-Comp Bench上的平均相对增益分别为9.48%和7.62%。 语义研究显示,语义界限和跨度内的集合都有助于这些收益,支持语义结构作为用RL进行即时工程的一种实际的诱导偏差.

articles.title: FPG-Seg: Annotation-free Retinal Vessel Topology Segmentation
articles.content: State-of-the art approaches to retinal vessel segmentation typically require extensive annotations, a highly time-consuming process, reliant on clinical expertise. We present FPG-Seg, an annotation-free pipeline for retinal vessel segmentation combining classical vesselness filtering, Bayesian deep learning and topology-aware graph reconstruction to segment retinal vessel topology without manual labels. Tested across four widely used benchmark datasets for retinal vessel segmentation, FPG-Seg attains a clDice of $0.74{-}0.78$, representing $86{-}98\%$ of the performance of an equivalent fully-supervised baseline, despite using no manual annotations for training or hyperparameter tuning. As part of this work, we also provide, to our knowledge, the first performance benchmark of an annotation-free vessel segmentation method on FIVES.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FPG-Seg:无注释的视网膜船只地形分解
articles.content_zh: 视网膜分解的最新方法通常需要大量说明,这是一个非常耗时的过程,依赖于临床专业知识。 我们提出FPG-Seg,这是一条无注释的管道,用于视网膜船分化,结合了古典船分化,贝叶斯人深层学习和地貌学-认知图重建,以分解视网膜船分解,没有人工标签。 FPG-Seg通过四套广泛使用的基准数据集测试,用于视网膜分解,其ClDice为0.74{}0.78美元,相当于完全监督的等同基线绩效的86{}-}98美元,尽管没有使用人工说明进行训练或超参数调试。 作为这项工作的一部分,据我们所知,我们还提供了无注解船分解方法在FVES上的第一个业绩基准。

articles.title: Denoising Textures is a Different Ballgame Altogether!
articles.content: The human brain effortlessly deciphers colors and textures from visual stimuli and reconstructs the world around us, yet preserving such details remains challenging in image denoising. While significant progress has been made in generic image denoising, the problem of texture denoising has remained relatively under-explored. Fine details, such as intricate patterns and repetitive structures, often suffer from over-smoothing even in deep learning based approaches for denoising. In this paper, we analyze the behavior of state-of-the-art (SOTA) denoisers on texture datasets and show that performance improvements are possible only by fine-tuning the denoisers on the texture datasets. Surprisingly, fine-tuning on texture datasets result in the models catastrophically forgetting the original dataset. These findings highlight the need for specialized treatment of textures in denoising. Since denoising quality directly impacts downstream tasks such as generative modelling, we argue that dedicated texture aware denoisers are essential for faithful texture reconstruction and synthesis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 纹理是不同的游戏
articles.content_zh: 人类的大脑不懈地从视觉刺激中分辨出颜色和纹理,并重建了我们周围的世界,然而,保存这些细节在图像解密方面仍然具有挑战性。 虽然在通俗形象去名化方面取得了重大进展,但纹理去名化问题仍然相对没有得到充分探讨. 细微的细节,例如复杂的模式和重复的结构,往往过于舒缓,即使是在深层次的以学习为基础的消遣方法中也是如此。 在本文中,我们分析最先进的(SOTA)denoisers在纹理数据集上的行为,并显示只有微调了纹理数据集上的denoisers才能改进性能. 令人惊讶的是,对纹理数据集的微调导致模型灾难性地忘记了原始数据集. 这些调查结果突出表明,在去诺化时需要专门处理纹理. 由于去Noing质素直接影响到下游的任务,例如基因建模,所以我们主张,专用的纹理感知分泌器对于忠实的纹理重建和合成至关重要.

articles.title: MMSearch-OPD: Easy Made Hard, Hard Made Learnable for Long-Horizon Multimodal Search Agents
articles.content:
Multimodal deep search is moving from short queries to long-horizon investigations that continually acquire evidence. However, training such agents remains constrained by limited challenging training questions and insufficient process feedback.
  We introduce MMSearch-OPD, combining controllable data refinement with joint reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). Our Refine pipeline performs targeted expansion of reasoning chains derived from existing simple multimodal questions. Parameterized transformations control search depth and cross-modal evidence requirements while reusing existing image--question pairs. For training, answer rewards and lightweight behavior penalties guide RL, while the reward gap modulates token-level teacher guidance on imperfect student trajectories. An exponentially decaying distillation coefficient reduces teacher dependence as training proceeds.
  Experiments show gains from data refinement and further improvements from joint training after SFT, indicating stronger long-horizon multimodal deep search capabilities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: (原始内容存档于2017-10-21) (英语). MMSearch-OPD: Easy Made Hard, 长线多式搜索代理
articles.content_zh:
多式联运深度搜索正在从简短的查询转向持续获取证据的长期调查。 然而,培训这些工作人员仍然受到有限的挑战性培训问题和程序反馈不足的限制。
我们引入了MMSearch-OPD,将可控制数据的完善与联合强化学习(RL)和政策上分馏(OPD)相结合. 我们的完善管道有针对性地扩大现有简单多式联运问题的推理链。 参数化转换控制搜索深度和跨模式证据要求,同时再用已存在的图像-问题对. 对于培训,回答奖励和轻量级行为处罚指导RL,而奖励差距则会将象征级的老师指导用于不完善的学生轨迹. 随着培训的进行,指数式衰减的分馏系数降低了教师的依赖性。
实验显示,在SFT之后,数据改进和联合培训的进一步改进有所收获,表明长视多式深度搜索能力更强。

articles.title: OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents
articles.content: Real desktop automation is neither purely visual nor purely programmatic. Agents must understand user-facing interfaces while efficiently manipulating files, scripts, and system state. However, native GUI/code coordination cannot be obtained by prompt-level tool composition. In our preliminary experiments, naively adding a code tool degrades a GUI agent, revealing that GUI/code routing must be internalized through training on high-quality hybrid data. We present OS-Helix, an end-to-end trained multimodal computer-using agent that unifies GUI actions and code execution in one action space. To construct the required supervision, we introduce application-artifact composition, pairing desktop applications with authentic file artifacts to instantiate executable Ubuntu states, and a decoupled instruction/evaluator generation pipeline that produces environment-grounded tasks whose final states can be verified regardless of the solution modality. We cold-start the policy with SFT on filtered hybrid data and further improve it through online RL in live desktop environments. For RL, we propose Step-balanced GSPO, which aggregates importance weight by action step rather than raw assistant tokens to prevent long code actions from dominating heterogeneous-action optimization. On OSWorld-Verified, OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B achieve relative improvements of 35.0% and 33.7% over their matched Qwen3.5 hybrid baselines, while OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success. Ablations provide evidence consistent with contributions from learned GUI/code coordination, scalable verifiable supervision, and action step balanced optimization, while demonstrating cross-platform transfer on WindowsAgentArena. Our project homepage is at https://os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OS-Helix: 统一本地计算机用户界面交互和代码执行
articles.content_zh: 真正的桌面自动化既不纯粹是视觉的,也不是纯粹的程序性的. 代理必须了解用户界面,同时高效地操纵文件,脚本和系统状态. 然而,本地的GUI/代码协调无法通过即时级工具组成来获得. 在我们的初步实验中,天真地添加一个代码工具会降解一个GUI代理,揭示出GUI/代码的路由必须通过高质量的混合数据培训进行内化. 我们介绍OS-Helix,这是经过端到端训练的多式计算机使用代理,统一了GUI在一个行动空间中的动作和代码执行. 为了构建所需的监督,我们引入了应用艺术成分,将桌面应用程序与真实的文件文物配对,以即时化可执行的Ubuntu状态,以及解相接的指令/评估器生成管道,以产生基于环境的任务,其最终状态无论溶液模式如何都可以核实。 我们用SFT冷却地启动过滤后混合数据的政策,并通过在线RL在活的桌面环境中进一步改进. 就RL而言,我们提议采用分步平衡的普惠制,通过行动步骤而不是原始的辅助标志来汇总重要性,以防止较长的代码动作占据不同动作优化的主导地位。 在OSWorld-Verification上,OS-Helix-27B和OS-Helix-35B-A3B比相匹配的Quen3.5混合基线实现相对改善35.0%和33.7%,而OS-Helix-27B-RL则进一步提高了42.9%,达到了66.44%的成功率. 校正提供了与所学GUI/代码协调,可扩展可核查监督,以及动作步骤平衡优化等贡献相一致的证据,同时在WindowsAgentArena上演示了跨平台的传输. 我们的项目主页是https://os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix/。

articles.title: WaveLLM: Wavelet-Domain LLM Entropy Modeling for Lossless Image Compression
articles.content: Lossless image compression fundamentally relies on accurate entropy modeling, driving a recent shift toward large language model (LLM)-based methods. However, existing approaches mainly emphasize the modeling capacity of LLMs while directly serializing images into pixel or residual sequences, leaving heterogeneous signal patterns entangled within a single prediction stream. In this paper, we argue that effective entropy modeling depends not only on model capacity, but also on the predictability of the input representation. Motivated by this insight, we propose WaveLLM, a wavelet-domain LLM-based entropy model for lossless image compression. By decomposing an image into multi-level wavelet subbands, WaveLLM converts a heterogeneous prediction problem into a set of more structured and statistically homogeneous subproblems that are more amenable to autoregressive probability estimation. To bridge numerical coding symbols with the LLM's native text token space, we introduce a dedicated numerical interface featuring value embeddings and a coefficient prediction head. Furthermore, a task-adaptive prompting strategy is designed to enable a single shared model to adapt to diverse subbands within a unified framework. Built on Llama-3.2-3B with LoRA adaptation, WaveLLM achieves 2.51, 2.24, and 2.27 bpsp on Kodak, CLIC.pro, and DIV2K, respectively, outperforming the PixelCNN-based codec using the same wavelet transform by 0.43, 0.36, and 0.46 bpsp, and surpassing recent LLM-based lossless compressors on all three benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 波浪LLM:波浪-域LLM 无损失图像压缩的嵌入模型
articles.content_zh: 无损失图像压缩从根本上依赖于精确的 en模型,推动最近转向了以大语言模型(LLM)为基础的方法. 然而,现有方法主要强调LLMS的建模能力,同时将图像直接序列化为像素或剩余序列,使不同的信号模式被缠绕在一个单一的预测流中. 在本文中,我们主张,有效的py模型不仅取决于模型容量,而且取决于输入表示的可预测性. 基于这种洞察力,我们提出"WaveLLM",一种以"波"为主的以"波"域为主的以"LLM"为主的无损图像压缩的 en模型. 通过将一幅图像分解成多级波段子带,WaveLLM将一个多相异的预测问题转换为一组结构更合理,统计上更一致的子问题,更适合自回概率估计. 为了将数字编码符号与LLM的原生文字符号空间相接,我们引入了以数值嵌入和系数预测头为特色的专用数字界面. 此外,还设计出一项适应任务的激励战略,使单一共享模式能够在统一框架内适应不同的分带。 在Llama-3.2-3B上由LORA改型而来,WaveLLM在Kodak, CLIC.pro和DIV2K上分别实现2.51, 2.24和2.27 bpsp,使用同波变换的PixelCNN编码器在0.43,0.36和0.46 bpsp上表现优于最近基于LLM的无损失压缩器,在所有三个基准上都超过了.

articles.title: How Much Physics Can Vision Learn from Audio? Probing and Distilling Damping Structure
articles.content: Physical understanding is crucial for decision making, yet vision models struggle to infer properties such as damping that govern how materials behave. Audio encodes such properties directly, because an object's acoustic response to impact reveals its damping through measurable decay. We probe frozen encoders for the quality factor $Q$, a dimensionless measure of how many oscillations an object completes before its ring dies away, and report how well each embedding orders impacts by $Q$ using the Spearman rank correlation $ρ$, for which $ρ=1$ is a perfect ordering and $ρ=0$ an unrelated one. Audio embeddings reach $ρ=0.73$ and retain most of that advantage on materials withheld from training, while a single video frame taken at the moment of impact, encoded by CLIP, supports only $ρ=0.28$. Having established where the signal lives, we ask how much of that gap vision can recover. We distill a frozen audio teacher into a frozen CLIP backbone through a trained projection head and find that this recovers a useful fraction of the audio advantage. Because pooled correlations on this task are dominated in practice by category identity, we also evaluate under a leave-one-material-out protocol in which the held-out material is withheld from the projection head as well as the probe. Distillation with a four-frame input improves the correlation there from 0.234 to 0.338 (+0.053 over the matched four-frame baseline, 14 of 17 materials), a gain that no category-level strategy can produce. Widening the visual input to four frames spanning the impact supplies half of that improvement at no acoustic cost, which indicates that part of what a single frame misses is visible dynamics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视觉能从音频学到多少? 探测和沉积坝结构
articles.content_zh: 物理理解对决策至关重要,但视觉模型却难以推断出诸如规范材料行为方式的筑坝等属性。 音频直接编码这些属性,因为一个物体对撞击的声学反应揭示出它通过可测量的衰变而起锚. 我们调查了质量因子$Q$的被冻结编码器,这是衡量一个物体在环被关闭之前完成多少振荡的无维度尺度,并报告每个嵌入命令使用Spearman的分级关系$&$受到多大程度的冲击,对于这个关系,$&$$是一个完美的订单,而$&$是一个无关的订单. 音频嵌入达到0.73美元,保留了培训材料的大部分优势,而由CLIP编码的撞击时拍摄的单一视频帧仅支持0.28美元。 在确定了信号所在位置之后,我们询问这一差距的愿景中有多少可以恢复。 我们通过一个训练有素的投影头 将一个被冷冻的音频老师 提炼成一个被冷冻的CLIP骨干 发现这能恢复音频优势的一小部分 由于与这项任务的集合关联在实践中以类别身份为主,因此我们还根据一项 " 一分即出 " 的协议进行评估,在该协议中,搁置的材料从投影头和探测器中被扣下。 采用四边框输入的分馏可改善其中的关联性,从0.234到0.338(比对应的四边框基线多出0.053分,即17个材料中的14分),这一收益是没有任何类别级战略能够产生的。 将视觉输入拓宽到横跨撞击的四帧,可以提供一半的这种改进而无需声学成本,这表明一个帧漏掉的部分是可见动态.

articles.title: Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation for Unified Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) can elicit specialized visual capabilities in vision-language models (VLMs), yet jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives often introduces cross-capability gradient conflicts. Training experts independently mitigates this interference, but direct reward optimization may entangle specialized knowledge with reward-hacking biases. This paper proposes Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation (SCOPED), which trains capability-specific experts and extracts explicit skills through reward-guided reflection. During on-policy distillation, these skills guide expert supervision while remaining unavailable to the unified student, encouraging it to internalize procedural knowledge without explicit skills at inference time. Across eight multimodal benchmarks, SCOPED consistently outperforms the backbone and mixed-capability RL, demonstrating the effectiveness of skill-decoupled on-policy expert distillation for integrating independently acquired capabilities. Further analyses reveal interference during joint capability optimization and suggest that skill augmentation promotes more consistent expert trajectories, greater attention to task-relevant visual evidence, and better preservation of specialized expertise in the unified student. All code and data are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/SCOPED.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 单一愿景-语言模式的熟练-十进制政策专家
articles.content_zh: 强化学习(RL)可以在视觉语言模型(VLMs)中吸引专门的视觉能力,但共同优化各种目标往往引入跨能力梯度冲突。 培训专家可以独立地减轻这种干扰,但直接奖励的优化可能会将专门知识缠住,造成奖励的偏见。 本文提出技能减员政策专家消化(SCOPED),通过奖励指导的思考,培训具体能力专家并提取明确的技能。 在政策提炼期间,这些技能指导专家监督,而统一学生却得不到这些技能,鼓励他们将程序知识内部化,在推断时没有明确的技能。 在整个8个多式联运基准中,SCOPED的业绩始终高于骨干和混合能力RL,表明与技能脱节的政策专家提炼集成独立获得的能力是有效的。 进一步的分析揭示出联合能力优化过程中的干扰,并暗示技能增强能促进更一致的专家轨迹,更注意与任务相关的视觉证据,并更好地保存统一学生的专业知识. 所有代码和数据可查阅https://github.com/NEUIR/SCOPED。

articles.title: FutureLift: Lifting Trajectory Proposals into Bidirectional Future Graphs for Motion Forecasting
articles.content: Accurate motion prediction is critical for safe autonomous driving, yet even strong forecasters leave residual errors in their multimodal proposals. Existing refiners compress complete proposals or update their segments sequentially, preventing the full proposed future from serving as explicit relational context for correction. We introduce FutureLift, a backbone-agnostic refiner that represents each multimodal proposal as a heterogeneous future graph, with spatially grounded temporal nodes connected to agent histories, map elements, alternative modes, and, for joint prediction, other agents future trajectories. Bidirectional temporal edges allow later evidence to revise earlier segments in a single pass, and the updated nodes predict residual coordinate and confidence corrections. Requiring only proposals, scores, and scene context, FutureLift provides a common refinement interface for structurally different forecasting backbones. On Argoverse2 and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, it consistently improves frozen proposals and outperforms native and specialized refiners across marginal and joint forecasting. On the WOMD motion-prediction leaderboard, FutureLift ranks first in minADE (0.5049m) and minFDE (0.9942m) among the compared standard-input methods, without LiDAR or ensembling, while achieving a competitive 0.4874 Soft mAP.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FutureLift:将轨迹建议提升到双向未来图中用于运动预测
articles.content_zh: 准确的运动预测对安全自主驾驶至关重要,但即使是强势预报员在其多式联运提案中也留下了剩余错误. 现有的精炼厂按顺序压缩完整的提案或更新其部分,防止整个拟议的未来成为明确的纠正关系。 我们介绍了FutureLift, 这是一种骨干不可知的精炼剂,它代表了每一种多式提案,是一种千差万别的未来图,其空间基时间节点与代理历史、地图要素、替代模式以及用于联合预测的其他代理未来轨迹相连。 双向时间边让后期证据在一次通过中修改了更早的段,更新后节点预测了剩余坐标和信心校正. 仅需要建议书,分数,和场景背景,FutureLift为结构上不同的预测主干线提供了一个共同的完善界面. 在Argoverse2和Waymo Open Motion Datas集上,它不断改进被冻结的建议书,并且超越了本地和专门精炼器,跨越边缘和联合预测. 在WOMD运动预测导板上,FutureLift在比照标准输入法中位居minADE(0.5049m)和minFDE(0.9942m)前列,没有LiDAR或综艺,同时实现了有竞争力的0.4874 Soft mAP.

articles.title: TRACE: Topology-Aware Reconnection via Prediction-Adaptive Connectivity Enforcement for Thin-Structure Segmentation
articles.content: Thin, elongated structures are particularly sensitive to connectivity errors, as even a few local segmentation mistakes can disrupt otherwise continuous paths. Existing skeleton-based objectives typically supervise fixed centerline locations and do not account for alternative local routes that may restore connectivity. We propose TRACE, a topology-aware, prediction-adaptive objective that uses a target skeleton to define required local connections. For each connection, TRACE identifies the easiest valid reconnection under the current prediction and jointly supervises its bottleneck with the corresponding skeleton point. The supervision thus adapts to the evolving prediction rather than remaining fixed to the centerline. We further introduce a topology-aware skeleton carrier that preserves both foreground and class-specific topology, enabling reliable definition of these connections. Extensive experiments across six 2D and 3D benchmarks show that TRACE improves connectivity and topology while maintaining strong segmentation accuracy with low training overhead. Code will be released upon acceptance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TRACE: 地形学- 智能通过预测- 辅助连接执行重联, 用于稀疏分解
articles.content_zh: 细长的结构对连通性错误特别敏感,因为即使是少数局部分解错误也会打乱否则会连续的路径. 现有基于骨架的目标通常监督固定中线位置,不考虑可能恢复连通性的其他当地路线。 我们提出TRACE,一个具有地貌意识,预测适应性的目标,它使用目标骨架来定义所需的局部连接. 对于每次连接,TRACE都会根据当前预测确定最简单的有效再连接,并用相应的骨干点共同监督其瓶颈. 因此,监督能够适应不断变化的预测,而不是固定在中线上。 我们进一步引入了一种具有地貌意识的骨架载体,既保留了前地地地貌,又保留了阶级特有地貌,从而能够对这些连接进行可靠的定义. 对6个二维和三维基准的广泛实验表明,TRACE改进了连通性和地貌,同时保持了很强的分化精度并降低了培训间接费用. 守则一经接受就会公布。

articles.title: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
articles.content: Computer use has reached a turning point: the focus is expanding from GUI-only interaction to systems that complete tasks on users' computers through visual and programmatic interfaces. We define a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA) as a system in which the model chooses how to observe, act, and organize its work across visual and programmatic interfaces. Yet frontier implementations, such as GPT-6 Astra's computer-use system, remain largely closed, limiting systematic study of their design. We introduce Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA), an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for GCUAs with the community. This report presents the first release of OpenGCUA. Code execution is a key feature of our agent design: it lets intermediate results determine subsequent operations and enables models to apply their existing programming capabilities directly to computer interaction. We also propose harness-to-model decision transfer, moving selected observations and task-state decisions from fixed harness rules to the model. On OSWorld-v2, our full configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5, raising mean partial score by +19.6 points and reducing reported steps per task by an average of 53.0% relative to batched GUI-only execution. We release our implementation and prompts, evaluation trajectories from all eight models, and preliminary versions of a real-device harness and a cross-device SDK. The harness addresses real-device challenges not fully captured by benchmarks, while the SDK provides a common programming interface across computers, mobiles and browsers. Across four real macOS tasks under our real-device harness, selected Qwen3.8-Max runs use 19.4 times as many reported reasoning tokens as GPT-6 Astra, highlighting substantial differences between models in real-device execution efficiency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OpenGCUA: 迈向一个供通用计算机使用的完全开放堆栈
articles.content_zh: 计算机的使用已经到了一个转折点:焦点正在从仅由GUI交互扩展到通过视觉和程序接口完成用户计算机任务的系统. 我们把通用计算机使用剂(GCUA)定义为一种系统,模型在其中选择如何在视觉与程序界面上观察,行动,和组织其工作. 然而,前沿实施,例如GPT-6 Astra的计算机使用系统,基本上仍然关闭,限制了对其设计的系统研究。 我们提出开放通用的CUA(OpenGCUA),这是一个正在进行的项目,旨在开发并开放面向社区的全球CUA的全堆. 本报告介绍"OpenGCUA"首发. 代码执行是我们代理设计的一个关键特征:它让中间结果决定后续的操作,并让模型直接将现有的编程能力应用于计算机交互. 我们还建议从利用到模式的决策转移,将选定的观察和任务状态的决定从固定利用规则转移到模式。 在OSWorld-v2上,我们的全面配置提高了包括GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5在内的所有8个评价模型的任务分数,将平均分数提高为+19.6分,并将每个任务的报告步骤比批量的GUI只执行平均减少53.0%. 我们发布了我们的执行和提示, 评估轨迹 从所有8个模型, 和初步版本的 真实的装置和交叉的装置SDK。 该套接字处理的是没有被基准完全捕捉到的真设备挑战,而SDK则提供了一个跨计算机,移动和浏览器的通用编程接口. 通过我们真实设备的4个真正的macOS任务,所选择的Quen3.8-Max运行使用比GPT-6 Astra报告的推理符数多出19.4倍,凸显出在真实设备执行效率方面模型的巨大差异.

articles.title: EVA-Cap: Optimizing Audiovisual Video Captioning via Event-Centric Alignment
articles.content: Recent advances in Omni Language Models (OLMs) provide a unified solution for audiovisual video captioning. Nevertheless, existing approaches predominantly treat captioning as an unstructured text generation process, neglecting the inherent semantic structure of videos and leading to suboptimal fine-grained audiovisual alignment. To bridge this gap, we propose EVA-Cap, a novel framework that decomposes captions into atomic audiovisual events and transforms unstructured text supervision into event-centric alignment. We train EVA-Cap via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on a self-curated dataset, EVA-Data, which is built with event-centric quality control. During the GRPO phase, the model is explicitly optimized against three event-centric alignment targets: global event completeness, intra-event attribution, and inter-event synchronization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EVA-Cap significantly outperforms existing methods in event-centric evaluation (e.g., +9.0% average gain on ChronusAV), while achieving competitive performance on general audiovisual captioning benchmarks (e.g., +3.3% on WorldSense).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EVA-Cap:通过事件-对齐优化视听视频字幕
articles.content_zh: 近期在Omni语言模型(OLM)方面的进展为视听视频字幕提供了统一解决方案. 然而,现有办法主要将标题视为一种结构不合理的文本生成过程,忽视了视频固有的语义结构,导致优劣的精细音频对接。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议EVA-Cap,这是一个将标题分解为原子视听事件并把无结构文本监督转变为以事件为中心的对齐的新框架。 我们通过监督精选(SFT)和集团相对政策优化(GRPO)在自定义的数据集EVA-Data上进行EVA-Cap培训,该数据集以事件为中心进行质量控制. 在GRPO阶段,该模式根据三个以事件为中心的对接目标被明确优化:全球事件完整性,事件内部归属,以及事件间同步. 广泛的实验表明,EVA-Cap在以事件为中心的评价方面大大超过现有方法(例如,ChronusAV的平均增益为9.0%),同时在一般视听字幕基准方面(例如,WorldSense为+3.3%)取得了竞争力。

articles.title: LAMP: Layerwise Adaptive Mixing of Predictors for Training-Free Few-Shot Vision-Language Adaptation
articles.content: Few-shot adaptation often relies on an encoder's final global representation, leaving complementary information in intermediate layers underused. Combining these features is challenging because their dimensions can differ and their usefulness varies across tasks. We propose LAMP, Layerwise Adaptive Mixing of Predictors, a training-free framework that combines global and regional information from multiple encoder layers. A single forward pass per view supplies all descriptors. Global and support-calibrated regional kernel predictors independently fit the same label residuals. Labeled validation data select their mixture in class-score space, preserving native feature dimensions without learned projections. LAMP-F further adapts text-anchored class prototypes, using a cached response to update the fixed-kernel residual predictions exactly. Experiments cover eleven datasets and ViT and ResNet backbones. LAMP achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracy among the compared published training-free ResNet-50 methods at 4, 8, and 16 shots, reaching 78.73% at 16 shots. Averaged across five support budgets, LAMP improves over a paired global-feature-only baseline by 1.14 and 1.59 percentage points on ViT-B/16 and ResNet-50; LAMP-F raises these gains to 1.96 and 2.54 points. LAMP-F reaches 16-shot accuracies of 83.57% and 79.10%, respectively. Controlled experiments identify multi-layer integration as the main source of improvement and examine pooling, calibration, validation labels, and computational cost. These findings show that combining layer-specific predictions can exploit complementary features from frozen encoders to improve few-shot classification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LAMP: 无培训预测器的图层适应性混合
articles.content_zh: 很少镜头的改编往往依赖于编码器的最终全球代表,使中间层的补充信息没有得到充分利用. 综合这些特征具有挑战性,因为其层面可能不同,其用途因任务而异。 我们提议采用LAMP,“对预测器进行图层适应性混合”,这是一种无培训框架,将来自多层编码器的全球和区域信息结合起来。 每道取景都有一个前传,提供所有描述符。 全球与支持校正区域内核预测器独立地匹配同名标签残基. 标签验证数据在分级空间中选择它们的混合物,在没有学到的预测的情况下保留了本地地物维度. LAMP-F进一步调整了文本焦虑类原型,使用缓存响应来精确更新固定内核剩余预测. 实验涵盖11个数据集和ViT和ResNet主干. LAMP在比较公布的无训练ResNet-50方法中,以4,8和16发的成绩达到最先进的平均准确度,以16发的成绩达到78.73%. 平均在5个支助预算中,LAMP在VIT-B/16和ResNet-50上将单对全球地物基线提高1.14和1.59个百分点;LAMP-F将这些收益提高到1.96和2.54个百分点。 LAMP-F的射速分别达到83.57%和79.10%. 受控实验确定多层次整合为改进的主要来源并检查集合,校准,验证标签和计算成本. 这些发现表明,结合地层特异性预测可以从被冻结的编码器中利用互补特征来改进几发分级.

articles.title: REKI: Registering Knowledge in VLAs
articles.content: We introduce REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model (VLA) pretrained exclusively on public data that sets a new Pareto frontier between performance and model size: on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin Clean2Rand and RoboCasa365, it is outperformed only by models about twice its size. REKI consists of a vision-language model (VLM) followed by a flow-matching action expert, and is pretrained on a curated mixture of public robot, egocentric human and vision-language data. Additionally, we endow it with a memory that gives the policy access to its recent past at negligible cost: a few register tokens in the action expert summarise the output of the VLM at each frame and persist in the expert's cache. This memory improves success in simulation and on real robots, and makes oscillations between poses about four times rarer. REKI uses a simple model design and training paradigm, and is optimised to be efficient at training and inference. We release the full code across data curation, training, inference and evaluation, deployment, and all pretrained and finetuned model weights: https://github.com/kyutai-labs/reki.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: REKI: 在VLA注册知识
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了REKI,一种2.4B的视觉语言动作模型(VLA)在公共数据上预作训练,设定了新的Pareto在性能和模型大小之间的边框:在LIBERO-Plus,RoboTwin Clean2Rand和RoboCasa365上,其性能仅被大约两倍于其大小的模型所超越. REKI由一个视觉语言模型(VLM)组成,后由流相相动作专家组成,并被预训于由公共机器人,以自负为中心的人和视觉语言数据等被曲相混合而成. 此外,我们赋予它一种记忆,使政策能够以可忽略不计的代价了解其最近的历史:行动专家中的几个登记标志概括了每个框架的VLM产出,并一直停留在专家的缓存中。 这种内存提高了模拟和在真机器人上的成功度,使姿势之间的振荡度大约是罕见的四倍. REKI使用简单的模型设计和培训范式,并被优化为在培训和推论上高效. 我们公布完整的代码,包括数据整理、培训、推论和评价、部署,以及所有经过预先训练和微调的模型权重:https://github.com/kyutai-labs/reki。

articles.title: Motion- and Gravity-Aware Feedforward 3D Reconstruction
articles.content:
Feed-forward transformer models have recently achieved strong performance in multi-view 3D reconstruction, but they still rely primarily on appearance-based attention and often struggle in dynamic scenes with weak geometric cues. In this work, we introduce a motion- and gravity-aware framework under the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm. During training, residual optical flow and gravity direction are provided as privileged signals to guide geometric representation learning; during inference, the model uses standard visual inputs only.
  We integrate these priors into transformer backbones with lightweight architectural changes, preserving feed-forward efficiency. Experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenes with dynamic objects, ambiguous structure, and challenging camera motion. Our analysis further shows that the optimal injection stage is backbone-dependent: middle-layer integration is generally preferable for VGGT, while late-stage integration is more effective for π3. These results suggest that LUPI offers a practical way to inject motion and physical priors into feed-forward 3D reconstruction without increasing test-time complexity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 移动和重力- 软件 FeedForward 3D 重建
articles.content_zh:
Feed-forward变压器模型在多视三维重建中最近取得了很强的性能,但它们仍然主要依赖外观上的注意,并经常以微弱的几何提示在动态场景中挣扎. 在这项工作中,我们在 " 利用保密信息学习 " 范式下引入了运动和重力意识框架。 在训练期间,提供剩余光学流和重力方向作为特权信号来指导几何表达学习;在推论期间,模型只使用标准视觉输入.
我们把这些前科整合到 具有轻量级建筑变化的变压器骨干中, 保持了进取效率。 关于标准基准的实验显示,在重建的准确性和稳健性方面,特别是在具有动态物体、模糊结构以及具有挑战性的相机运动的场景方面,不断提高。 我们的分析进一步表明,最佳注射阶段依赖骨干:对于VGGT来说,中层集成一般比较可取,而后期集成则比较有效. 这些结果表明,LUPI提供了一个实用的方法,在不增加试验时间复杂性的情况下,将运动和物理前科注入向导3D重建.

articles.title: FALCON: FPGA-Accelerated Latency-Certifiable Occupancy Networks for Camera-Based Autonomous Driving
articles.content: A perception system that must brake for a pedestrian does not need a low average latency. It must deliver an answer before the deadline on every frame, the worst case included. Commodity edge accelerators optimize the mean through dynamic scheduling, OS jitter, thermal throttling, and contention, so their per-frame latency can be measured but not bounded. We build FALCON, a camera-based 3D occupancy front-end on the AMD Kria KR260, an embedded FPGA drawing 4.3 W idle and up to 6.6 W under inference, and make the latency guarantee layered and explicit: programmable-logic (PL) compute is cycle-bounded analytically; inference is a measured envelope over 100k-frame traces; and a watchdog enforces output delivery, publishing the previous output flagged stale when a frame is late. The deadline runs use a fixed-work proxy of six ResNet-50 DPU inferences per frame, not the full occupancy network: across three 100k-frame enforced runs, all 300k proxy frames delivered an output within the 100 ms deadline plus at most 10.2 ms, the worst of the three runs. The full six-camera FlashOcc pipeline composes to about 1.3 s per frame on the board and is not yet a 10 Hz system. The two operations the DPU cannot run, a view-transform gather and a bilinear resize, become fixed-trip-count PL IPs numerically matched to their software references. On the full Occ3D-nuScenes validation set the board reaches mIoU 29.88, 92.8% of an FP32 baseline the DPU cannot run. On a ResNet-50 probe over 100k frames the KR260 tail stays within 1.5 times its median (2.0 times for the six-inference proxy), where Jetson Orin reaches 4.4 times and the worst datacenter GPU run (NVIDIA L4) 23.6 times. The deployment recipe, HLS sources, and raw timing traces are released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FALCON:用于相机自动驾驶的FPGA加速式Latency-Certifical使用网络
articles.content_zh: 必须对行人进行刹车的感知系统不需要低等平均延迟. 它必须在每个框架的最后期限之前做出答复,最坏的情况就是如此。 商品边缘加速器通过动态调度,OS快活,热减速,和相争来优化中间值,因此它们的每帧空闲度可以测量而不受限制. 我们在AMD Kria KR260上建造了以相机为基础的3D占用前端FALCON,一个嵌入式FPGA画出4.3 W闲置并最多为6.6 W的推想,并且使潜伏性保证分层并明确:可编程-logic(PL)计算是循环式的;推想是100k-帧痕迹以上的被测量到的信封;一个监督者强制输出,当帧后发布前一个输出被标记为分层. 最后期限运行使用每帧6个ResNet-50 DPU推论的固定工作代理,而不是全占用网络:跨越3个100k帧被强制运行,所有300k的代理帧在100ms最后期限内输出出一个输出,并最多10.2ms,是3个运行中最糟糕的. 完整的六相机FlashOcc管道由板上每帧约1.3 s组成,还不是10 Hz系统. DPU无法运行的两种操作,一个是视图转换集合和双线性调整大小,成为固定的-trip-count PL IP在数字上与其软件引用相匹配. 在Occ3D-nuScenes的全部验证中,该板会达到mIoU 29.88,是DPU无法运行的FP32基线的92.8%. 在超过100k帧的ResNet-50探测器上,KR260尾巴停留在它的中位数的1.5倍以内(六推论代用号为2.0倍),Jetson Orin达到4.4倍,最差的数据中心GPU运行(NVIDIA L4)23.6倍. 发布部署食谱,HLS源和原始计时痕迹.

articles.title: SCCL-DT: Semantic-Conflict-Aware Contrastive Learning with Dual-Rule Teacher Distillation for Zero-Shot Chest X-Ray Diagnosis
articles.content: Contrastive vision-language pre-training supports zero-shot chest X-ray diagnosis, but standard objectives treat every off-diagonal image-report pair in a batch as a negative. In radiology, recurring findings across patients mean that instance mismatch need not imply semantic incompatibility, creating false-negative supervision that we term a semantic conflict. A training-trace audit shows that pair-observations selected by the online mask used during training are enriched for report-derived finding agreement, although this proxy analysis does not establish clinical equivalence. Fixed thresholds can become miscalibrated as similarity distributions evolve, while soft reweighting leaves residual repulsive gradients. We therefore propose Semantic-Conflict-Aware Contrastive Learning (SCCL), which tracks modality-specific similarity distributions with exponential-moving-average (EMA) statistics, derives adaptive thresholds, and hard-masks flagged candidates before softmax normalization. Inclusive (OR) and consensus (AND) rules define two SCCL teachers, whose bidirectional cross-modal rankings are consolidated through standard distillation into a single deployable student, SCCL-DT. Across five public chest X-ray benchmarks, SCCL-DT achieves a mean zero-shot AUC of $0.850$, compared with $0.837$ for the strongest evaluated baseline in our comparison. Code will be made publicly available soon.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SCCL-DT: 语义-冲突- 意识- 与双规则教师相矛盾的学习
articles.content_zh: 相矛盾的视觉-语言预训支持零发胸X射线诊断,但标准目标将分批分批的每对外相图像-报告配对视为负数. 在放射学中,患者间反复出现的结果意味着病例的不匹配并不一定意味着语义不相容,从而造成假阴性监督,我们称之为语义冲突. 一项培训跟踪审计显示,培训期间使用的在线口罩所选取的对等观测结果被丰富成报告生成的查找协议,尽管这一代理分析并不确立临床等同性. 固定阈值会随着相似性分布的演化而变得有误判性,而柔性再加权则会留下残余的反冲梯度. 因此,我们提出语义-冲突-意识相冲突学习(SCCL),该学习将跟踪特定模式的相似性分布和指数-指数-平均(EMA)统计数据,得出适应性阈值,硬面团标出候选人后再进行软面正常化。 包容性(OR)和共识(AND)规则定义了两位SCCL教师,他们的双向跨模式排名通过标准分解被整合为单一可部署学生SCCL-DT. 在5个公共胸口X光基准中,SCL-DT的中度零射出AUC为0.850美元,而相比之下,最强的评价基线为0.837美元。 守则将很快公布。

articles.title: Beyond the Dominant Label: Recovering Coexisting Lesion Evidence with Multiple Instance Learning
articles.content: Whole-slide images may contain coexisting lesions, yet weak supervision typically provides only the most severe diagnosis. We formulate this setting as dominant-label multiple instance learning, where the observed label is the maximum-severity element of a latent lesion set. Standard multiclass MIL treats it as a complete one-hot description and therefore suppresses lower-severity evidence whenever it co-occurs with a dominant lesion. We propose DomSet-MIL, a label-aware framework that aligns the annotation mechanism across bag and instance levels. Dominant-Label Censored Likelihood models the reported diagnosis without declaring unreported lesions absent. Severity-Ordered Residual Routing assigns patch evidence from high to low severity and preserves residual support for secondary findings, while top-$q$ pooling links local routing scores to bag prediction. Experiments across natural and controlled settings show that DomSet-MIL achieves state-of-the-art performance in dominant-label prediction while more effectively recovering latent coexisting-lesion evidence. These findings demonstrate that modeling the dominant-label mechanism can improve diagnostic prediction without sacrificing clinically meaningful secondary findings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond the Digminant Label:通过多种案例学习来恢复共同存在的Lesion证据
articles.content_zh: 整个滑坡图像可能含有并存的损伤,但监督不力通常只能提供最严重的诊断。 我们将此设定为主要标签的多实例学习,其中所观察到的标签是潜在损害集的最高强度要素。 标准多级MIL将它视为一个完整的一热描述,因此,每当它与主要损伤共同发生时,都会压制低等证据. 我们提出DomSet-MIL,这是一个具有标签意识的框架,它协调了包和例之间的注释机制。 上报的诊断结果, Severity-Ordered Dreamers Routing将补丁证据从高度到低度分配,并保留了对二级结论的剩余支持,而上-美元集合则将本地的路由分数链接到包预测. 跨越自然和受控制环境的实验表明,DomSet-MIL在主要标签预测中实现了最先进的性能,同时更有效地恢复潜在的并存效应证据。 这些研究结果表明,对主导-标签机制的模型可以改进诊断预测,而不会牺牲临床上有意义的二级发现。

articles.title: Pathology foundation models for training-free case retrieval in salivary gland tumors
articles.content: In pathology, pattern recognition relies on a frame of reference built through extensive training and experience, which may still fall short when encountering rare cancer subtypes. Archives of previously diagnosed tumors often contain relevant precedents, yet identifying the most relevant cases remains challenging. Here we explore whether content-based retrieval with current pathology foundation models facilitates rare cancer diagnostics without any task-specific training. Pathologists can query a digitized archive using a region of interest (ROI) from a whole slide image (WSI) and retrieve morphologically similar cases, along with their ICD-O codes and corresponding WSIs. The ROI can be selected manually or automatically using a gated attention-based multiple instance learning model. We evaluate our approach by leave-one-case-out on an imbalanced dataset of 137 salivary gland tumor cases spanning 12 ICD-O morphology categories, comparing four pathology foundation models (Atlas2, Atlas2-B, Atlas2-S, and UNI2h). Top-1/3/5 retrieval was 62.5%/76.7%/81.3% for Atlas2, 50.2/66.6/72.9% for UNI2h, 52.3%/71.5%/77.6% for Atlas2-B and 54.4/65.2/73.7% for Atlas2-S. Macro-averaged F1 ranged from 69.0% for the smallest model Atlas2-S to 76.6% for the largest model Atlas2 across the five classes with at least ten cases. Our modified Chamfer similarity separated correct from incorrect matches among the Top-5 more reliably for Atlas2 (AUC 0.754) than for Atlas2-B (0.679, p = 0.020) and Atlas2-S (0.653, p = 0.003), but not UNI2h (0.697, p = 0.196). Requiring no additional training or manual annotation, this approach makes departmental archives searchable with pathology foundation models, providing a low-barrier route to case-based differential diagnosis and extending the individual frame of reference to the collective experience of the department.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 唾液腺瘤无培训病例检索的病理学基础模型
articles.content_zh: 在病理学中,模式识别依赖于通过广泛的培训和经验所构建的参照基准,在遇到罕见的癌症亚型时,这个参照基准可能仍然不足. 先前诊断出肿瘤的档案往往包含相关的先例,但确定最相关的病例仍然具有挑战性. 在这里,我们探索,基于内容的检索与目前的病理基础模型是否促进罕见癌症诊断,而无需接受任何特定任务的培训. 病理学家可以使用一个感兴趣的区域(ROI)从整个幻灯片图像(WSI)中查询一个数字化的档案,并检索形态上相近的病例,连同他们的ICD-O代码和相应的WSI. ROI可以手动选择,也可以自动使用基于门的注意的多例学习模式. 我们通过对137个唾液腺瘤病例的不平衡数据集进行一例休整来评估我们的方法,这些病例跨越12个ICD-O形态类别,比较了四个病理基础模型(Atlas2、Atlas2-B、Atlas2-S和UNI2h)。 Atlas2、UNI2h的检索率为62.5%/76.7%/81.3%,Atlas2-B的检索率为52.3%/77.6%,Atlas2-S的检索率为54.4/65.2/73.7%。 宏观平均F1从最小的Atlas2-S型模型的69.0%到最大的Atlas2型模型的76.6%不等。 我们经过修改的Chamfer相似性与图集2 (AUC 0.754)和图集2 S (0.653,p = 0.03)的Top-5之间的不正确匹配性相去甚远,但UNI2h (0.697,p = 0.196)并非如此。 无需额外培训或人工说明,这一办法使部门档案可以使用病理基础模型进行搜索,为基于病例的差别诊断提供低阻道,并将个别参考框架扩大到部门的集体经验。

articles.title: Retrofitting Recurrent Vision-Language Models from Pretrained Backbones
articles.content: Recent work shows that depth recurrence can be retrofitted into pretrained language models. In this work, we adapt this paradigm for visual understanding, using depth recurrence to reduce the parameter footprint of a pretrained vision-language model (VLM). To this end, we prune layers from the language backbone of the VLM and loop over a subset of the remaining layers. At each step of the loop, a linear adapter merges the block's output with the token representations from the preceding layers and projects the fused representation back into the block. As the pruning impacts the original model performance, we propose a three-stage recovery training: first, we leverage a language-only pretraining to recover the performance of the language backbone, followed by an alignment of the vision-language projector, and a full fine-tuning of the model via visual instruction tuning. In the first and the last stage, we distill the outputs of the pretrained non-recurrent model into the recurrent model, which further improves the recovery. We evaluate the proposed approach on the TinyLLaVA-1.4B backbone without introducing any new vision-language data during retrofitting. Our experiments demonstrate that the retrofitted recurrent model outperforms the unpruned baseline trained with the same recovery data while storing 23.3% fewer language parameters. We further show that the proposed retrofitting recurrence outperforms the setup of converting a recurrent LM into a VLM on the same data. Additionally, our ablations show how design choices, such as the adapter between recurrences and a larger recurrent block, lead to the improved performance of our approach. Finally, we find that our proposed model gains on reasoning-oriented benchmarks, whereas its performance on basic visual understanding benchmarks remains on par with the baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从预训后骨重现的经常性视觉语言模型
articles.content_zh: 最近的工作表明,深度再现可以被改造为被预先训练的语言模型. 在这部作品中,我们为视觉理解改造了这个范式,利用深度重现来减少被预先训练的视觉语言模型(VLM)的参数足迹. 为此,我们从 VLM 的语言主干线上 分层循环到其余的分层上。 在循环的每一步,一个线性适配器会将块的输出与前几层的符号表示相合并,并预测被熔接的表示返回块. 随着穿梭会影响原型的性能,我们提议进行三阶段恢复训练:一是利用只用语言的预训来恢复语言主干线的性能,再由视觉语言投影仪对接,再通过视觉教学调音对模型进行全面微调. 在第一阶段和最后阶段,我们把经过预先训练的非经常模式的产出提炼成经常模式,这进一步改善了恢复。 我们评价关于TinyLLAVA-1.4B主干线的拟议办法,在改造过程中不引入任何新的视觉语言数据。 我们的实验表明,经过改造的经常性模型在使用同样的恢复数据培训的未刷入基线的基础上,超过了业绩,同时储存了23.3%的语言参数。 我们进一步表明,拟议中的再生改造超过了在同一数据上将经常性LM转换为VLM的设置. 此外,我们的模拟显示,设计选择,例如复发和较大的再生区块之间的适应器,如何导致我们方法的绩效得到改进。 最后,我们发现,我们提议的模型在以推理为导向的基准方面有所进展,而它在基本视觉理解基准方面的表现仍然与基线相同。

articles.title: Memory as Weights: Internalizing Long-Term History for Streaming Videos
articles.content: Streaming vision-language models (VLMs) must continuously integrate information from the past while remaining responsive to current observations and user queries. Existing memory mechanisms typically compress, retrieve, or cache historical observations and reintroduce them into the input context, forcing historical memory and current observations to compete for limited context. We propose MaLoW, a streaming memory framework that instead internalizes historical context into evolving lightweight parameter updates. MaLoW uses a recurrent HyperNetwork to incrementally consolidate incoming video observations into fixed-size LoRA weights, allowing historical information to be carried forward without revisiting the full video stream. In doing so, MaLoW represents history as weights, while keeping the current observation as input. To support training, we further construct MaLoW-Instruct, a large-scale streaming video dataset containing 381K question-answer pairs over 56K videos. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate that MaLoW achieves strong performance on OVO-Bench, StreamingBench, and StreamArena. On the backward split of OVO-Bench, MaLoW outperforms prior memory approaches by 3.9% to 11.8% across different video backbones while incurring only modest latency overhead. Beyond streaming video understanding, MaLoW also generalizes to vision-language-action models, improving the action success rate on Simpler WidowX by 9.3%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 作为重量的记忆:将长期历史内部化,用于流放视频
articles.content_zh: 流畅的视觉语言模型(VLMs)必须不断融合过去的信息,同时对当前的观察和用户查询保持响应. 现有的内存机制一般会压缩,取回,或缓存历史观察并重新引入输入上下文,迫使历史内存和当前观察竞争有限的上下文. 我们提议 MALOW,一个流传的内存框架, 而不是将历史背景内部化为不断发展的轻量级参数更新。 MaLOW使用一个经常性的HyperNetwork来将接入的视频观测逐渐整合为固定大小的LORA权重,使得历史信息可以不重温整个视频流而被转发. 在这样做的时候,MaLOW代表历史作为权重,同时保留当前观察作为输入. 为了支持培训,我们进一步建造了MaLOW-Instruct,这是一个大型流媒体视频数据集,包含381K个问答对数,超过56K个视频. 我们进行了广泛的实验,以证明MALOW在OVO-Bench,Streaming Bench,和StreamArena上取得了强大的性能. 在OVO-Bench的后向分出时,MaLOW在不同的视频主干线上比先前的内存接近3.9%至11.8%,而只产生适度的潜伏性间接费用. 除了流传的视频理解,MaLOW还概括到视觉语言-动作模型,将Simmer WildieX上的动作成功率提高了9.3%。

articles.title: FeaTok: Feature-Loss Tokenization for Image Generation
articles.content: Discrete image generators learn the distribution of tokens produced by an image tokenizer. These token representations should be easy for generators to model, not merely enable faithful image reconstruction. Yet these tokenizers are commonly trained to reconstruct pixels, which prioritizes low-level fidelity and may disrupt representation structure useful for generation. Motivated by feature-predictive self-supervised learning, we introduce feature-loss tokenization (FeaTok), which trains discrete tokens by reconstructing pretrained features rather than pixels. Ablations across SigLIP, SigLIP2, DINOv2, and DINOv3 show better generative performance with FeaTok. In class-conditional generation, FeaTok advances the quality-compute Pareto frontier, reducing gFDr6 at 256x256 by up to 29 percent over the strongest discrete baselines and outperforming the strongest unguided continuous baseline (RAEv2) with 38 times less sampling compute. FeaTok also achieves higher human-preference reward-model scores than prior art without reward-based training and surpasses continuous and discrete text-conditional baselines on three benchmarks with only 500 fine-tuning updates after pre-training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FeaTok: 用于图像生成的特性- Loss Tokenization
articles.content_zh: discrete图像生成器学习了由图像标致器所生产的活符的分布. 这些象征性的表示应便于发电机模拟,而不只是促成忠实的图像重建。 然而,这些示意器通常被训练来重建像素,这种像素优先考虑低级忠诚,可能会打乱对一代人有用的代表结构. 由地物预设自我监督的学习所激发,我们引入地物失落标志化(FeaTok),它通过重建被预先训练的地物而非像素来训练离散地物. 横跨SigLIP,SigLIP2,DINOv2和DINOv3的相接性能与FeaTok表现出更好的基因表现. 在类条件生成中,FeaTok推进了质量计算Pareto边框,在256x256时将gFDr6在最强离散基线上降低高达29%,并比最强的无制导连续基线(RAEv2)表现优于采样计算率低38倍. FeaTok还实现了比之前的艺术更优异的奖赏模式分数,没有基于奖赏的训练,并在三个基准上超越了连续和离散的文字条件基线,在预训后只有500个微调更新.

articles.title: When Models Misread Ink: Auditing VLMs for Arabic Calligraphy Recognition
articles.content: Arabic calligraphy is a high-stakes cultural visual domain for Muslim communities, yet VLM evaluations rarely test its fine-grained script traditions. We audit 12 VLMs on a cleaned 1,195-image six-way benchmark using numeric, visual-cue, and Diwani-first prompts. In this closed-set setting, the best numeric-prompt accuracy is 60.9% for closed/API models and 47.2% for open-weight models. The main failure is default-label collapse: every numeric run is dominated by a single label taking 33-63% of predictions, against an 18.8% majority-class baseline. For 8 of 12 models the default is Thuluth; GPT-4o labels 52.9% of all images as Thuluth although it is only 18.1% of the set. Prompting helps unevenly: visual cues move accuracy by more than 10 points for some models but hurt others, and foregrounding Diwani often relocates the default rather than removing it. Arabic calligraphy recognition is therefore a compact, culturally grounded stress test for VLM robustness and for measuring which visual traditions become legible to automated systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当模型错误读取墨水:阿拉伯书法识别的审计 VLM
articles.content_zh: 阿拉伯书法是穆斯林社区的一个高考文化视觉领域,然而VLM评价很少测试其精细的文字传统. 我们使用数字、视觉和Diwani的第一提示,对清理后的1,195-图像六向基准进行12个甚高频的审计。 在这种闭合设置中,收缩/API模型的收缩精度最好为60.9%,开口量模型为47.2%. 主要的失败是默认标签倒闭:每个数字运行都以一个单一的标签为主,使用33-63%的预测,而多数级基线为18.8%. 对于12个模型中的8个,默认为Thuluth;GPT-4o将所有图像的52.9%标为Thuluth,尽管它只占集的18.1%。 提示有不均匀的帮助:视觉提示为一些模型移动精度超过10分但伤害了其他模型,而预设的Diwani经常会迁移默认而非去除. 因此,阿拉伯文的书法识别是对VLM稳健性以及衡量哪些视觉传统可辨识到自动化系统的一种紧凑、基于文化的压力测试。

articles.title: Visual Sanad: Auditing Vision-Language Models for False Acceptance of Qur'anic Citations
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to interpret religious, educational, and culturally sensitive visual content, yet their reliability on citation verification remains underexplored. We introduce Visual Sanad, a controlled benchmark for testing whether VLMs falsely accept incorrect Qur'anic verse attributions when the same quote-reference pair is rendered under different visual framings. The benchmark contains 2,400 rendered images built from 100 English Qur'an verses, four factual states per verse, and six visual conditions ranging from plain text to decorative and authority-framed layouts. All quote-reference pairs were source-checked and human-audited before rendering. Across 24 full model-prompt runs, we observe a sharp capability split. Proprietary API-served VLMs range from near-perfect citation verification to moderate false acceptance, whereas recent open-weight VLMs often show weak discrimination and default to VALID on most images. De-biased prompting can reduce false acceptance, but often by shifting the decision threshold toward INVALID rather than by producing strong citation discrimination. Visual Sanad therefore exposes a culturally grounded multimodal factuality failure: fluent VLMs may treat displayed religious citations as self-authenticating unless they have strong citation-verification ability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Visual Sanad: 虚假接受《古兰经》引用的审计远景-语言模型
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)被越来越多地用于解释宗教,教育和文化上敏感的视觉内容,然而它们在引用核查方面的可靠性仍然没有得到充分利用. 我们引入了Visual Sanad, 一个用于测试VLMs是否错误地接受错误的Qur'anic诗句归属的可控基准, 当同一引文参考对在不同的视觉框架下得到. 该基准包含从100个英文《古兰经》诗句、每节四个事实状态以及从纯正文字到装饰和权威框架布局等6个视觉条件所制作的2 400个图像。 所有引文参考对子在渲染前都经过了源头检查和人为审计. 整个24个模型瞬间,我们观察到一个尖锐的能力分裂。 专有的API服务VLM从近乎完美的引用验证到中度的虚假接受,而近期的开量VLM在大多数图像上往往表现出微弱的歧视和默认为VALID. 消除偏见的鼓励可以减少虚假的接受,但往往是通过将决定门槛转移到INVALID,而不是产生强烈的引用歧视。 因此,Visual Sanad揭露了一种基于文化的多模式事实上的失败:流利的VLM可能会将所显示的宗教引用视为自我认证,除非他们具有强大的引用核查能力。

articles.title: Data-Efficient ConvNeXt Pretraining for High-Resolution Sentinel-1 GRD SAR Representation Learning
articles.content: Labeled Sentinel-1 Ground Range Detected (S1GRD) datasets remain scarce, limiting supervised deep learning for land-surface remote sensing, while self-supervised pretraining for this domain has been dominated by Vision Transformer (ViT)-based masked image modeling requiring substantial data and compute. We propose SparK-SAR, a sparse convolutional masked pretraining framework built on SparK and ConvNeXt, designed to exploit convolutional inductive biases for S1GRD imagery under constrained compute. SparK-SAR makes three core technical contributions: (i) ConvNeXt-RS, a domain-adapted encoder that halves the stem stride (4x to 2x) to produce 14x14 feature maps at stride 16x, providing 4x more spatial tokens at identical parameter count; (ii) a lightweight ConvNeXt-512 reconstruction decoder with PixelShuffle upsampling that reduces pretraining VRAM by 7.5-8.5% per GPU relative to a UNet-128 baseline while matching its accuracy; and (iii) an empirical characterization of FP16 mixed-precision pretraining instability in the standard SparK UNet-768 decoder on S1GRD data, complemented by a finding that finetuning with layer-wise learning rate decay (LLRD) improves downstream performance of pretrained encoders. On four Copernicus-Bench S1GRD tasks, our finetuned 27.8M-parameter ConvNeXt-RS encoder improves over a non-pretrained baseline by +4.7, +5.0, +5.8, and +1.4 pp on EuroSAT-S1, BigEarthNet-S1, DFC2020-S1, and Flood-S1 respectively, and outperforms the Copernicus-FM ViT (139M parameters, frozen) on three of four tasks at roughly 5x fewer parameters. A pretraining data-scaling study reveals task-dependent data efficiency: classification saturates with as little as 10-25% of the SSL4EO-S12 v1.1 corpus, while dense prediction continues to improve significantly up to 25-50%. The study also includes a CKA representation analysis and a geographic de-collision experiment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高分辨率哨兵-1GRD 合成孔径雷达代表性学习的具有数据功能的ConvNEXt预训
articles.content_zh: 标签式Sentinel-1地面测距(S1GRD)数据集依然稀缺,限制了对地表遥感的有监督的深层学习,而对该领域进行自我监督的预训则由基于Vision Transformer(ViT)的需要大量数据和计算的遮盖图像模型所主导. 我们提议使用SparK-SAR,这是在SparK和ConvNEXt上建造的一款零星的被遮住的预训框架,旨在利用S1GRD图像在受限计算下产生的入门偏差。 SparK-SAR作出三项核心技术贡献:(一) ConvNEXt-RS,一个域调整编码器,将干速率(4x至2x)减半,在16x时制作14x14特征图,在相同的参数计数时提供4x多的空间标志;(二) ConvNEXt-512重建分解器,用PixelShuffle上标,比UNet-128的基线降低每个GPU预训VRAM的7.5%-8.5%,同时与其准确性相匹配;(三) SparKet-768标准分解器中FP16混合精密分解分解不稳定性的经验特性,辅之以一项发现,即与分层学习率衰减(LLRD)微调提高了预训编码器的下游性能。 在哥白尼-奔驰S1GRD的四项任务上,我们将27.8M参数ConvNEXt-RS编码器改进为+4.7、+5.0、+5.8和+1.4pp,分别改进了EuroSAT-S1、BigEarthNet-S1、DFC2020-S1和Flood-S1,并在大约5x更低参数的四项任务中的三个任务上改进了27.8M参数ConvNEXt-RS编码器(139M参数被冻结了)。 一项预训数据缩放研究揭示了任务依赖性数据效率:分类饱和度小于10-25%的SSL4EO-S12 v1.1活体,而密集的预测继续显著改善到25-50%. 这项研究还包括CKA代表分析以及地理去缩实验.

articles.title: VesperMUSE: Multi-Modal Fusion Vision Transformer for Image Semantic Segmentation Under Diverse Light Conditions
articles.content: Semantic segmentation is critical for the reliable navigation and scene understanding of autonomous systems, yet its performance degrades severely in low-light environments due to noise, artifacts, colour distortion, and the loss of structural details. To address this challenge, this work introduces VesperMUSE, a unified multi-modal framework designed to achieve robust image semantic segmentation across diverse illumination conditions. The architecture addresses the light deficiency problem on multiple levels: proposing a novel physics-informed synthetic low-light adaptation algorithm, approaching Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) through a thermal-guided paradigm, and finally aiming to recover the intrinsic scene details for semantic segmentation through a multi-modal fusion approach. Following enhancement, the framework dynamically integrates the primary RGB features with auxiliary thermal representations and surface normal maps highlighting geometric discontinuities and material boundaries. At the core of this integration is a highly scalable, modality-agnostic self-attention mechanism that extracts both global context and fine local features from an arbitrary number of auxiliary inputs. By combining and projecting these hierarchical multi-modal representations into a unified component, the attention module allows the network to selectively attend to relevant cross-modal cues without requiring any architectural modifications when different sensor configurations are used. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that VesperMUSE successfully recovers missing visual cues, providing a flexible, state-of-the-art (SOTA) solution for machine perception in extreme and unstructured real-world environments.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VesperMUSE: 图像语义分解在相向光条件下的多模态聚变变器
articles.content_zh: 语义分解对于自主系统的可靠导航和场景理解至关重要,然而由于噪音,文物,色彩扭曲,结构细节丢失,其性能在低光环境下严重退化. 为应对这一挑战,本作引入了VesperMUSE这一统一的多模式框架,旨在实现不同照明条件的强力图像语义分解. 该架构在多层次上解决了光缺失问题:提出一种新颖的物理学知情合成低光适应算法,通过热导范式接近低光影像增强(LLIE),并最终通过多模式聚变方法来回收语义分化的内在场景细节. 增强后,框架能动态地将主RGB特征与辅助热表达和地表平面平面图相融合,突出几何不连续和材料边界. 这种整合的核心是高度可扩展、模式不可知的自觉机制,从任意数量的辅助投入中提取全球背景和精细的局部特征。 通过将这些分级的多模式表示方式合并并投影成一个统一的组件,关注模块允许网络有选择地处理相关的交叉模式提示而无需在使用不同的传感器配置时进行任何建筑修改. 广泛的评价表明,VesperMUSE成功地恢复了缺失的视觉提示,为在极端和无结构的现实世界环境中的机器感知提供了灵活而先进的(SOTA)解决方案.

articles.title: GRID-Planner: Graph-Structured Relational Reward Shaping for Diffusion Planning
articles.content: Autonomous driving planning requires selecting trajectories that remain safe, rule-compliant, and comfortable under complex multi-agent interactions, yet robust closed-loop decision making in planning-critical scenes remains challenging. Existing diffusion- and RL-based planners often rely on generic rewards and use relational structure mainly for representation, limiting how planning-critical rollouts shape policy improvement. We present GRID-Planner, a graph--reward integrated diffusion planning framework that aligns generative planning with structured relational signals. Specifically, GRID-Planner combines graph-aware importance weighting, a time-indexed relational reward surrogate, and an advantage-weighted diffusion objective with on-policy self-distillation, forming a rollout-return-advantage-update loop without explicit likelihoods. Experiments on nuPlan and interPlan show that, compared with the diffusion-only baseline, GRID-Planner reduces collision rate, lane deviation, and jerk by 35.8\%, 60.8\%, and 27.4\%, respectively, and improves the planning score by 3.4\%. Project website: https://github.com/yangzhaojason/GRID-Planner.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 全球资源信息数据库-规划者:用于传播规划的图-定型关系奖励
articles.content_zh: 自主驾驶规划需要选择在复杂的多代理互动下仍然安全,遵守规则,舒适的轨迹,然而在规划关键场景中稳健的闭路决策仍然具有挑战性. 现有的传播和基于RL的规划者往往依赖一般的奖励,并且主要利用关系结构来进行代表,这限制了规划的关键推出如何影响政策的改进。 我们介绍了全球资源信息数据库规划员,这是一个图酬综合传播规划框架,将基因规划与结构化的关系信号相协调。 具体地说,全球资源信息数据库-规划者将图感重要性加权、时间索引关系奖励代用、优势加权传播目标与政策上的自我消化结合起来,形成一个推出-回归-优势-更新循环,而没有明确的可能性。 关于nu Plan和inter Plan的实验表明,与仅扩散基线相比,GRID-Planner将相撞率,道偏差,和混蛋分别降低了35.8分,60.8分和27.4分,并将规划分数提高了3.4分. 项目网站:https://github.com/yangzhaojason/GRID-Planner。

articles.title: P2TPO: Structure-Aligned Page-to-Token Credit Assignment for Full-Page Document Parsing
articles.content: End-to-end full-page document parsing must preserve the content and structure of heterogeneous elements, yet otherwise accurate outputs can contain local errors and omissions. A single page-level advantage does not explicitly identify which elements differ in quality across sampled outputs or where their errors occur. We introduce Page-to-Token Policy Optimization (P2TPO), a structure-aligned credit-assignment framework that operates on full-page policy trajectories. Reference-element alignment first associates block-level quality contrasts with generated spans. Unified Anchor Pricing (UAP) incorporates matched and missing element outcomes and provides feedback relative to a fixed quality ceiling when sampled outputs receive identical but imperfect scores for a reference element. Within matched blocks, Span Credit Redistribution (SCR) redistributes existing block credit according to aligned correct and erroneous spans, using boundary proxies for within-block omissions while preserving the total block-derived advantage across its tokens. Under a fixed-weight additive page utility, we show that element-indexed contrasts retain local quality differences that page-level aggregation can cancel out. In the main experimental comparison, P2TPO outperforms all evaluated policy optimization baselines in seed-averaged scores on each of the six document parsing benchmarks. Additional experiments demonstrate gains across model scales and initializations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: P2TPO: 全页文档解析的结构- 相通的页面对帐信用指定
articles.content_zh: 端到端的全页文档解析必须保留不同元素的内容和结构,而否则准确的产出可能包含局部出错和遗漏. 单一的页面优势没有明确确定在抽样产出中哪些内容在质量上有所不同,或出现错误。 我们采用Page-to-token政策优化(P2TPO),这是一个结构相协调的信用分配框架,在全页政策轨迹上运作。 参考元素对接第一关联区块级质量与生成跨度的对比. 统一Anchor定价(UAP)包含匹配和缺失的元素结果,并在抽样产出获得相同但不完整的参考要素分数时提供与固定质量上限相比的反馈. 在相匹配的区块内,Span信用再分配(SCR)根据对齐的正确和错误的跨度重新分配现有区块信用,使用边界代用符来弥补区块内遗漏,同时保留其代用符上总的区块衍生优势. 在固定重量的添加剂页面工具下,我们显示元素索引对比保留了本地质量差异,页面级汇总可以抵消. 在主要实验性比较中,P2TPO在六个文件分析基准中每个基准的种子平均分数上都超过了所有评价的政策优化基线。 其他实验表明,在模型尺度和初始化方面都取得了收益。

articles.title: Following Delegation Traces to Study Human Oversight in Interaction with Multimodal AI
articles.content: As multimodal AI systems are becoming our everyday thought partners, the shift towards studying how users transfer control to these systems becomes especially urgent. In this paper, we report an overview of findings from an online study with n=56 AI-literate participants and 392 Video Question Answering trials. After inspecting each multimodal AI response, participants rated task-specific trust and selected one of three intended policies for an analogous future task: reject AI assistance, use it with verification, or delegate fully to the AI. Within participants, post-interaction trust strongly predicted the user's delegation choices (OR=14.97, 95% CI [7.14,31.37]). Trust and delegation nevertheless remained distinct. Verification was the dominant policy and often co-occurred with high trust. Delegation also increased with task order after adjustment for momentary and participant-level trust (OR=1.22, 95% CI [1.02,1.45]), indicating an experience-related component that self-reported trust ratings alone could not capture. These findings motivate a shift from intended delegation to a non-intrusive observation of how delegation is enacted in collaborative human-AI tasks. We therefore conclude by proposing enacted delegation traces as a methodological framework for future studies of multimodal and agentic AI use.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 跟踪研究人类在与多模式AI互动中的监督
articles.content_zh: 随着多模式AI系统正成为我们日常的思想伙伴,转向研究用户如何向这些系统转移控制变得特别紧迫. 在本文中,我们汇报了一项在线研究的总结结果,参与者为n=56 AI识字者和392个视频问答试验。 在检查了每一份多式大赦国际答复之后,与会者对特定任务的信任进行了评分,并为类似的未来任务选择了三项预期政策之一:拒绝大赦国际的援助,加以核查,或向大赦国际充分授权。 在参与者中,互动后信任强烈预测了用户代表团的选择(OR=14.97,95%CI [7.14,31.37]). 然而,信任和代表团仍然不同。 核查是主导政策,而且常常是高度信任的共同行为。 在调整了瞬间信任和参与者级信任(OR=1.22,95% CI [1.02,1.45])后,代表团也随任务顺序而增加,表明仅自报的信任评级无法捕捉到与经验相关的部分. 这些结论促使人们从打算授权转变为对授权是如何在人类-AI合作任务中实施的无侵犯性的观察。 因此,我们最后提议,颁布代表团跟踪法,作为今后研究使用多式和代理AI的方法框架。

articles.title: Flow-CLIP: Image-Conditioned Residual Scoring for CompositionalImage-Text Matching
articles.content: Vision--language pre-training has enabled substantial progress in image--text retrieval and zero-shot recognition by learning transferable cross-modal representations. However, sentence-level alignment remains insufficient for compositional matching, where captions can describe the same objects and attributes while differing in how these elements are bound. To address this limitation, we propose Flow-CLIP, which refines global image-text alignment through image-conditioned changes in token--patch evidence. Global Compatibility Calibration (GCC) learns a sentence-level similarity metric, while Image-Conditioned Evidence Refinement (ICER) incorporates visual patch context into token queries and uses the resulting change in local matching evidence to adjust the global score. We further introduce Cross-Image Margin Ranking (CIMR), which compares the same positive--negative caption pair across matched and mismatched images, encouraging a larger ranking margin when the image supports the correct description. Experiments on compositional matching and attribute--object binding benchmarks show that Flow-CLIP improves binding accuracy over pretrained CLIP and learned global alignment through local evidence refinement, while cross-image ranking supervision mitigates reliance on language priors. Code will be released at link.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Flow-CLIP:成像成像成像的成像成像成像法 图像文本匹配
articles.content_zh: 通过学习可转让的跨模式表述,视觉语前培训在图像文本检索和零镜头识别方面取得了重大进展。 然而,句子级的对齐仍然不足以进行组成匹配,其中标题可以描述相同的对象和属性,而对这些元素绑定的方式则有所不同. 为了克服这一限制,我们提议采用Flow-CLIP,通过对象征性标记证据进行图像条件的修改来改进全球图像文本的对齐。 全球相容性校正(GCC)学习了句子级相似度的度量衡,而图像-可控证据精准化(ICER)将可视补丁上下文纳入到符号查询中,并用由此而来的地方相配证据变化来调整全局分数. 我们进一步引入了"跨图像边际"(CIMR),它比较了相同正负相配和不匹配相配的图像的对接,鼓励在图像支持正确描述时进行更大的排名比. 关于组成匹配和属性-对象约束基准的实验表明,Flow-CLIP通过本地证据的精细化,提高约束精度,而不是经过预先培训的CLIP,并学会全球对接,而跨图像排名监督则能减轻对语言前言的依赖. 代码将会在链接中发布。

articles.title: BridgeAfford: Bridging Query-Target Gap for Generalizable 3D Affordance Grounding
articles.content: Language-guided 3D affordance grounding aims to localize functional regions on 3D objects according to interaction intents. However, existing methods exhibit poor generalization to unseen objects. One challenge is the query-target gap: a semantic discrepancy between query features encoding interaction intents and target-region features, leading to inaccurate grounding. End-to-end training favors query representations tailored to seen objects, limiting their compatibility with shifted target-region features on unseen objects. To address this issue, we propose BridgeAfford, a framework that reduces the query-target semantic gap from two complementary perspectives. First, Interaction Region Alignment (IRA) promotes cross-object alignment among geometrically similar interaction regions during training. This enables structures on unseen objects that resemble previously observed ones to produce representations similar to those learned during training, facilitating target-region recognition. Second, Visual Evidence Aggregation (VEA) leverages a 2D affordance model to refine the attention distribution and guide the query toward the correct region, yielding more target-aware queries. Extensive experiments on the LASO and PIAD datasets demonstrate that BridgeAfford outperforms existing methods, particularly on unseen objects, highlighting its robust generalization ability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BridgeAfford: 通用3D承受力地平线的桥梁查询-目标缺口
articles.content_zh: 语言导取的3D平价地基旨在根据交互意图将功能区域定位于3D对象上. 然而,现有方法对看不见物体的概括性很差。 一个挑战是查询-目标差距:查询特征编码互动意图与目标区域特征之间的语义差异,导致不准确的地基. 端到端训练偏好针对所见对象的查询表达式,限制其与所见对象上变化的目标区域特征相容. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议BridgeAfford,从两个互补的角度缩小查询-目标语义差距的框架。 第一,在培训期间,相互作用区域对接(IRA)促进几何相似相互作用区域之间的交叉对象对接。 这使得与以前观测到的物体相类似的看不见物体上的结构能够产生与培训期间学到的物体相类似的表述,促进目标区域识别。 第二,视觉证据聚合(VEA)利用2D提供模式来完善注意力分布并引导查询向正确的区域,从而产生更多的目标意识查询。 关于LASO和PIAD数据集的广泛实验表明,BridgeAfford比现有方法,特别是在看不见的物体上,表现优于现有方法,突出了其强大的通缩能力.

articles.title: Seeing is Believing: Benchmarking and Mitigating the Interference of Language Priors on Visual Perception in MLLMs
articles.content: Language priors in MLLMs can override visual evidence, impairing visual perception. Existing benchmarks assume shared priors across models and rely solely on accuracy. However, cross-model prior agreement falls below 80%, and over 15% of items can be answered correctly without any image, causing accuracy to overestimate prior resistance. To address these limitations, we introduce ViSiP-Bench, a benchmark grounded in rare-but-real scenarios across six prior categories, with a model-aware dynamic prior induction protocol and three metrics that more precisely and continuously measure prior resistance than accuracy alone. Evaluating 24 models reveals that prior adherence is pervasive, does not improve with scale, and larger models tend to either strongly override their priors or firmly adhere to them. We therefore propose MAPS, which identifies each model's strongest priors and fine-tunes on factually grounded knowledge to soften excessive prior reliance without disrupting general capabilities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 见是信:衡量和减轻对MLLMs中视觉视觉视觉语言前言的干扰
articles.content_zh: MLLMs中的语言前身可以覆盖视觉证据,损害视觉感知. 现有基准假定各模型共享前科,并完全依赖准确性。 然而,跨模型的先行协议低于80%,超过15%的项目可以在没有任何图像的情况下正确回答,导致准确性高估了先行阻力. 为了克服这些局限性,我们采用了ViSiP-Bench,这是以稀有但真实的情景为基础的基准,涵盖前6个类别,它有一个具有模型意识的动态前导协议和三个衡量标准,比仅精确性更精确和持续地衡量以前的阻力。 对24个模型的评价表明,以往的遵守情况很普遍,没有随着规模的扩大而改善,较大的模型往往会强烈地超越其前科或坚决遵守。 因此,我们提出MAPS,它确定每个模型最强的前科,并对基于事实的知识进行微调,以缓和先前过度依赖,而不会破坏一般能力。

articles.title: SurgStreamer: proactive, request-driven monitoring of surgical video streams with structured state and a reusable reasoning layer
articles.content: Surgical teams could benefit from assistants that watch the video for requested events, such as "tell me when the clip applier appears during Calot triangle dissection", and answer questions about what has already happened. We formalise this task as request-driven event detection with exact semantics and causal alert decisions, and present SurgStreamer. It separates procedure-specific perception, which maps the 1-FPS stream to a structured state over tools, actions and phases, from procedure-agnostic reasoning, which evaluates a formal monitoring condition over this state and an event memory, either with exact rules or with a small controller that addresses entities through pointers rather than names. We evaluate this monitoring core with gold conditions. On a pre-registered, sealed test set of 12 laparoscopic cholecystectomies, SurgStreamer reached a macro event-F1 of 0.598 over full procedures. On identical 75-s windows with only the window available to every method, it scored 0.677. The tested configurations of the streaming vision-language model OneStreamer-4B, including ones fine-tuned on SurgStreamer's state or on video with an adapted vision encoder, scored at most 0.540 (Holm-adjusted p <= 0.012). At three external centres, re-training only perception raised performance on held-out procedures from 0.239 to 0.470. On a new procedure, pituitary surgery, controller weights trained on cholecystectomy matched an in-domain controller on oracle state (0.947 vs 0.938). On predicted state they missed the pre-registered non-inferiority margin (-0.024 [-0.040, -0.008]) unless the alert thresholds were re-calibrated. The results support separating perception from reasoning and point to perception under distribution shift as the main limitation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SurgStreamer:对结构化状态和可重复使用的推理层的外科视频流进行主动、由请求驱动的监测
articles.content_zh: 外科团队可以从观看视频的助手们为所请求的事件而受益,比如"在Calot三角解剖期间出现剪接器时告诉我",并回答关于已经发生的事情的问题. 我们把这个任务正式化为由请求驱动的事件检测,包含精确的语义和因果警报决定,并呈现出SurgStreamer. 它将程序特定感知区分开来,将1-FPS流在工具,动作和相位上映射到结构化状态,从程序不可知推理中分离出来,它评价了这个状态上的正式监测条件和事件内存,要么有精确的规则,要么有一个小控制器通过指针而不是取名处理实体. 我们用黄金来评估这个监测核心 SurgStreamer在预先注册的12个膝盖囊肿的封口测试中,通过全程达到了0.598的宏事件-F1。 在只有每种方法可用的窗口的75-s相同的窗口上,它得分为0.677分. 被测试的流线视觉语言模型OneStreamer-4B的配置,包括了在SurgStreamer状态上或视频上经过微调并配有被修改的视觉编码器的配置,得分最多为0.540分(Holm-educted p <=0.012). 在三个外部中心,只进行再培训的观念将暂停程序的业绩从0.239提高到了0.470。 在新的手术中,垂体外科手术,接受过胆囊切除术训练的控制器重与甲骨文状态的域内控制器相匹配(0.947 vs 6.938)。 在预测的状态下,他们错过了预先登记的非贫困差值(-0.024 [-0.040,-0.08]),除非重新调整了警戒阈值。 结果支持将观念与推理区分开来,并指出分配转变中的看法是主要的限制。

articles.title: Anvil: Scaling Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Knowledge Recirculation
articles.content: Embodied spatial intelligence requires more than visual recognition: models must localize entities, reason about their relations, and express this knowledge in action-relevant forms. Yet joint training can conflate the knowledge needed at different stages because supervision is fragmented across incompatible geometric and semantic outputs. We introduce Anvil, a unified framework for data generation, training, and benchmarking for embodied spatial intelligence. (1) Anvil-Gen is a heterogeneous data flywheel that combines form-specific generation, cross-stage consistency verification, and failure-driven recollection across 11 Ground--Relation--Act forms. (2) Anvil-Ben provides scene-aligned supervision for learning diverse embodied spatial capabilities and scene-linked assessments that distinguish stage competence from error propagation. (3) Anvil-MOPD is a 9B student that consolidates heterogeneous spatial knowledge through distillation from specialist teachers. Semantic-first-fault routing targets teacher supervision to the student's earliest decisive failure, while stage normalization controls the loss scale across native outputs of different lengths. We construct 5.8M source-grounded records spanning 160K images, reserving 580K spatial records for held-out evaluation and using the remaining 5.22M records for training. On average across seven public benchmarks, Anvil-MOPD outperforms Qwen3.5-9B and RynnBrain-8B by 9.29 and 11.03 percentage points, respectively, while reaching 80.67% on VABench-Point. Controlled studies support targeted coverage, selective transfer, and feedback-guided repair as complementary framework components.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Anvil:通过知识循环增强健全的空间情报
articles.content_zh: 健美的空间智能需要的不仅仅是视觉识别:模型必须使实体定位,其关系的理由,并以与行动相关的形式来表达这种知识. 然而,联合培训可以将不同阶段所需的知识混为一谈,因为监督分散于不相容的几何和语义产出。 我们引入了Anvil, 用于数据生成、培训和建立包含的空间情报基准的统一框架。 (1)Anvil-Gen是一款多变的数据飞轮,结合了形式特异生成,跨相相容性验证,以及11个地-关系-行为形式的故障驱动回想. (2) Anvil-Ben为学习不同空间能力提供场地相通性监督,并进行现场相通性评估,区分阶段能力与出错传播。 (3) Anvil-MOPD是一名9B学生,通过专家教师的分馏来整合不同的空间知识. 语义-第一故障通路针对教师监督,以达到学生最早的决定性失败,而阶段正常化则控制不同长度的本土产出的损失规模. 我们建造了5.8M源源头记录,覆盖了160K图像,保留了580K空间记录用于暂停评价,并利用了剩余的5.22M记录用于培训。 在7个公共基准中,Anvil-MOPD的成绩分别比Quen3.5-9B和RynnBrain-8B分别高出9.29和11.03个百分点,而VA Bench-Point则达到80.67%. 受控制的研究支持有的放矢的覆盖、有选择的转移和反馈指导的修复,作为补充框架的组成部分。

articles.title: From Sketch to Scene: Relightable Garment Reconstruction from Marked Sketches
articles.content: Sketching is one of the most natural ways for people to express visual ideas. Unlike the text prompts that most generative systems rely on today, a sketch captures spatial structure and intent directly, including where a designer wants highlights and shadows to appear. Yet current sketch-to-3D pipelines have no input for that intent: they bake the drawn shading into the texture as dark paint, and the light cannot be moved. We propose a system that transforms a rough garment sketch, marked with sparse annotations (a star for a highlight and a moon for a shadow), and a short text prompt describing the texture, into a textured 3D mesh with an explicit directional light, as a scene that can be relit and edited after generation. The two symbols are the most frequent proposals in an elicitation study with art students. From the marked sketch the system predicts the scene's directional light and, separately, a displacement field that bends the surface so that the moon-marked regions fall into shadow under that light, rather than being painted dark in the texture.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从 Sketch 到场景: 从已标记的相机重建可亮化的服装
articles.content_zh: 捉摸是人们表达视觉思想最自然的方法之一. 与文本所提示的多数基因系统依赖于今天不同,一幅草图直接捕捉空间结构和意向,包括设计者希望亮点和阴影出现的地方. 然而,目前的草图到3D管线并没有为此目的投入:它们将所绘制的阴影烤入纹理中作为暗漆,光线不能被移动. 我们提出一个系统,将粗糙的服装素描,用稀疏的说明来标注(一颗恒星用来指向亮点,一颗月亮来指向阴影),并用短文本提示来描述纹理,变成一个带有明确方向光的纹理的3D网格,作为一代后可以被重写和编辑的场景. 这两个符号是与艺术学生一起进行的诱导研究中最经常的建议. 从所标注的草图上,系统预测了场景的方向光并单独地呈现出一个使地表弯曲而使所标出月亮的区域倒入该光下被阴影,而不是被漆入纹理中.

articles.title: Seeing Both the Forest and the Trees: Reusing Holistic 3D Priors for Part-Decomposed Generation
articles.content: Generating 3D assets with explicit parts requires two properties at once: geometric detail inside each part and structural coherence across the whole object. Recent image-conditioned 3D generation models adopt a structured 3D representation that anchors tokens to explicit spatial positions, capturing both properties, but their output remains a single fused mesh. We ask how a part-decomposed generation model can inherit both properties of these holistic priors, and answer with STRUCTPARTS, a framework whose core technical contribution is a dual-frame coordinate interleaving mechanism: each shape latent is interpreted under both a part-local and an object-global reference frame, and processed through a global-local inter-leaved transformer that simultaneously reuses the prior's geometric detail at the part scale and its structural coherence at the whole-object scale. As its structural input, STRUCTPARTS uses a segmented mesh scaffold, a coarse mesh paired with a face-level segmentation mask kept entirely within the prior's native 3D representation. With only lightweight finetuning, both intra-part detail and inter-part coherence emerge from the same pretrained weights. On PartObjaverse-Tiny, STRUCTPARTS matches or surpasses prior part-decomposed models at a fraction of their training cost, while naturally supporting part-mesh refinement and part-level editing.
