articles.title_zh: 见"森林"和"树":重用"整体3D前传"为"分解的一代".
articles.content_zh: 产生有明确部分的3D资产,需要同时有两个属性:每个部分内部的几何细节和整个对象的结构一致性. 最近有图像条件的3D生成模型采用了结构化的3D代表,将符号固定在明确的空间位置上,捕捉出两个属性,但其输出仍然是单一的被引信网. 我们问一个分解的生成模型如何能够继承这些整体前传的特性,并与STRUCTPARTS(一个其核心技术贡献是双帧坐标互接机制的框架):每个外形潜伏都在一个分解局部和对象-全球参考框架下进行解释,并通过一个全球分解的分解间变压器进行处理,该变压器同时在分解尺度上再用前传的几何细节,并在整个分解尺度上重用其结构一致性. 作为结构输入,STRUCTPARTS使用一个分层的网状脚手架,一个粗口的网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状网状 由于只有轻量级微调,部分内部细节和部分间一致性都产生于相同的被预先训练的重量. 在PartObjaverse-Tiny上,STRUCTPARTS以培训成本的一小部分匹配或超过以前的分解模型,同时自然支持分解精度和分级编辑.

articles.title: Temporal Periodic Image Registration with Implicit Neural Representations
articles.content: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have recently gained popularity for their ability to model functions using simple and lightweight networks. These methods have also proven effective in deformable image registration. In this work, we extend INRs for deformable image registration to the domain of temporal image registration, focusing on periodic temporal image sequences. Our approach, Temporal-IDIR, optimizes a single INR to model deformations across all frames in a temporal image sequence simultaneously, allowing for self-regularization through its own deformation predictions. To achieve this, we introduce a temporal consistency loss that penalizes discrepancies between direct source-to-target transformations and those traversing intermediate frames. We evaluate our framework on the DIR-LAB dataset, using the target registration error (TRE) between annotated and moved landmarks as the metric. Here, we achieve a TRE of 1.03 mm, outperforming other INR-based registration methods. Additionally, our framework supports smooth interpolation between time frames by estimating deformations between the given input frames. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/MMLowes/Temporal_INR.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 带有隐形神经特征的定期图像登记
articles.content_zh: 隐性神经表达系统(INRs)最近因其使用简单和轻量级网络模拟功能的能力而得到欢迎. 这些方法在可变形图像登记方面也证明是有效的. 在这个作品中,我们将可变形图像注册的INRs扩展至时间图像注册领域,并侧重于定期时间图像序列. 我们的方法"Temperal-IDIR",优化了单一的INR,在时间图像序列中同时对所有帧的变形进行模型化,允许通过自己的变形预测进行自律. 为了实现这一点,我们引入了时间一致性损失,从而惩罚了直接源到目标转换与那些转动中间帧之间的差异。 我们利用标注和移动地标之间的目标登记错误(TRE)作为衡量标准,对DIR-LAB数据集评估我们的框架。 在这里,我们实现了1.03毫米的TRE,优于其他基于INR的登记方法. 此外,我们的框架通过估计特定输入框架之间的变形,支持时间框架之间的平滑内插。 代码可在https://github.com/MMLowes/Temporal_INR上公开查阅.

articles.title: From Adults to Children: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Chest X-Ray Classification under Domain Shift
articles.content: Foundation models have shown significant potential across diverse fields and have been applied to medical imaging, but their robustness across patient populations remains unclear. In this work, we investigate foundation models' ability to generalize from adult to pediatric chest X-ray classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first benchmark to compare multiple foundation models under a common adult-to-pediatric evaluation setting while also analyzing the effect of adaptation depth. We harmonize VinDr-CXR and PediCXR into a five-label classification task and evaluate six foundation models and two CNN baselines. All models are adapted using adult data only and tested in both the in-domain and pediatric domains using linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning. The benchmark reveals a clear and consistent trend: all models suffer a substantial performance degradation when transferred from adult to pediatric data, with drops exceeding 10 percentage points. While Macro-AUROC values reach approximately 92% on the adult test set, performance decreases to around 78% on the pediatric domain. Another important finding is that increasing the depth of adaptation does not significantly improve cross-population generalization. Moreover, strong in-domain performance does not translate into better performance on pediatric data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从成人到儿童:域转移下胸X射线分类基准基模型
articles.content_zh: 基础模型在各个领域都显示出了巨大潜力,并已应用于医疗成像,但其在病人群体中的稳健性仍不明确。 在这项工作中,我们调查了基础模型从成人到儿科胸X光分级的概括能力. 据我们所知,这是第一个在成人对儿科的共同评价环境中比较多个基础模型的基准,同时也分析了适应深度的影响。 我们把VinDr-CXR和PediCXR统一为五标签分类任务,并评价了六个基础模型和两个CNN基线. 所有模型都仅使用成人数据进行改造,并在内域和儿科领域都使用线性检测,部分微调,并进行全微调试. 该基准显示出一个明确而一致的趋势:所有模型在从成人数据转移到儿科数据时,其性能都大幅下降,下降幅度超过10个百分点。 虽然Macro-AUROC值在成人测试中达到了约92%,但在儿科领域,性能却下降到了约78%. 另一项重要结论是,提高适应深度不会显著地改善跨人口一般化。 此外,强大的域内性能并不能转化为儿科数据的更好性能.

articles.title: Teaching DINOv3 About Partial 3D Geometry: A Self-Supervised Geometry-Aware Approach
articles.content: Partial shape matching is a crucial yet underexplored problem in 3D vision, with significant relevance to real-world scenarios where shapes are often only partially observed. Existing feature descriptors face difficulties in this setting, as traditional representations either struggle with the boundaries of partial shapes or heavily depend on the shape's spatial position. While existing approaches have employed DINO features for partial shape matching, these features are not inherently suited for handling partial observations. In this work, we propose a method to refine DINO features using LoRA-based self-supervised learning, enabling the generation of feature descriptors that are robust to partiality. Our features substantially improve performance on partial shape matching compared to traditional or vision foundation features. Additionally, when integrated into existing partial shape matching pipelines, we achieve state-of-the-art results on partial shape matching and left-right prediction benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 教学 DINOv3 关于部分 三维几何: 自导自导的几何-智能方法
articles.content_zh: 部分外形相配是3D视觉中一个关键而未充分探讨的问题,与现实世界的外形往往只被部分地观测到的假想有很大关系. 现有地物描述符在此背景下面临困难,因为传统地物描述符要么与部分外形的界限相搏,要么严重地依赖于外形的空间位置. 虽然现有方法采用了DINO特征进行部分外形匹配,但这些特征本质上并不适合处理部分观测. 在这项工作中,我们提出一种方法,利用基于LORA的自我监督学习来完善DINO特征,从而能够生成强烈到偏颇的特征描述符. 与传统或视觉基础特征相比,我们的特点大大提高了部分形状匹配的性能。 此外,在融入现有的部分形状匹配管道时,我们在部分形状匹配和左偏右预测基准方面取得最新成果。

articles.title: Single-stage joint diffusion of sky images and clear-sky index for ultra-short-term irradiance forecasting: what the frame-to-irradiance stage discards
articles.content: Sky-image irradiance forecasting is dominated by a two-stage design: a video-prediction model forecasts future sky frames, and a separately trained regressor maps those frames to irradiance. We propose a single-stage alternative that co-denoises the future sky-image and clear-sky-index sequences in one diffusion process, with an irradiance head that reads a denoised preview of the future sky rather than the noised diffusion state. The forecaster needs no regression stage and runs from sky images and deterministic covariates alone, with no measured irradiance at its input --- the situation at a site with a camera but no pyranometer. On 2023 SIRTA data the model reaches a pooled RMSE of $104.1$~W\,m$^{-2}$ and a skill score of $+0.34$ on the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) against smart persistence, higher than any of twelve baseline configurations, and retains that skill when retrained on 2021--2022. On the model's own generated frames, a separately trained regressor reaches $150.6$~W\,m$^{-2}$ against the joint head's $104.1$: roughly $46$~W\,m$^{-2}$ that joint training recovers and a cascade discards. Point accuracy is competitive but not best: a deterministic network that also reads measured irradiance attains $97.6$~W\,m$^{-2}$. The model's CRPS skill leads that network's in every sky-condition tertile, by $0.26$ to $0.30$.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 单阶段联合传播天空图像和超短期辐照预报的晴天指数:帧到辐照阶段丢弃的是什么
articles.content_zh: 天相辐射预报以两相设计为主:一是视频预测模型预测出未来的天空相框,一是经过单独训练的回向器将这些相框映射出辐射相. 我们提出一个单相相的替代方案,将未来的天象和晴天指数序列在一个扩散过程中同化而成,并用一个辐射头来读取未来天空的去诺化预览,而不是噪声扩散状态. 预测器不需要回归阶段,它仅从天空图像和决定共变,在其输入时没有测量到的辐照 -- -- 一个有相机但没有计的站点的情况。 2023 SIRTA数据显示,该模型在连续排名概率分数(CRPS)上达到104.1美元~W\,m$~2}$和0.34美元的技能分数,高于12个基线配置,并在2021-2022年再培训时保留了该技能. 在模型自己生成的相框上,一个经过单独训练的后退器达到150.6美元~W\,m$~2}美元,而联合头部为104.1美元:大约46美元~W\,m$~2}美元,联合训练可以恢复和级联抛弃. 点的准确性是竞争性的,但并非最好:一个也读取所测出辐射度的确定性网络达到97.6美元~W\,m$~2}$. 该型号的CRPS技巧导致网络在每一个天平条件的地平板上,以0.26美元到0.30美元.

articles.title: MedPAO-VL: Interpretable and Protocol-Compliant Agent for Structured Radiology Report Generation
articles.content: Despite the remarkable generalization capabilities of Large Language Models, generating clinically accurate and structured radiology reports from medical images remains a significant challenge. Current end-to-end approaches function as black boxes, prone to factual hallucinations and generating ungrounded findings. This lack of reliability and failure to adhere to domain-specific structuring protocols, fundamentally limits their clinical utility. We present MedPAO-VL, a multimodal agent that shifts the paradigm from monolithic generation to explainable, iterative, protocol-compliant structured report generation. Unlike deterministic models, our plan-act-observe loop functions as a goal-oriented agent: it first perceives the Chest X-Ray through an explainable vision module designed to capture inherent diagnostic uncertainty, then iteratively refines the generated report by observing semantic discrepancies and self-correcting its generation for better alignment with visually detected clinical findings. Evaluation of our framework demonstrates that this agentic reasoning improves clinical correctness and completeness, achieving an expert-rated accuracy score of 3.5/5 and a structural score of 4.3/5. By prioritizing pathology specific explainability and iterative refinement over opaque end-to-end mapping, MedPAO-VL offers a transparent and clinically viable alternative for automated structured radiology report generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MeDPAO-VL:结构放射学报告生成可解释和协议兼容剂
articles.content_zh: 尽管"大语言模型"具有显著的通俗化能力,但从医学图像中生成临床准确而有条理的放射学报告仍然是一个重大挑战. 目前的端到端方法作为黑盒发挥作用,容易发生事实幻觉并产生无根据的发现. 这种缺乏可靠性并未能遵守特定域的结构协议,从根本上限制了它们的临床效用. 我们介绍的是MedPAO-VL,这是一个多式联运代理商,它将模式从单体生成转向可解释、迭接、符合协议的结构化报告生成。 与定型模型不同的是,我们的计划-act-observator循环功能是面向目标:它首先通过一个旨在捕捉内在诊断不确定性的可解释的视觉模块来感知到胸X-Ray,然后通过观察语义差异并自我校正其生成,以更好地与可视检测到的临床结果相匹配来反复完善生成的报告. 对我们的框架的评价表明,这种代理推理提高了临床正确性和完整性,实现了专家评分为3.5/5分,结构分为4.3/5分. MeDPAO-VL通过将病理特定解释性和迭代改进置于不透明的端到端绘图之上,为自动结构放射学报告生成提供了透明和临床上可行的替代品。

articles.title: NICE Toolbox: Nonverbal Interpersonal Communication Exploration Toolbox
articles.content: Understanding human communication is a long-standing goal in psychological research. People express themselves through many verbal and nonverbal channels: posture, gesture, gaze, facial expression, and speech. Measurement and annotation of these signals has traditionally required time-consuming manual work by trained human labellers. The Nonverbal Interpersonal Communication Exploration (NICE) Toolbox is a free, open-source Python framework that automatically measures these signals by combining existing state-of-the-art computer vision and speech-processing methods into a single software package. It includes support for multi-camera systems, interchangeable detection algorithms, 2D and 3D visualization of detector outputs, evaluation on the user's custom data, and export to third-party software. With the release of this tool, we aim to make data exploration of interpersonal communication signals scalable, reproducible, and accessible for psychological research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: NICE 工具箱 : 非语言人际通信探索工具箱
articles.content_zh: 了解人际交流是心理研究中长期存在的目标. 人们通过许多口头和非口头渠道表达自己:姿态、姿态、目光、面部表情和言论。 这些信号的测量和注释传统上需要经过训练的人类标签员进行耗时的手工工作. 非语言人际通信探索(NICE) Toolbox是一个自由开源的Python框架,通过将现有的最先进的计算机视觉和语音处理方法合并为一个软件包来自动测量这些信号. 它包括支持多相机系统,可互换检测算法,探测器输出的2D和3D可视化,评价用户自定义数据,并输出给第三方软件. 随着这一工具的发布,我们的目标是使人际通信信号的数据探索具有可扩展性,可再生性,并可供心理学研究使用.

articles.title: Learning to Think and Explore in 3D World
articles.content: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. Instead of providing multi-view images, videos, or 3D representations to the model, we preserve the native visual encoding of VLMs, i.e., a single image, one at a time, just like humans, and treat the 3D representation only as an environment with which the model can interact through actions (e.g., move left) and observations (rendered images). Each rollout begins from an initial first-person view and a visual question. The model can then iteratively reason, navigate, and reorient its viewpoint before committing to a final answer. Following an initial trajectory-supervised finetuning, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) with rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. Crucially, RL provides no direct supervision over which viewpoints the model should visit or which exploration actions it should take. Instead, the model must learn an effective exploration policy solely from the extent to which its interactions improve performance. Across six 3D benchmarks, our model ACT3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2% that improves its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash. ACT3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50-70% fewer input frames, and generalizes to unseen domains with an average improvement of 5.9% over its supervised initialization. Further analysis reveals adaptive, question-conditioned exploration. Performance gains over the base model increase from 0.6% on questions answerable from the initial view to 16.3% on those requiring extensive exploration. ACT3D searches for occluded targets, avoids unnecessary exploration, and acquires complementary viewpoints for spatial comparisons. These findings demonstrate that outcome-based RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual evidence, but also to learn when and how to acquire it.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在3D世界学习思考和探索
articles.content_zh: 我们研究视觉语言模型(VLMs)如何在3D空间学习思考和积极探索. 我们不向模型提供多视图图像,视频,或3D表示,而是保留了VLM的原生视觉编码,即一个图像,一个一次一个,和人类一样,只把3D表示当作一个环境,模型可以通过动作(如左移)和观察(还原图像)进行互动. 每次推出都从初始第一人称视图和视觉问题开始. 然后,该模型可以反复说明理由、导航和调整其观点,然后再承诺最后答案。 经过初步的由轨迹监督的微调后,我们应用了强化学习(RL),奖励主要由最后的正确性驱动. 关键的是,RL没有直接监督模型应访问哪些观点或应采取哪些勘探行动。 相反,模型必须仅从其互动改善业绩的程度来学习有效的勘探政策。 我们的ACT3D模型平均精度达到53.2%, ACT3D还超越了现有的开源三维方法,同时使用50-70%的减量输入框,并概括到看不见的领域,平均比监督初始化提高5.9%。 进一步的分析揭示出适应性的,有问题条件的探索. 基准模型的性能收益从回答问题时的0.6%从初始观点提高到需要广泛探索的16.3%。 ACT3D搜索被占用的目标,避免不必要的探索,并获得空间比较的补充观点. 这些调查结果表明,基于结果的RL使VLM不仅能够对视觉证据进行推理,而且能够学习何时和如何获得.

articles.title: DINO-FIL: Multi-Layer Transformer Fusion for Generative Inpainting Forgery Localization
articles.content: We propose DINO-FIL, a transformer-based framework for pixel-level localization of generative image forgeries. The method leverages multi-layer representations from a pretrained DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 encoder combined with a lightweight fusion decoder to capture both semantic structure and fine-grained texture inconsistencies introduced by image editing. By aggregating intermediate transformer features across depths, the model improves sensitivity to subtle, spatially localized artifacts that are often missed by standard single-layer approaches. We evaluate DINO-FIL in a cross-dataset setting, training on B-Free and testing on Beyond the Brush, CocoGlide, TGIF, and SAGI-D. The model achieves strong generalization, outperforming existing baselines on average and on four of five evaluated datasets, while maintaining a high true negative rate on pristine images.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DINO-FIL:用于基因化涂抹伪造本地化的多激光变形器
articles.content_zh: 我们提议DINO-FIL,一个基于变压器的框架,用于将基因成像假象本地化. 该方法利用了由被预先训练的DINOv3 VIT-H+/16编码器与轻量级聚变解码器相结合的多层表示来捕捉由图像编辑引入的语义结构和精细纹理不一致. 该模型通过集成跨深度的中间变压器特征,提高了对微妙而空间局部的文物的敏感性,而这些文物往往被标准的单层方法所忽略. 我们通过跨数据集、无B培训以及 " 刷子 " 、 " CocoGlide " 、 " TGIF " 和 " SAGI-D " 测试来评估DINO-FIL。 该模型实现了强烈的概括化,平均比现有基线和5个评估数据集中的4个要好,同时在原始图像上保持了较高的真实负率.

articles.title: FuseAdapt: Parameter-Efficient Multimodal Fusion for Semantic Segmentation with Missing Modalities
articles.content: Multi-modal semantic segmentation benefits from complementary sensors, but this benefit is fragile when some modalities are degraded or missing at test time. Many existing methods rely on dedicated fusion modules or multi-branch cross-modal encoders, and the fusion often becomes unreliable when modalities are absent, leading to substantial performance drops. We propose \textbf{FuseAdapt}, a parameter-efficient framework that performs fusion within the adaptation space of a frozen vision foundation model (VFM), exploring whether VFM priors can serve as an effective shared backbone for multi-modal segmentation. Instead of attaching a standalone fusion network, FuseAdapt assigns each modality a lightweight adaptation branch and performs \emph{adaptation-space fusion} by keeping Q/V low-rank adaptation private to each modality and routing only FFN low-rank residual activations across modalities inside the frozen backbone. The pretrained VFM remains fixed while modality-specific corrections and explicit cross-modal interaction are learned through the adaptation paths. To handle missing modalities, we further introduce \textbf{Predictive Modality Modeling (PMM)}, a direct representation-level objective for cross-modal redundancy. During training, PMM masks a target modality and predicts its embedding from the visible ones, supervised by a teacher target computed under full-modality input. PMM is used only during training and adds no inference-time overhead. Across three multi-modal segmentation benchmarks (MCubeS, DELIVER, MUSES), FuseAdapt consistently improves both modality-complete and modality-incomplete segmentation with a small trainable budget, yielding up to +3.01 mIoU under full modalities and +12.56 mIoU under missing modalities over prior state-of-the-art. Project page: https://devinxzhang.github.io/FuseAdapt-Page/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FuseAdapt: 缺少模式的语义分区的参数有效多式组合
articles.content_zh: 多模式语义分解从互补传感器中受益,但当某些模式在试验时被退化或缺失时,这一惠益是脆弱的. 许多现有方法都依赖于专用的聚变模块或多分支的跨模式编码器,而当模式缺失时,聚变往往变得不可靠,导致大量性能下降. 我们提议\textbf{FuseAdapt},一个参数效率高的框架,在被冻结的视野基础模型(VFM)的适应空间内进行聚变,探讨VFM前身是否能够作为多模式分化的有效共享骨干. FuseAdapt不附带一个独立的聚变网络,而是指定每种模式一个轻量级适应分支,并进行\emph{适应-空间聚变},使Q/V低等适应对每种模式保持保密,并且只在被冻结的骨干内通过不同模式对FFN低等残余活化。 预先训练的VFM仍然固定不变,同时通过适应路径学习特定模式的校正和明确的跨模式互动. 为了处理缺失的模式,我们进一步引入\textbf{ 预测模式(PMM)},这是跨模式冗余的直接代表级目标。 在培训期间,PMM掩盖了一种目标模式,并预测其从可见模式上嵌入,由根据全模式输入计算出来的教师目标监督。 PMM只在培训期间使用,不增加推断时间间接费用。 FuseAdapt在三种多模式分区基准(MCubeS、DELIVER、MUSES)中,不断改进模式完成和模式不完成的分区,其可培训预算较小,在完全模式下达到+3.01 mIoU,在缺失模式下达到+12.56 mIoU,优于以前的先进水平。 项目网页:https://devinxzhang.github.io/FuseAdapt-Page/.

articles.title: Beyond Generation: Using Multimodal LLMs as Detectors of LLM-Generated Deepfake Facial Images
articles.content: As image generation models become increasingly capable of producing highly realistic content, traditional forensic techniques are struggling to keep up. This paper investigates whether MLLMs can instead be used as a form of forensic analysis by identifying synthetic media. Specifically, the study aims to determine whether these models detect fake images by recognising physical inconsistencies, or whether they rely on digital artefacts such as embedded watermarks.Six MLLMs: GPT-4o, GPT-5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 2.5, Gemini 3, and Seed 1.6, are benchmarked using a dataset of 400 images. Fifty images are authentic photographs, while the remaining 350 are generated using seven leading image models: Gemini 3, Gemini 2.5, Flux.2 Pro, GPT-Image-1, GPT-Image-1.5, Seedream 4.0, and Seedream 4.5. The evaluation is structured in three stages: single-image classification, pairwise comparison, and a focused "self-detection" experiment on Gemini. Several MLLMs achieved a high detection accuracy, with GPT-5.2 reaching a peak of 97.9% in the pairwise experiment, against specific generators and an overall mean pairwise accuracy of 82.5% by identifying structural or physical inconsistencies within images. However, results from the self-detection experiment indicate that the presence of invisible SynthID watermarks leads to a 10% reduction in Gemini's detection accuracy compared to the clean control group. One possible explanation is that SynthID embedding reduces some of the visible artefacts the models rely on for detection.These results imply that MLLMs can detect structural artefacts without relying on watermarks, but performance varies substantially across model generations. The findings from comparison C5 also suggest that SynthID embedding may suppress some of the structural artefacts used during detection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Generation: 使用多式LLMs作为LLM-Gened Deepfake Facial 图像的探测器
articles.content_zh: 随着图像生成模型越来越能产生出高度现实的内容,传统的法证技术正难以跟上. 本文调查MLLMS是否可以通过识别合成介质作为法证分析的一种. 具体来说,该研究的目的是确定这些模型是否通过识别物理上的不一致来检测出假图像,或者它们是否依赖于嵌入式水印等数字手工艺品. 6个MLLMs:GPT-4o,GPT-5,GPT-5.2,双子座2.5,双子座3和种子1.6,使用由400个图像组成的数据集作为基准. 50幅相片为正版相片,而其余的350幅相片则使用7个主要相片模型生成:双子座3,双子座2.5,Flux.2 Pro,GPT-Image-1,GPT-Image-1.5,Seedream 4.0和Seedream 4.5. 评估分为三个阶段:单相图分类,对等比较,以及双相子上的重点"自测"实验. 几个MLLM实现了高检测精度,在对偶实验中,GPT-5.2相对于特定发电机达到了97.9%的峰值,通过识别图像内部的结构或物理不一致,总体平均对偶精度为82.5%. 然而,自测实验的结果表明,与清洁控制组相比,隐形合成水印的存在导致双子座检测精度降低10%. 一种可能的解释是,合成ID嵌入会减少模型检测所依赖的一些可见的手工艺品. 这些结果意味着,MLLMs可以不依赖水印来探测出结构上的手工艺品,但不同代相差很大。 比较C5的结果还表明,合成体嵌入可能会抑制在探测时使用的一些结构工艺品。

articles.title: Beyond Source Prompts: Towards Visually Grounded AI-Generated Video Quality Assessment
articles.content: Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence have accelerated video generation technologies. However, AI-generated videos (AIGVs) remain susceptible to various distortions, highlighting the need for dedicated video quality assessment methods. Content semantics play an important role in AIGV quality assessment, with source prompts typically used as textual references. However, these prompts may not accurately reflect the generated video content, resulting in a discrepancy between the intended textual description and the generated result. To address this limitation, this paper proposes VGCap, an AIGV quality assessment framework guided by visually grounded captions that align better with generated content. Specifically, we introduce two forms of captions: a global caption obtained by minimally revising the source prompt based on multi-frame visual evidence, and prompt-independent segment captions that describe localized temporal content. Together, these captions provide complementary textual evidence for assessing spatial quality, temporal quality, and text-video alignment. Experimental results on the LGVQ and FETV datasets show that VGCap outperforms representative baselines across all three dimensions. Further ablation studies on caption sources and temporal components confirm the effectiveness of visually grounded captions for each quality dimension, while highlighting the benefits of segment-level features for temporal quality prediction. The source of VGCap will be available at https://github.com/lolo123-123/VGCap.

articles.title_zh: Beyond source:实现可视化的AI-Gened视频质量评估
articles.content_zh: 最近基因人工智能的进步加速了视频生成技术. 然而,AI生成的视频(AIGVs)仍然容易受到各种扭曲,突出表明需要专门的视频质量评估方法. 内容语义在AIGV质量评估中起重要作用,源提示通常作为文字参考. 然而,这些提示可能无法准确反映所生成的视频内容,从而导致预期的文字描述和所生成的结果之间存在差异. 为解决这一限制,本文件建议采用以视觉为基础的、与生成内容更加一致的文字指导的AIGV质量评估框架VGCap。 具体来说,我们引入了两种形式的标题:一种是通过基于多框架视觉证据的最小修订源提示获得的全球标题,另一种是描述局部时间内容的即时独立片段标题。 这些标题加在一起,为评估空间质量、时间质量和文本视频相接提供了补充性文本证据。 LGVQ和FETV数据集的实验结果显示,VGCap超越了所有三个维度的代表性基线. 有关标题来源和时间组成部分的进一步研究证实了每个质量维度的视基标题的有效性,同时强调了分层特征对时间质量预测的益处。 VGCap的来源将在https://github.com/lolo123-123/VGCap上查阅.

articles.title: The Dormant Spiking Neuron: A State-Driven Mechanism for Efficient Spiking Neural Networks
articles.content: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer a compelling pathway toward energy-efficient artificial intelligence, fundamentally anchored in presynaptic input-driven sparsity. However, a substantial yet chronically overlooked source of computational overhead persists: the continuous subthreshold dynamics of postsynaptic neurons. Quantitative analysis reveals that up to 44% of neurons in an ImageNet-trained ResNet-18 model reside in a deeply inhibited state, imposing a persistent computational burden despite having a negligible probability of firing. To address this inefficiency, the Dormant Spiking Neuron (DSN) model is introduced. By incorporating a state-driven dynamic gate, the DSN allows a neuron to enter a dormant state when its membrane potential falls below a predefined negative threshold, dynamically pruning redundant computations at the instance level. Crucially, this dormancy mechanism is directly integrated into the neuronal dynamics and trained end-to-end via backpropagation through time using surrogate gradients, enabling the network to actively learn a robust dormancy policy that adaptively preserves critical information flow. Extensive experiments across static and neuromorphic datasets demonstrate that the DSN framework consistently reduces computational energy by 40% to over 70%. Notably, on the large-scale ImageNet dataset, the DSN outperforms state-of-the-art static pruning techniques at comparable reported cost reductions and simultaneously improves the corresponding baseline SNN accuracy by 1.34%. By establishing a trainable, state-driven sparsity paradigm orthogonal to conventional input-driven methods, the DSN unlocks synergistic efficiency gains, presenting an effective approach for advancing neuromorphic computing.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Dormant Spiking Neuron:高效Spiking神经网络的国家驱动机制
articles.content_zh: 螺旋神经网络(SNNs)提供了通往节能人工智能的有说服力的路径,其根本基础是突触前输入驱动的螺旋. 然而,长期被忽略的大量计算间接费用来源依然存在:突触后神经元的持续下限动态。 定量分析显示,在ImageNet训练有素的ResNet-18模型中,高达44%的神经元处于被深深抑制的状态,尽管发射的概率微乎其微,但却造成了持续的计算负担. 为解决这种效率低下的问题,引入了多尔曼特·斯皮克宁·纽伦(DSN)模式. 通过纳入由状态驱动的动态门,DSN允许神经元在细胞膜潜力低于预先定义的负阈值时进入休眠状态,动态地在实例层面进行冗余计算. 关键的是,这种宿舍机制被直接融入了神经动力学中,并且通过用代用梯度的后向传播经过了培训,使网络能够积极学习一种能适应性地保存关键信息流的稳健宿舍政策. 跨越静态和神经形态数据集的广泛实验表明,DSN框架始终将计算能量减少40%至70%以上. 值得注意的是,在大规模ImageNet数据集方面,DSN在报告的费用减少方面超过了最新水平的静态挤压技术,同时将相应的SNN基线精度提高了1.34%。 DSN通过建立可受训练,可受国家驱动的斯帕克范式正对常规输入驱动方法,解锁了协同增效,提出了推进神经形态计算的有效方法.

articles.title: International Multi-Centre Validation of Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Precise Discrimination between Normal and Abnormal Retinal Development
articles.content: Arrested retinal development can cause childhood visual impairment, but grading optical coherence tomography scans is difficult to standardise across devices and centres. We developed and evaluated an unsupervised domain adaptation model to classify normal and abnormal retinal development across different OCT systems. This retrospective multicentre study used OCT scans from five centres in four countries and the UK Biobank. Data covered four OCT devices, including table mounted and handheld systems. A ResNet50 based Domain Adversarial Neural Network was trained using labelled images from a source device and unlabelled images from a target device. We evaluated six source to target pairings and compared model performance with seven clinician graders. A separate Heidelberg Spectralis dataset was reserved for external evaluation. Across validation sets, accuracy ranged from 87.75% to 96.06%, sensitivity from 88.68% to 98.38%, and specificity from 78.00% to 98.02%. The best performing model, adapted from TM OCT1 to HH OCT1, achieved 96.06% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.994, with a 95% confidence interval from 0.981 to 0.999. Several models also maintained discrimination on the unseen Heidelberg device. Unsupervised domain adaptation enabled OCT classification across devices without labelled target device data. The approach may support more consistent assessment of retinal development and large scale analysis of existing imaging datasets.

articles.title_zh: 国际多中心验证无监督地区在正常和非正常视网膜发展之间精确歧视的适应性
articles.content_zh: 被捕的视网膜发育会造成儿童视觉障碍,但光学一致性成像扫描在设备和中心之间难以标准化。 我们开发并评价了一个不受监督的域名适应模型,将不同OCT系统的正常和异常视网膜发育分类. 这项回顾性多中心研究使用了来自四个国家五个中心和英国生物银行的OCT扫描. 数据涵盖四个OCT设备,包括台式挂载和手持系统。 一个基于ResNet50的域外神经网络接受了培训,使用来自源设备的标签图像和来自目标设备的无标签图像。 我们评估了6个来源,以进行目标配对,并将模型性能与7个临床医生分级员进行比较。 另有一个海德堡光谱数据集被保留给外部评价. 在各种验证中,精确度从87.75%到96.06%,灵敏度从88.68%到98.38%,特异性从78.00 %到98.02%。 从TM OCT1被改编为HH OCT1的性能最好的模型达到了96.06%的精度,并且是接收机运行特征曲线下的一个区域为0.994,置信间隔从0.981到0.999为95%. 一些模型还维持了对看不见的海德堡装置的歧视。 未经监督的域适应使得OCT在没有标有目标设备数据的设备之间进行了分类. 这种方法可能有助于更一致地评估视网膜的开发情况并对现有成像数据集进行大规模分析。

articles.title: Mixture of Multi-Sequence Feature Difference for Contrast-Enhanced MRI Synthesis
articles.content: Contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (CE-MRI) is crucial for accurately diagnosing and segmenting brain tumors. However, the acquisition of CE-MRI requires injecting contrast agents, which poses potential health risks and increases scan costs. Here, we propose a CE-MRI synthesis method from non-contrast sequences, reducing both risk and cost. Unlike existing methods that rely on channel-wise concatenation to fuse multi-sequence information for synthesis, we introduce a Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD) module. The proposed module uses a dynamic weighting strategy to adaptively select and aggregate informative features from both individual source sequences and explicit differences among them. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms baselines in terms of image fidelity and perceptual quality on the UCSF-PDGM and UPenn-GBM datasets. Our method successfully reconstructs tumor regions and achieves segmentation performance comparable to that obtained with real CE-MRI. Our ablation studies show that although adversarial learning improves perceptual quality, a regression-based variant of our method achieves higher structural fidelity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多序列特性差异混合,用于对比性增强磁共振 综合
articles.content_zh: 相矛盾的磁共振成像(CE-MRI)对于准确诊断和分解脑瘤至关重要. 然而,获取CE-MRI需要注射对比剂,这可能造成健康风险并增加扫描成本. 在此,我们从非相容序列中提出CE-MRI合成方法,降低风险和成本. 与现有方法依赖信道相接来为合成而引信多序列信息不同,我们引入了地物差异混合(MoFD)模块. 拟议模块采用动态加权战略,以适应性地从单个源序列中选择和汇总信息性特征,以及它们之间的明显差异。 定量和定性评价表明,我们拟议的方法在图像可靠性和视觉质量方面超过了UCSF-PDGM和UPenn-GBM数据集的基线。 我们的方法成功地重建了肿瘤区域,实现了与真正的CE-MRI获得的分解性能相仿. 我们的减退研究显示,虽然对抗性学习提高了知觉质量,但我们方法的一种基于回归的变体实现了更高的结构忠诚.

articles.title: Bridging the Markerless Tracking Validation Gap: Intraoperative X-ray Workflow Integration
articles.content: Markerless intraoperative tracking of spinal anatomy via RGB-D sensors is a promising alternative to invasive bone-anchored fiducials, yet no existing clinical dataset provides independent subsurface ground truth for validating these methods. We address this gap with a clinically viable pipeline that derives per-vertebra 6-DoF pose from routine intraoperative C-arm fluoroscopy, co-registered to the RGB-D camera frame through a multimodal fiducial array detectable in both imaging modalities. Critically, the pipeline requires no additional radiation, instrumentation, or deviation from standard surgical workflows, relying solely on the fluoroscopic images already acquired during routine level checks. A calibrated transform chain links the vertebral pose recovered via multi-view 2D-3D CT-to-fluoroscopy registration to the RGB-D coordinate frame, enabling direct comparison of any markerless registration estimate against a subsurface reference. Ex vivo validation against optically tracked ovine vertebrae confirms end-to-end accuracy of 2.06 +- 0.29 mm and 3.35 +- 0.93 degrees, sufficient to serve as independent ground truth for methods with substantially larger errors. We demonstrate the pipeline's utility by evaluating two markerless registration strategies on clinical data spanning 11 vertebrae across 1,500 frames from three surgical sequences: the first such evaluation against an independent subsurface reference in a clinical setting. The proposed framework provides reusable infrastructure for benchmarking emerging markerless tracking methods on real surgical data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 弥合无标记跟踪验证漏洞:操作中X光工作流程集成
articles.content_zh: 通过RGB-D传感器对脊髓解剖学进行无标记的内行跟踪,是入侵性骨血管活化剂的一种有希望的替代品,然而,现有的临床数据集并没有为验证这些方法提供独立的地表下真伪. 我们用一条临床上可行的管线来弥补这一缺口,这条管线通过两种成像方式中都能探测到的多式微分阵列,从常规的操作内C-臂荧光镜中取出。 关键的是,管道不需要额外的辐射、仪器或偏离标准的外科手术工作流程,而只依靠在例行水平检查中已经获得的氟化图像。 将通过多视图2D-3D CT-对氟化物的登记与RGB-D坐标架所回收的脊椎造型连接起来,从而能够将任何无标记的登记估计数同地下参照物进行直接比较。 对光学跟踪的卵巢顶部进行外活性验证,证实端到端精度为2.06+-0.29毫米和3.35+-0.93度,足以作为具有明显较大误差的方法的独立地地真. 我们通过评价两个无标记的临床数据登记战略来展示管道的效用,这些战略跨越了三个外科序列的1 500个框架的11个脊椎:第一次这种评价是对照临床环境中的独立地表下参照进行的。 拟议框架为将新出现的无标记跟踪方法作为实际外科数据的基准提供了可重复使用的基础设施。

articles.title: Edit4D: Editable 4D Scene Generation with Textual Control
articles.content: We introduce Edit4D, an editable text-to-4D scene generation framework that constructs 4D scenes from separate background and dynamic character representations. Recent advances in generative models have enabled text-driven dynamic scene synthesis, but editable 4D scene generation remains challenging due to the need to preserve spatial geometry and temporal dynamics. Existing approaches typically generate holistic scene videos, where the background and dynamic characters are coupled, making object-level editing and flexible camera control difficult. Edit4D addresses these limitations through a stage-specific generation pipeline. Given a user instruction, Edit4D first decomposes it into stage-specific prompts for background, dynamic character, and scene-character composition. Using these prompts, we synthesize multi-view scene images with text-to-image and camera-conditioned generative priors and reconstruct a background 3D Gaussian splatting representation. We then generate a character image, animate it with an image-conditioned video prior, reconstruct a 4D mesh, and bind Gaussian primitives to obtain a character representation. Finally, both components are composed through text-guided segmentation and contact-aware optimization. A global scene refinement is then performed to improve harmonization and rendering consistency. By integrating stage-specific components, Edit4D enables controllable camera motion, flexible object-level editing, and the practical construction of editable 4D scenes. Project page: https://chanwo0kim.github.io/Edit4D/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 编辑4D:可编辑的有文字控制的 4D 场景生成
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了Edit4D,这是一个可编辑的文本到4D场景生成框架,它从不同的背景和动态字符表现构造出4D场景. 基因模型最近的进步使得文字驱动的动态场景合成成为可能,但由于需要保存空间几何和时间动态,可编辑的4D场景生成仍然具有挑战性. 现有方法一般产生整体的场景视频,其中背景和动态字符相接,使得对象级的编辑和灵活相机控制变得困难. Edit4D通过特定阶段的生成管道来应对这些局限性. 鉴于一个用户指令,Edit4D首先将它分解为针对背景,动态字符,和场景特征构成的阶段特有提示. 利用这些提示,我们用文字到图像和相机条件的基因前传合成多景场景图像,并重建出背景3D高斯克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克 然后我们生成一个人物图像,用一个图像条件化的视频在前作动画,重建出一个4D网格,并捆绑高斯原始人以获得人物代表. 最后,这两个部分都是通过以文字指导分解和接触意识优化而构成的. 然后进行全球范围的改进,以增进协调和一致性。 通过整合阶段特定组件,Edit4D可以实现可控相机运动,灵活的对象级编辑,以及可编辑的4D场景的实际构建. 项目网页:https://chanwo0kim.github.io/Edit4D/

articles.title: FusionAudit: Pathway-Conditioned Robustness Auditing for Native Multimodal Models
articles.content: As vision-language models (VLMs) transition from frozen-encoder pipelines to native multimodal architectures, the visual channel increasingly serves as both a perceptual input and a carrier of rendered text that competes with user prompts. Current single-attack, pixel-centric evaluations fail to capture this complexity: they collapse distinct visual attack surfaces into a single scalar and ignore how architectural shifts alter vulnerability. We introduce PaRMA, an evidence-based auditing framework that defines pathway-conditioned risk over two primary image-level interventions: pixel perturbation and rendered-text insertion. Instead of arbitrary attack enumeration, PaRMA uses pathway-specific diagnostics to expose architecture-specific blind spots. Notably, we uncover a see-but-not-deceived signature where native VLMs attend heavily to typographic overlays but visually reject them, and we identify an objective mismatch between encoder-level and answer-level attacks in deep-fusion models. To exploit these findings, we instantiate FusionAudit, introducing two diagnostic-motivated attacks: MANTIS (margin-aware pixel perturbation) and Nat-Evid (host-congruent semantic insertion). Evaluating 18 open-weight VLMs across a novel nativeness taxonomy, we demonstrate that legacy single-attack rankings (e.g., PGD) are unstable for native models. Our diagnostic-driven attacks substantially raise the estimated residual risk, showing that PaRMA provides a falsifiable, evidence-driven auditing methodology for uncovering vulnerabilities missed by standard benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 联合审计:本土多式联运模式的路径条件强性审计
articles.content_zh: 随着视觉语言模型(VLMs)从冷冻-编码器管道向本土多模式架构的过渡,视觉通道日益成为与用户提示相竞争的已渲染文本的感知输入和载体. 目前的单发攻击,以像素为中心的评价未能捕捉到这种复杂性:它们会把明显的视觉攻击表面倒塌成一个单一的平板,而忽略建筑转变如何改变脆弱性. 我们采用了基于证据的审计框架PARMA,它界定了两种主要图像层面干预措施的路径条件风险:像素扰动和提供文本插入。 PARMA没有任意攻击点数,而是使用路径特异性的诊断来暴露建筑特异性的盲点. 值得注意的是,我们发现了一种可见但不可见的签名,即当地VLM大量参与打字,但视而不见,我们发现在深度聚变模型中编码器级和答案级攻击之间的客观不匹配。 为了利用这些发现,我们即时进行FusionAudit,引入了两个有诊断动机的攻击:MANTIS(边际-意识像素扰动)和Nat-Evid(主-相通语义插入). 对18个开放量级的VLM进行全新本土分类评价,我们表明,遗留下来的单发攻击排名(如PGD)对于本土模型来说是不稳定的. 我们的诊断驱动攻击大大增加了估计的残余风险,表明PARMA为发现标准基准所遗漏的脆弱性提供了可伪造的由证据驱动的审计方法。

articles.title: Digital Typhoon Dataset V3: Benchmarking for Multi-spectral Extension and Analyzing Systematic Bias in Intensity Regression
articles.content: This paper presents the Digital Typhoon Dataset V3, a new version of the longest typhoon satellite image dataset spanning nearly 50 years, designed to benchmark machine learning models on long-term spatio-temporal data. The latest addition to Dataset V3 is multispectral satellite data, enabling multi-channel models. We investigate data-splitting strategies and present benchmarking results for the Northern and Southern Hemispheres. Experimental results show that, under the current dataset construction and experimental setting, multi-channel inputs do not clearly outperform single-channel inputs for pressure regression. Among the evaluated model architectures, image types, and spectral channels, ResNet-18, full-resolution images, and Channel 1 generally provide the best single-channel performance for pressure regression. Performance also differs between the WP and AU datasets by regression target, with lower RMSE on WP for pressure regression and on AU for wind regression. These results highlight the importance of considering dataset-specific and task-specific characteristics when interpreting benchmark performance. Additionally, we analyzed systematic bias in intensity regression, which leads to underestimation of intensity for strong typhoons. We tested imbalance-aware weighting strategies, including inverse-density weighting inspired by BalancedMSE, and showed that these approaches are not sufficient to remove the bias. The dataset is publicly available at http://agora.ex.nii.ac.jp/digital-typhoon/dataset/ and https://github.com/kitamoto-lab/digital-typhoon/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 数字台风数据集V3:多光谱扩展基准和分析强度回转中的系统比斯
articles.content_zh: 本文介绍数字台风数据集V3,这是新版最长的台风卫星影像数据集,持续了近50年,旨在将机器学习模型作为长期时空数据的基准. 对Dataset V3的最新添加是多光谱卫星数据,使多通道模型成为可能. 我们调查分享数据的战略,并提出南北半球的基准结果。 实验结果表明,在目前的数据集构建和实验设置下,多渠道输入不能明显地超过单渠道输入来进行压力回流. 在被评价的模型架构中,图像类型和光谱通道,ResNet-18,全分辨率图像,以及1频道一般为压力回流提供最好的单通道性能. WP和非盟数据集的性能也因回归目标而异,WP上压回归的RMSE更低,而非盟上压回归的RMSE更低. 这些结果突出表明,在解释基准业绩时必须考虑到数据集的具体特点和任务的具体特点。 此外,我们分析了强度回归的系统性偏差,这导致低估了强烈台风的强度。 我们测试了认识到不平衡的权重战略,包括受到平衡型MSE启发的反密度权重,并表明这些方法不足以消除偏见。 该数据集可在以下网站公开查阅:http://agora.ex.nii.ac.jp/digital-typhon/dataset/和https://github.com/kitamoto-lab/digital-typhon.

articles.title: SCMerge: Spatial-Consistency-Aware Token Pair Merging for Efficient Semantic Segmentation
articles.content: Vision Transformer architectures have showcased impressive performance on semantic segmentation, yet their quadratic attention complexity hinders practical applications. Recent works have focused on merging tokens to reduce sequence length and thus improve transformer efficiency. However, existing token merging methods primarily rely on feature similarity to identify similar tokens, overlooking spatial consistency, which may introduce segmentation errors in semantic segmentation. In this work, we propose SCMerge, a training-free token merging method that jointly considers feature similarity and spatial consistency in pairing similar tokens. The pairwise tokens are then merged within the encoder, and the resulting token sequences are reconstructed onto the original patch grid after decoding. The proposed method is flexible and can be plugged into existing vision Transformer-based semantic segmentation pipelines. Extensive experiments on the benchmark datasets ADE20K, Pascal Context, and Cityscapes show that SCMerge consistently achieves a better trade-off between segmentation accuracy and efficiency than baseline methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SCMorge: 空间- 一致性- 智能托肯对等合并以高效语义分割
articles.content_zh: 视觉变形器架构在语义分解上展现出令人印象深刻的性能,然而其四相关注的复杂性阻碍了实际应用. 近期的作品以合并符为主来缩短序列长度并从而提高变压器的效率. 然而,现有的符号合并方法主要依靠特征相似性来识别相类似的符号,俯瞰空间一致性,这可能会引入语义分化中的分化错误. 在这项工作中,我们提议SCMorge,一种无培训的符号合并方法,它共同考虑在对等类似符号时的特征相似性和空间一致性. 配对符随后被合并到编码器内部,由此产生的符号序列在解码后被重建到原来的补丁网格上. 拟议的方法是灵活的,可以插入现有的以变形器为基础的语义分解管道. 对基准数据集ADE20K,Pascal Context,和Cityscapes的广泛实验表明,SCMorge在分解精度和效率之间始终比基准方法实现更好的取舍.

articles.title: DIAL: Dynamic and Informed Adjustment of the Native Stochastic Law for Reliable Weather Ensembles
articles.content: Ensemble weather forecasts can look reliable in global averages while hiding too little spread in some cases and too much in others. These errors vary across variables, spatial scales, lead times, and weather states. Adapting randomness during forecasting can correct these errors, but training fixes stochastic behavior beforehand and output calibration acts afterward. Inference guidance also acts during forecasting, but typically scores ensemble members separately rather than the ensemble as a whole. Reliability feedback arrives at the end, and tracing it backward through many chaotic forecast steps is expensive and unstable. We therefore introduce Dynamic and Informed Adjustment of the Native Stochastic Law (DIAL), which controls a frozen model's native stochasticity. DIAL learns from past forecasts to predict whether each variable and scale needs more or less spread. As a forecast develops, it estimates how possible noise changes will affect later forecast accuracy and reliability. It combines these predictions to make small noise updates at each step. This loop avoids retraining the weather model and full backpropagation through the forecast. We evaluate DIAL on FourCastNet 3 (FCN3) using later ERA5 years unseen during training. DIAL provides better scale-resolved reliability than learned postprocessing and reward-based control baselines. Relative to the unmodified Native FCN3 reference, DIAL achieves an 8.27% improvement in the primary multiscale continuous ranked probability score (CRPS).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DIAL: 动态和知情地调整关于可靠天气组合的原生结构法
articles.content_zh: 汇总的天气预报在全球平均数中可以看起来可靠,而在某些情况中隐藏的传播太少,在另一些情况中则太少。 这些错误因变量、空间尺度、准备时间和天气状况而异。 在预报中适应随机性可以纠正这些错误,但训练事先纠正了有花样的行为,然后输出校正行为. 推论指导在预测期间也起作用,但一般会分别评分综艺成员而不是综艺. 可靠性反馈到达了终点,通过许多混乱的预测步骤来追溯到后方是昂贵和不稳定的. 因此,我们引入了动态和知情调整土著施托克斯特克法(DIAL),它控制了被冻结的模型的土著作风. DIAL从过去的预测中吸取了教训来预测每个变量和尺度是否需要多或少的分布. 随着预测的发展,它估计可能发生的噪声变化将如何影响以后的预测准确性和可靠性. 它结合了这些预测,在每个步骤上进行小噪声更新. 这个循环避免了天气模型的再培训,并通过预报完全回传. 我们在FourCastNet 3(FCN3)上利用培训期间所未见的晚年ERA5评价DIAL。 DIAL提供比所学的后处理和基于奖励的控制基线更好的规模解决方案可靠性. 相对于未经修改的原生FCN3参考,DIAL在初级多级连续分级概率分数(CRPS)上取得了8.27%的改进.

articles.title: Spurious Attention Heads in Vision Transformers: Mechanistic Identification of Annotation-Driven Bias in Medical Chest X-Ray Analysis
articles.content: Vision Transformers deployed in medical imaging exploit spurious correlations, yet the internal mechanisms remain unidentified and impossible to fix. We apply mechanistic interpretability to locate one such mechanism in ViT-Base 16: a single attention head (L8H10) that functions as a dedicated annotation-reader on chest X-rays, attending to corner text rather than lung pathology in 62% of 200 COVID-19 images. Causal validation via inpainting confirms annotation content rather than luminance or edge density drives the behaviour, increasing lung attention 1.52 times upon removal in affected images ($p{<}0.0001$). The finding replicates across NIH ChestX-ray14 (79%), DeiT-Base (88%), and ViT-Large 16 (80%), establishing spurious annotation-attending heads as a consistent property of ViT-family architectures across two datasets and three architectures. Full fine-tuning does not suppress the behaviour and may entrench it: 98.4% of spurious images remain spurious and the spurious rate rises marginally, as the shortcut is reinforced rather than removed. Critically, single-head ablation produces $p{=}0.340$ and multi-head ablation of all three identified carriers produces $p{=}0.532$, meaning a causally verified annotation-reading circuit is completely invisible to output-level evaluation. Mechanistic auditing finds what behavioural testing cannot.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视觉变换器中的纯洁关注头目:医学胸X射线分析中的注解-Driven Bias的机械识别
articles.content_zh: 在医疗成像中部署的视觉变形器利用了虚假的关联,然而内部机制仍然不明朗并无法修复. 我们运用机械解释能力在ViT-Base 16中找到一个这样的机制:一个单一的注意头(L8H10),它作为胸X射线的专用注释读取器发挥作用,在200个COVID-19图像中,62%的图像中注意角文本而不是肺病. 通过印花进行因果关系验证,证实注解内容,而不是发光或边缘密度,促使行为发生,使受影响图像的肺注意力增加1.52倍(0.0001美元)。 该发现在NIH ChestX-ray14(79%),DeiT-Base(88%)和ViT-Large 16(80%)之间复制,将虚伪的注解取出头作为ViT-家族架构的一致属性,跨越了两个数据集和三个架构. 全面微调并不能抑制行为,并可能使其根深蒂固:98.4%的虚假图像仍然虚假,而虚假率稍有上升,因为快捷方式得到了加强而不是去除。 关键是,单头通航产生0.340美元,所有三个识别载体的多头通航产生0.532美元,即因果核实的注读回路对输出级评价来说是完全看不见的。 机械审计发现行为测试是无法做到的。

articles.title: Anchor3DGS: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Compact Anchor-Based Representation
articles.content: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have enabled effective multi-view 3D reconstruction by predicting Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass. However, existing approaches predominantly adopt a pixel-aligned paradigm that predicts one Gaussian per input pixel, coupling the Gaussian count to the input resolution and number of views. This also leads to redundant primitives in textureless regions and insufficient coverage in geometrically complex areas. We present Anchor3DGS, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces pixel-aligned prediction with a compact anchor-based representation. Guided by information entropy, our method places a set of 3D anchors in the scene, concentrating them in regions of higher visual complexity while maintaining broad spatial coverage. Each anchor performs occlusion-aware aggregation of multi-view image features, exchanges information with other anchors, and is decoded into a set of local Gaussians. A lightweight feature enhancement module further refines the coarse RGB output from Gaussian splatting and improves rendering fidelity. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that our Anchor3DGS achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis quality while only using an order of magnitude fewer Gaussian primitives.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Anchor3DGS: 种子前导 3D 高斯平板电脑与基于契约的Anchor代表制
articles.content_zh: 近期的Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)方法通过在单个前传中预言高斯原始人,使得多视图3D重建有效. 然而,现有方法主要采用像素相通的范式,预测每个输入像素有一个高斯人,将高斯人计数与输入分辨率和视图数相接. 这也导致无纹理地区出现冗余原始人,几何复杂地区覆盖不足. 我们提出Anchor3DGS,这是一个无外观的Feed-forward 3DGS框架,用紧凑的锚地代表取代像素相通的预测. 以信息 en为取向,我们的方法将一组3D锚地放入现场,将其集中在视觉复杂程度较高的区域,同时保持了广泛的空间覆盖. 每个主播都进行多视图图像特征的隐蔽-意识聚合,与其他主播交换信息,并被解码为一组本地高斯人. 轻量级特性增强模块可进一步完善高斯电镀出粗糙的RGB输出并改进渲染忠诚. 对各种基准数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的Anchor3DGS实现了最先进的新颖视图合成质量,而只使用数量级的更少的高斯原始人.

articles.title: Training-Free Target-Aware Refinement of 3D Gaussian Language Map
articles.content: Distilling vision-language features into 3D Gaussian Splatting yields a language map that can be queried with arbitrary text. In deployment, however, a small set of user-specified targets must be reliably located, which current distilled maps often miss, while open-vocabulary queryability for other words must remain intact. We propose a training-free, target-aware refinement of an already-distilled language map. Guided by a text-promptable segmenter, the visual embedding inside each detected target region is blended with the target text embedding, a convex combination whose coefficient sets the amount of injected prior, while non-target regions are left untouched. Injecting too much overwrites appearance cues and general queryability, so we seek, for each target, the smallest coefficient that still lets it win, and we obtain every coefficient in closed form, leaving no hyperparameters to tune. We further identify a failure mode of injection in language-goal localization. Text embeddings share a common component, and injecting them makes the standard cosine read-out query-agnostic, which a centering step in the read-out removes. Across three benchmarks, the refinement consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation, roughly doubling the base mIoU on Replica, and localizes language goals more reliably than the base map. It also transfers as a plug-in to off-the-shelf field-based and object-level language maps and supports a real-world demonstration in which a legged robot navigates to natural-language goals. Project page and code: https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/target-aware-langmap/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 3D高斯语言地图的完善
articles.content_zh: 将视觉语言特性分解为3D高斯平板化生成一个语言地图,可以任意文本来询问. 然而,在部署时,必须可靠地找到一套针对用户的小型目标,而目前所提取的地图往往漏掉,而其他单词的开放-vobulary可查询性必须保持不变。 我们建议对已经过时的语言地图进行无培训的、目标明确的改进。 以文本速成分解器为指针,将每个被检测出的目标区域内的可视嵌入与目标文本嵌入相混合,一个对流组合,其系数设定了之前被注入的量,而非目标区域则未受影响. 注射过多地覆盖了外观提示和一般的可查询性,所以我们为每个目标寻求最小的系数,使其仍然能取胜,我们以封闭的形式获得每一个系数,没有超参数来调谐. 我们还确定了语文目标本地化的失败注射方式。 文本嵌入具有共同的组件,并注入它们使得标准余弦读出查询-可知性,这是读出中的一个中心步骤去除. 在三项基准中,改进不断改进了开放式省分,在复制版上将mIoU的基数翻了一番,使语言目标更加可靠。 它还作为插件传输到现成的场地和对象级语言地图,并支持一个真实世界的演示,由一条腿的机器人导航到自然语言目标. 项目网页和代码:https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/target-aware-langmap/

articles.title: A Decision-Aware Evaluation Protocol for Uncertainty in Medical Image Segmentation
articles.content: Medical segmentation uncertainty is often evaluated with calibration error or pixel-level error-detection scores, but these metrics do not show whether uncertainty improves downstream review decisions. We propose a decision-aware evaluation protocol that separates uncertainty estimation from deferral policy and evaluates their combination under fixed review budgets: which pixels, regions, or images should be accepted, and which should be reviewed. The protocol reports fixed-budget error reduction, risk-coverage behaviour, region-level review proxies, structural failure modes, probability-derived baselines, and sensitivity to review assumptions. We instantiate it across retinal vessel, skin lesion, and polyp segmentation with multiple backbones and uncertainty estimators. Under matched inference budgets and canonical multi-layer MC Dropout, test-time augmentation (TTA) gives a stronger error-detection signal across matched MC--TTA comparisons, including architecture and dropout-placement checks. However, estimator rankings are not universal. For example, probability-derived scores remain competitive, deep ensembles can outperform TTA, learned deferral helps mainly when the base estimator is weak, and rankings can change with review unit, uncertainty target, correction assumptions, and cost model. Structural and second-observer analyses further show that boundary and thin-structure failures are partly tied to annotation ambiguity. These findings support evaluating uncertainty as an estimator-policy-review configuration, not as a standalone score map. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Uncertainity-in-Medical-Image-Segmentation/README.md
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 医疗图像分解不确定性的知情决定评估协议
articles.content_zh: 医学分解的不确定性常被用校正误差或像素级出错-检测分数来评价,但这些度量不表明不确定性是否改善了下游审查决定. 我们提议一项了解决定的评价议定书,将不确定性估计与推迟政策区分开来,并根据固定审查预算评估二者的组合:哪些像素、区域或图像应当被接受,哪些应当被审查。 协议报告固定预算误差减少、风险覆盖行为、区域一级审查代理、结构故障模式、概率基准以及对审查假设的敏感性。 我们通过视网膜血管、皮肤损伤 和多管分化 与多管骨干和不确定的判断器进行即时分析 在相应的推论预算和教条多层MC Dropout下,测试时间增强(TTA)在相应的MC--TTA比较中提供了更强大的出错检测信号,包括结构和出错位置检查. 然而,估计排名并不普遍. 例如,概率得出的分数仍然具有竞争力,深层综艺可以超过TTA,所学的延后主要在基数估计器弱时有所帮助,排名随审查单位,不确定性目标,校正假设和成本模型而变化. 结构和第二观测者分析进一步表明,边界和薄结构故障部分与注释模糊有关。 这些调查结果支持将不确定性评价为一种衡量-政策-审查配置,而不是一个独立的分数图。 代码:https://anonymous.4open.science/r/unsureity-in-Medical-Image-Sclumentation/README.md.

articles.title: Hear, Localize, and Reason: Spatially Aware Scene Understanding for Audio-Visual LLMs
articles.content: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) have made strong progress in multimodal understanding, yet most treat audio as monaural semantic content, limiting their ability to reason about where sounds originate and how they relate to the visual scene. Recent spatial audio-visual studies address parts of this problem, but often focus on specific abilities, such as spatial correspondence or direction and distance reasoning. In this work, we introduce HLR-AVSceneQA, a comprehensive benchmark with a hear-localize-reason hierarchy that evaluates whether models can recognize what is heard, localize sound sources in egocentric and allocentric views, and use these localized sources to reason about how they relate to the visual scene. We further introduce HLR-LLM, which augments a strong audio-visual foundation model with a binaural spatial audio branch alongside its monaural semantic audio pathway. We train HLR-LLM with a curriculum that incorporates final-stage chain-of-thought supervision for multi-step spatial reasoning. Experiments show that existing AV-LLMs remain limited in spatial grounding and relational reasoning, while HLR-LLM substantially improves spatial audio-visual scene understanding without compromising semantic audio-visual perception.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 倾听、定位和理由:对视听课程的空间认知场景理解
articles.content_zh: 视听大型语言模型(AV-LLMs)在多模式理解上取得了显著进展,然而大多数将音频视为一元语义内容,限制了他们解释声音发源地和与视觉场景的关系的能力. 近期的空间视听研究针对了这个问题的部分内容,但往往侧重于特定的能力,如空间通信或方向和距离推理等. 在这部作品中,我们引入了HLR-AVSceneQA,这是一个具有听觉本地化-理性分级的综合基准,它评价模型是否能够识别所听到的,将声音源本地化为以自负为中心,以异心为中心的观点,并利用这些本地化的源来解释它们与视觉场景的关系. 我们进一步引入了HLR-LLM,它增加了一个强大的视听基础模型,其二元空间音频分支与其元语义音频路径相并列. 我们用一个课程来培训HLR-LLM,该课程包含对多步骤空间推理的最后阶段思维链监督。 实验表明,现有的AV-LLM在空间地平面和关系推理方面仍然有限,而HLR-LLM在不损害语义视听感知的情况下大幅度地改进了空间视听场景理解.

articles.title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
articles.content: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique signal. Our experiments further demonstrate that these structured and interpretable outputs improve the verifier's generalization to out-of-domain multimodal critic tasks. To train this verifier, we introduce a Decoupled RL training strategy that jointly optimizes sub-question-level binary judgment and global alignment scoring, using precise local feedback to develop fine-grained verification capabilities that provide a foundation for reliable continuous scoring at the global level. Under a general reinforcement learning framework, we first empirically demonstrate that the proposed pointwise graded verifier significantly outperforms binary verifiers in traditional text-to-image scenarios. We then extend our investigation to rule-governed generative world modeling where generative models are leveraged for world simulation and world reasoning under explicit rules. From a theoretical standpoint, we further show that a pairwise verification paradigm yields more accurate critiques than the pointwise formulation when ground-truth images are available, with empirical results on diverse structured world-modeling tasks such as Maze and Sudoku further validating the effectiveness of our approach. Overall, our findings suggest a key insight: the transition from generative models to structured world-modeling agents critically hinges on the availability of accurate pairwise graded visual verifiers.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OmniVerifer-C1:规则管理基因世界模型的分级验证器
articles.content_zh: 基因视觉核查器在推进多式智能方面发挥着关键作用。 为了在涉及组成要求的复杂多式情景中加强视觉核查员的稳健性,我们超越了仅产生True/False离散判断的常规二进制核查员,并引入了自动将复杂提示或环境规则分解为精细分量的核查员,并按点定分,以提供连续和更加翔实的批评信号。 我们的实验进一步表明,这些结构化和可解释的产出改进了核查者对域外多式联运评论任务的概括。 为了培训这一核查员,我们采用了脱钩的RL培训战略,联合优化子问题层面的二进制判断和全球对等评分,利用准确的当地反馈来发展精细的核查能力,为全球一级可靠的连续评分奠定基础。 在一般的强化学习框架内,我们首先以经验证明,在传统的文本到图像的假设中,拟议的分级核查器大大超过二进制核查器。 然后,我们把调查扩大到统治基因世界的模型,根据明确的规则,利用基因模型进行世界模拟和世界推理。 从理论角度看,我们进一步表明,双向核查范式产生的评论比地面真实图像出现时的直指表述更准确,在马兹和数都等各种结构化的世界模型任务上的经验结果进一步证实了我们的方法的有效性。 总而言之,我们的调查结果提出了一个关键的见解:从基因模型向结构化的世界模型化剂的过渡,关键取决于能否获得准确的对等分级视觉核查器。

articles.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
articles.content: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FDE-Gym: AI交付的最后一英里
articles.content_zh: 现有代理人基准通常对代理人进行关于问题报告、规格或任务票所界定明确任务的评价。 现实世界的客户交付方式不同:前向部署的工程师(FDEs)必须澄清模棱两可的要求,在活地系统工作,并发现未说明的限制. 我们介绍了FDE-Gym,这是从18个行业的20个客户设想中得出的95个端到端交付任务的基准,每一个都由来自现实世界交付项目的行业专家加以调整。 在与脚本利益攸关方和可修改客户系统的模拟客户环境中,代理商与利益攸关方互动,并在类似生产系统上运作,以提供可行的解决方案。 FDE-Gym通过如何改善客户自身成功度量表来评分一次交付,在0(未更改系统)和1(参考解决方案)之间实现常态化,对利益攸关方互动(信息、试运行和等待时间)进行处罚。 一个在线平台允许人类在相同的分级标准下练习FDE技能. 我们从七个供应商那里评估13个模型配置。 在现实环境下,在必须发现未说明限制的情况下,最佳配置能实现平均FDE-Gym分0.56分,并只解决了95个任务中的14个(至少0.8分而无出事). 发现未说明的制约因素是主要的瓶颈:当模型必须在没有明确指导的情况下发现这些制约因素时,性能会急剧下降。 然而,仅凭信息发现并不能说明存在差距:即使在最佳配置能从利益攸关方获得每个关键事实的23项任务上,它也只使10项业务正常上升0.8或以上。 这些结果表明,在解决明确的任务和为真正的客户提供有效的人工识别系统之间存在着很大差距。

articles.title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. Further experiments show that MLExpert improves performance on NatureBench Lite, agent scaffold optimization, and algorithm optimization, suggesting that the learned optimization capability generalizes to other tasks.

articles.title_zh: MLExpert:面向自主机器学习工程的通用代理模型
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型正在从协助科学研究和工程发展到自主发展和改进人工智能系统,推动人工智能(AI4AI)作为实现递归自我改进的途径。 由工作流程驱动的机器学习工程(MLE)系统通过复杂的管弦乐管理长视实验,为这种追求提供了一条实用的道路;而最近的MLE系统则采用模型定向交互,使模型能够根据执行反馈自主地组织实验并调整优化策略. 然而,每次实验的反馈都反映了之前的几项决定,长期劳动与就业部的运行包含着许多如此昂贵的实验. 因此,培训必须从长期互动轨道中选择有用的监督,并学习中间结果。 我们提出了自主长视距MLE优化的后训练方法,并应用于培训MLExpert,即35B型相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 我们设计了Kaggle-MLE工厂,以构建可执行的任务和用于模型定向实验的交互控制。 分级代理SFT通过结果指导监督将一般工具使用和编码能力转移给MLE. Windowsed Interactive RL(WIRL)将相继实验结果之间的多回合决定作为执行窗口,并赋予它共享基于结果的奖励. 在轨迹结束前同步收集和政策修正支持政策更新。 在MLE-Bench Lite上,MLExpert将基模的平均奖牌率从37.9%提高到72.7%,实现性能与更大型的前沿模型相媲美,如Kimi-K3和GLM-5.3. 进一步的实验表明,MLExpert改进了Nature Bench Lite上的性能,代理脚手架优化,以及算法优化,说明所学到的优化能力概括到其他任务.

articles.title: Evaluation Awareness Beyond English: Do LLMs Act Differently When Tested in Indic Languages?
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) can often tell when they are being tested. This ability, known as evaluation awareness, can lead models to act more cautiously during safety evaluations than in real use. Existing work has studied evaluation awareness almost entirely in English, although models serve users in many languages. Indic languages are spoken by over a billion people, yet evaluation awareness remains almost entirely unstudied in them. We test four instruction-tuned models from three families in five Indic languages alongside English. A set of cues varies whether the model is told that it is monitored and whether the monitoring is a safety test. Models refuse harmful requests more often when they are told that they are being tested. This increase appears in all four models and all six languages. In Indic languages, refusal of harmful requests rises by 14.4 percentage points on average. The test cue also brings Indic refusal of harmful requests level with English, but raises refusal of benign Indic requests from 6.9% to 11.3%. We release all 47,880 judged responses to support further work. These results suggest that safety evaluations in Indic languages may not reflect how models treat their everyday users.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 评估意识超越英语:在接受印度语测试时,LLMS是否不同?
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)在测试时往往可以分辨出. 这种能力称为评价意识,可以引导模型在安全评价期间比实际使用时更谨慎地采取行动。 现有工作几乎完全用英语研究评价意识,尽管模型服务于许多语言的用户. 超过10亿人使用印度语,但评价意识却几乎完全没有得到研究。 我们用5种印地语和英语测试3个家庭的4个教学调整模型。 一套提示方式不同,是否告诉模型被监测,以及监测是否是安全测试. 模特儿在被告知自己正在接受测试时会更经常地拒绝有害的请求. 在所有四种模式和所有六种语言中都出现了这种增加。 在印地语中,拒绝有害要求的平均增加14.4%。 测试提示还使Indic拒绝英语的有害请求,但将拒绝良性Indic请求的比例从6.9%提高到11.3%。 我们公布所有47 880项经判断的答复,以支持进一步的工作。 这些结果表明,印地语的安全评价可能无法反映模型如何对待日常用户。

articles.title: Twice Upon a Time: Complementary Representations for Time-Series Reasoning
articles.content: Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) enable language-based understanding and reasoning over temporal data, yet a fundamental question remains: what information should their time-series representations preserve, and what variation should they factor out? Existing TSLMs typically expose the language model to a single representation, imposing a fixed inductive bias across downstream tasks. We instead introduce complementary representations as a design principle for time-series reasoning. Our model combines two visual views: line plots preserve absolute measurements and the observed coordinate frame, while normalized delay embeddings factor out positive amplitude rescaling and offsets while exposing temporal structure. Dedicated visual encoders integrate both views into a shared language model through visual tokens and multi-level feature fusion. Evaluation-time interventions verify that the two views exhibit distinct invariance profiles, while single-view ablations show that their combination is particularly beneficial beyond basic perception, with the large gains in prediction and reasoning. Built on Qwen3-VL-8B, our dual-view model improves overall TSRBench accuracy from 44.5% with line plots alone to 53.2%, substantially exceeding the strongest evaluated dedicated TSLM baseline at 36.7%. It further achieves 89.9% accuracy on TSExam and 86.8% numerical accuracy on multivariate ChatTS alignment. Together, these results demonstrate that complementary representations provide an effective design principle for general-purpose TSLMs, enabling models to exploit temporal structure without sacrificing access to the original measurement frame.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一次两次:时间序列说明的补充说明
articles.content_zh: 时间序列语言模型(TSLMs)使得基于语言的理解和推理能够超越时间数据,然而一个根本问题仍然存在:它们的时间序列表达应保留哪些信息,它们应顾及哪些变化? 现有的TSLMs通常将语言模型暴露为单一的表示,在下游任务中施加了固定的导出偏差. 相反,我们采用了补充陈述作为时间序列推理的设计原则。 我们的模型结合了两种视觉观点:行地图保留了绝对测量和被观测到的坐标框架,而正常的延迟则嵌入了正振幅回升和抵消因素,同时暴露出时间结构. 专用可视化编码器通过可视化符号和多层次特征聚变,将两种观点整合为共享语言模型. 评价时间干预证实两种观点呈现出截然不同的不一致特征,而单一观点的浮出水面则表明,两者的结合在基本认知之外特别有益,在预测和推理方面大有收获。 我们的双视模型建于Quen3-VL-8B上,将TSR Bench的整体精度从单线地块的44.5%提高到53.2%,大大地超过了36.7%的经评价的最强专用TSLM基线。 它进一步在TSExam上实现了89.9%的精度,在多变量的ChatTS对齐上实现了86.8%的精度. 这些结果共同表明,互补表述为通用TSLMs提供了一个有效的设计原则,使模型能够利用时间结构而不牺牲对原始计量框架的利用。

articles.title: Training Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas
articles.content: One of the first steps of a research pipeline is generating ideas. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate this step, but most of this work optimizes the quality of individual ideas, while overlooking diversity. In our work, we study document-grounded ideation, focusing on increasing the diversity of LLM generated ideas and ensuring they are high quality. Given prior papers, a model must propose a set of ideas that are each high-quality and clearly distinct from one another, while also being grounded in the input documents. To optimize for this, we propose training with a set-level reinforcement learning objective. In our setup, in a single generation, the model writes K structured idea cards grounded in the source papers, and the set is scored jointly, where each idea's quality is weighted by its distance from the ideas written before it. This teaches the model to steer each new idea away from its predecessors. We show that our trained 8B model achieves higher creative utility (a measure combining quality and diversity) than Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-6 Astra on our contamination-free benchmark. In a pilot human study with four experts, our sets are judged as promising as Claude Opus 4.8's and contain marginally more unique ideas. When a coding agent runs proof-of-concept experiments on the ideas, our model's success@k is comparable to Claude Opus 4.8's, so we see that the added diversity does not cost any executability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 产生不同科学思想的培训理由模型
articles.content_zh: 研究管道的最初步骤之一是产生想法。 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地被用来自动化这个步骤,但大部分作品优化了个人思想的质量,同时忽略了多样性. 在我们的工作中,我们研究以文件为基础的思想,重点是增加LLM所产生的思想的多样性,并确保这些思想的质量。 鉴于以前的文件,一个模式必须提出一套想法,这些想法都是高质量的,彼此明显不同,同时也以投入文件为基础。 为了优化这项工作,我们建议进行培训,并设定加强学习的目标。 在我们的设定中,在一代人中,模型会写出K结构化的思想卡,以源论文为基础,而集被联合打分,其中每个思想的质量会根据其与所写思想的距离来加权. 这教导了这个模式将每个新思想从前作中引出. 我们显示,我们训练有素的8B模型比克洛德·奥普斯·4.8和GPT-6 Astra在无污染基准上更具有创造性。 在一次由四名专家参与的试验性人类研究中,我们的套装被评为与克洛德·奥普斯4.8的套装一样有前途并含有略微更独特的想法. 当一个编码代理对这些想法进行概念证明实验时,我们模型的成功@k可以和克洛德·奥普斯4.8的相当,因此我们看到增加的多样性并不花费任何可执行性.

articles.title: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
articles.content: The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training (MPT), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. With the same post-trained action policies, learned self-orchestration outperforms alternative coordination strategies. Ablations show that both action and bidding benefit from learning, and that learned bids provide more effective action-training signals. Beyond the original training objectives, trained swarms adapt faster to related tasks and achieve better performance with larger populations at inference time. Larger populations also suffer smaller performance losses under agent dropout, demonstrating that learned self-orchestration supports reuse, scaling, and robustness in decentralized agent swarms. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/Embodied-Minds-Lab/MPT.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习分散代理斯瓦尔姆的自律
articles.content_zh: 代理人群的能力取决于其个别成员及其协调方式。 然而,现有的多代理系统常常在固定的管弦结构内训练代理,将个人能力的学习与集体行为的组织区分开来. 我们采用基于市场的培训后(MPT),这是在分散的代理人群中联合学习行动政策和自我约束的框架。 代理商表示愿意通过投标参与,由投标人决定谁采取行动,集体结果如何提供当地培训信贷。 学习行动和投标行为可以使个人的能力和参与模式在没有中央协调机构的情况下共同适应。 我们评估MPT的内含工艺、机器人导航和深入研究。 结果表明,在单一的后培训方面有所收获,并证实代理人的参与确实随着学习而演变。 通过同样的训练后行动政策,学会的自我管理优于其他协调战略。 差距表明,行动和投标都从学习中受益,学到的投标提供了更有效的行动培训信号。 除了最初的培训目标外,受过培训的一群人更快地适应相关任务,并在推断时间与更多的人取得更好的业绩。 较多的人口还因毒剂流失而遭受较小的性能损失,这表明在分散的毒剂群中,学得的自整能支持再利用、扩大规模和稳健性。 守则和训练有素的模型可在https://github.com/Embody-Minds-Lab/MPT上查阅。

articles.title: MindEval2: Clinically Grounded Patients and Rubrics for Evaluating Language Models in Mental Health Support
articles.content: With people increasingly turning to AI chatbots for mental health support, the need to evaluate these tools is becoming more pressing. Recent benchmarks attempt to mimic a realistic setting by simulating multi-turn interactions with synthetic patients and evaluating them with an LLM-as-a-judge. However, the usefulness of these methods is limited because simulated patients can be overly forthcoming and self-reflective, and judgments typically involve opaque Likert scales with unclear practical utility. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MindEval2, an evaluation framework that consists of two components: Mental Health Quality Rubrics (MHQR), for evaluation, and MindSim, for patient simulation. For MHQR, we collaborate with PhD-level psychologists to develop a set of rubrics that break down response quality into explicit operational criteria that are more interpretable and actionable than existing evaluation taxonomies. MindSim, in turn, is an LLM harness that combines carefully-designed patient profiles with tools, enabling more varied, challenging, and realistic interactions than existing baselines. The harness also contains a memory component that is updated between each interaction, enabling MindEval2 to model the longitudinal aspect of mental health. We evaluate 18 proprietary and open-weight models on MindEval2, finding that while frontier models have largely improved on issues related to surface level quality and boundaries, guidance calibration remains the dominant failure mode across all models, accounting for most of the quality gap.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MindEval2:在心理健康支助中评估语言模型的临床上基于临床的病人和Rubrics
articles.content_zh: 随着人们越来越多地转向AI聊天机器人寻求心理健康支持,对这些工具进行评估的必要性变得越来越迫切. 最近的基准试图模仿现实环境,模拟与合成病人的多回合互动,并以LLM-as-a-judge来评价他们。 然而,这些方法的实用性有限,因为模拟病人可能过于主动和自我反射,判断通常涉及不透明的相像尺度,实用性不明确. 为了弥补这些差距,我们引入了MindEval2,一个包含两个组成部分的评价框架:用于评价的心理健康质量Rubrics(MHQR)和用于患者模拟的MindSim. 对MHQR来说,我们与博士级心理学家合作,开发出一套将反应质量分解成比现有评价分类更为可解释和可采取行动的明确操作标准的标题. MindSim反过来是一个LLM控制器,它将精心设计的病人剖面图和工具结合起来,使得互动比现有的基线更多样化,更具挑战性和现实性. 牵引装置还包含每个相互作用之间被更新的记忆组件,使MindEval2能够模拟心理健康的纵向方面. 我们评价了MindEval2上的18个专有型和开放型模型,发现虽然前沿模型在与地表质量和边界有关的问题上大有改进,但制导校正仍然是所有模型的主要故障模式,占了质量差距的大部分.

articles.title: Grid-Bench: Can LLMs Predict How Discrete Worlds Change?
articles.content: Spatial instructions describe how to move objects, transform regions, or modify their surroundings. When several operations are applied in sequence, each acts on a configuration shaped by earlier changes. How accurately can large language models (LLMs) predict the resulting spatial state? We introduce Grid-Bench, an executable benchmark in which eight families of operations transform discrete worlds represented as two-, three-, and four-dimensional grids. Given an initial grid, explicit rules, and an event history expressed as text, a model predicts the complete final grid. Reference execution makes every predicted value checkable, supporting comparisons across spatial operations, history lengths, and workloads. Evaluating six LLMs shows that complete-state accuracy falls sharply as histories grow, with substantial divergence among models that perform similarly on single events. Models with similar exact-match accuracy can nevertheless differ substantially in the number of incorrect cells on shared instances. Even over long histories, some models recover many correct changes beyond what copying the initial state would yield. Grid-Bench makes both complete recovery and these differences in returned states directly measurable across a range of spatial conditions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 网格-奔驰:LLMS能否预测世界如何变化?.
articles.content_zh: 空间指令描述如何移动物体,改变区域,或修改其周围环境. 当多个操作被按顺序应用时,每个操作都会在由更早的变化所塑造的配置上进行. 大型语言模型(LLMs)如何准确预测由此形成的空间状态? 我们引入了Grid-Bench, 一个可执行的基准,在这个基准中,8个业务家族会改变以二,三,四维网格为代表的离散世界. 鉴于一个初始网格,明确的规则,以及一个以文字表示的事件历史,一个模型可以预测完整的最终网格. 参考执行使每个预测值都能够核对,支持空间操作、历史长度和工作量的比较。 对6个有限责任公司的评价表明,随着历史的增长,完全状态的准确性急剧下降,对单一事件同样起作用的模型之间存在很大差异。 然而,在共享实例中,准确性类似的模型在不正确的单元格数量上可能存在很大差异。 即使在漫长的历史中,一些模型恢复了许多正确的变化,超出了复制初始状态会产生的结果。 Grid-Bench使完全恢复和返回状态中的这些差异在一系列空间条件下直接可以衡量。

articles.title: Knowledge That Is Linear Before Fine-Tuning Generalizes After It
articles.content: Not all facts a language model can recall support further learning equally well. We distinguish active facts, which support generalization beyond their own recall, from inert facts, which can be recalled but do not support such generalization in a given task. We study this distinction by constructing new relations from existing ones. Take the relation that maps a place to its continent (Paris -> Europe) and assign each of its answers an arbitrary new label (Europe -> crab, Asia -> zebra). The new relation then maps Paris -> crab. We fine-tune the model on the new relation for a subset of subjects, without telling it the original relation or the relabeling rule, and test whether it assigns the corresponding labels to held-out subjects that share an answer in the original relation. Having learned Paris -> crab, does it answer Munich -> crab? Across eleven language models and 70 relations, how linearly readable the original relation is in pretrained representations strongly predicts this generalization. Within each model, the two correlate across relations at Pearson r = 0.87 to 0.92. This association persists when controlling, separately and jointly, for the number of fine-tuning subjects and answers, the model's accuracy on the original relation, and how often the subjects occur in pretraining text. It is also robust to re-randomizing the label assignment and fine-tuning seed, and to replacing the animal labels with labels from thirteen other semantic categories. When we map a fine-tuned model's wrong label back to the original answer it was assigned to, Munich -> zebra becomes Munich -> Asia. Answers recovered this way are more often among the linear probe's top answers for the subject than among the pretrained model's own. Whether a new relation generalizes depends less on whether its facts can be recalled than on how readily their shared structure can be read out linearly.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 知识是线性 之前的精益通俗化
articles.content_zh: 并不是所有的事实,一个语言模型都可以回忆起支持进一步学习的同样良好。 我们把支持超越自身记忆的概括性实际与惰性事实区分开来,前者可以回顾,但并不支持在特定任务中作这样的概括性。 我们通过从现有关系中建立新关系来研究这种区别。 取其大陆(巴黎- > 欧洲)的地标,并为每个答案指定一个任意的新标签(欧洲- > 螃蟹、亚洲- > 斑马)。 新的关系然后映射出巴黎 - > 螃蟹。 我们微调一个子集主题新关系上的模型,而不告诉它原始关系或再贴标签规则,并测试它是否为在原始关系上共享答案的被搁置对象指定了相应的标签. 学会了巴黎->螃蟹,它回答慕尼黑->螃蟹吗? 纵观11个语言模型和70个关系,原始关系如何线性可读,在被预先训练的表示中,强烈地预言了这种概括. 在每种模式中,两者在Pearson r = 0.87至 0.92 的相互关系。 这种联系在分别和联合控制微调主题和答案的数量、模型在原始关系的准确性以及在培训前文本中发生这些主题的频率时持续存在。 重新随机分配标签和微调种子,用其他13个语义类的标签来取而代之,这也非常有力。 当我们将一个经过微调的模型错误的标签映射回原答案时,慕尼黑 - > 斑马变成了慕尼黑 - > 亚洲。 以这种方式恢复的答案在线性探测器对对象的顶端答案中比在被预先训练的模型自己的答案中更常见. 新的关系是否概括,与其说取决于它的事实是否可以被召回,倒不如说取决于它们的共同结构是否能够被线性地读出。

articles.title: AI Consilium: a Benchmark of LLM Clinical Multidisciplinary Second Opinions
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. Eight single-model pipelines generated independent role-specific opinions and interactive-consilium reports under free-form and structured clinical-reasoning conditions. A physician-calibrated LLM Judge evaluated 3,040 final reports and the corresponding structured primary-role outputs. Model identity separated report quality more strongly than response format. Structured final reports had higher overall mean scores in seven of eight model pipelines, with their clearest advantage in management (2.740 vs. 2.436). Compared with the structured pre-consilium primary-role opinion, the complete structured synthesis had higher pooled scores across all five shared criteria, with the largest increases in problem prioritization, factual grounding, and reasoning coherence. GPT-5.6-Sol led every evaluated component and reached consensus in the fewest review rounds. These findings show that the benchmark can distinguish model capability, the contribution of multidisciplinary synthesis, criterion-specific effects of response structure, deliberation dynamics, and inference requirements within one common-case evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AI Consilium:LLM临床多学科第二意见基准
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)可以产生对复杂病例的差别诊断,但有用的第二种意见也必须基于事实、临床一致、可操作和安全。 我们利用300起诊断性解决的NEJM-MedQA病例制定了多层面基准:110起用于医生参考评级和法官校正,190起用于暂停评价。 8个单型管线在自由形式和结构化的临床合理条件下产生独立的角色特定意见和互动-consilium报告. 一名经医生校准的LLM法官评价了3 040份最后报告和相应的结构化初级作用产出。 模式身份分离报告的质量比反应格式更强。 结构化最后报告在8个示范管道中的7个管道的总体平均分数较高,在管理方面具有最明显的优势(2.740对2.436)。 与结构化的组合前主要作用意见相比,完整的结构化综合在所有5个共同标准中集合得分较高,问题优先排序、事实依据和推理一致性增加最多。 GPT-5.6-Sol领导了每一个被评价的部分,并在最少几轮审查中达成共识. 这些调查结果表明,基准可以区分模型能力、多学科综合的贡献、反应结构的具体标准影响、审议动态以及一个共同案例评价中的推断要求。

articles.title: Multi-Target Few-Shot Prompting with Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Few-shot prompting is useful when instructions and rewards are hard to specify.
