One such application is editing by example, where a demonstrated formatting change or API migration may need to be applied across multiple sites. However, such edits often depend on both left and right context, making generation with causal autoregressive models awkward. We therefore introduce multi-target few-shot prompting with diffusion language models, where examples guide the infilling of multiple masked regions within a shared canvas. To address the known challenge of reliably following demonstrations in few-shot prompting, we further leverage selective masking of the canvas to derive a likelihood-ratio reward that favors example-supported infills. Across few-shot prompting benchmarks and software refactoring case studies, we find that demonstrations improve infilling accuracy, with example guidance yielding further gains in several settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以分散语言模式推动的多目标
articles.content_zh: 当指令和奖励难以具体确定时,少发点提示是有用的。 其中一个应用程序是按例编辑,其中显示的格式变化或API迁移可能需要跨多个站点应用. 然而,这种编辑往往既取决于左上下文,也取决于右上下文,使得带有因果自递模式的生成变得尴尬. 因此,我们采用了以传播语言模式为导火索的多目标几发法,其中的实例指导在共同的画布中填充多个被蒙蔽的区域。 为了应对在几发子弹下可靠跟踪示威的已知挑战,我们进一步利用有选择地掩盖画布,以获得一种有利于以实例支持的填充量的可能性-比例奖励。 我们发现,通过几发催生基准和软件重构案例研究,演示改进了填充精度,例子指导在几个环境中产生了进一步收益。

articles.title: CAT-alyzing Honesty: Continuous Adversarial Training for Transferable LLM Honesty
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming prevalent in scenarios where honesty is critical. However, despite alignment training, these models still exhibit dishonest behaviour, such as outputting claims that contradict some knowledge or are not supported by what is accessible in context. We introduce Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty (CATCH), inspired by a method originally developed to robustly refuse harmful queries. CATCH trains the model towards an honest answer and away from a dishonest one while maintaining the model's capabilities. We evaluate two architectures (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3-3.6-27B). We show that trained with only hundreds of targets built from self-reporting scenarios, CATCH learns an honest behaviour that robustly generalizes and transfers across distinct benchmarks. It consistently reduces dishonesty under pressure on MASK, increases confessions in the multi-agent game of Among Us, and improves the discovery rates of the model's hidden behaviours in AuditBench. We show that CATCH outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning in improving honesty, and it is on par with state-of-the-art honesty activation steering. However, CATCH surpasses honesty steering in maintaining utility, thanks to a novel choice of utility data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CAT-分析诚实:可转让LLM的持续横向培训 诚实
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在诚实至关重要的情景中正变得普遍. 然而,尽管进行了校正培训,这些模式仍然表现出不诚实的行为,例如提出与某些知识相矛盾或得不到背景可获取内容支持的诉求。 我们引进了 " 一致诚实的持续横向培训 " (CATCH),其灵感来自最初为强烈拒绝有害询问而开发的方法。 CATCH将模型训练为诚实的答案,并远离不诚实的答案,同时保持模型的能力. 我们评价两个建筑(Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct和Qune3-3.6-27B). 我们显示,经过培训的只有数百个从自我报告设想中制定的目标,CATCH学习了一种诚实的行为,有力地概括了不同基准之间的转移。 它在MASCK的压力下持续地减少不诚实,在"我们之间"的多代理游戏中增加口供,并提升了该模型在"审计本奇"中隐藏行为的发现率. 我们显示,CATCH在提高诚实性方面表现优于激励和监督的微调,它与最先进的诚实性激活方向相同。 然而,由于对公用数据作出了新的选择,CATCH在维持公用方面超越了诚实指导。

articles.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
articles.content: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 图书馆代理: 培训LLMs 以 Curate 长文本工作空间,以预想未来查询
articles.content_zh: 对大型语言模型来说,由于文件篇幅长的原因仍然是一项挑战。 标准检索方法本质上是被动反应的,在推论时间带有复杂,跨文件推理的阻滞剂,而预估结构如知识图往往因为依赖僵硬的heuristic而不足. 相反,我们是否可以允许代理人进行预告性的指导性治疗:在推断前学会主动重组无结构的公司,以高效地服务于各种未来的询问. 我们建立在现代代理吊带(如克洛德码)中的关键不对称基础上:虽然LLM代理在导航现有文件系统以解决即时任务方面是精通的,但是他们很少被训练来构建可再用的工作空间供将来使用. 为了即时化这种能力,我们引入了"图书代理"(Liberiary Agents),在这个框架中,一个构建者代理将原始文件转换为合成文件和参考链接的分级文件系统,它构成了适合下游响应代理的工作空间. 我们制定工作空间建设作为马尔可夫决策程序,并通过强化学习优化建设者政策,以直接最大限度地提高下游答题准确度. 经验是,图书馆代理公司在浏览Comp-Plus上比最强的检索和预计算基线高出33个百分点,通过反复查询将前期建筑成本摊还,并以31分平均精度提高的方式将零射入BRIGHT上的看不见域。

articles.title: Not X, but When: Diagnosing a Mandarin LLM Writing Tic through Contextual Appropriateness
articles.content: Recurring expressions in model-written text are often treated as signatures of machine authorship, yet most of them serve legitimate functions. Whether such an expression is a tic depends on whether the model knows when it is called for. This judgment of appropriateness, central to communicative competence, remains largely unexamined for language models. We study it through the Mandarin corrective construction bushi X, ershi Y ("not X, but Y"). Drawing on Gricean pragmatics and corrective negation, we introduce a decision tree that classifies uses as substantive, optional, or defective by testing whether the context makes X a live alternative and whether rejecting X is informative. Five commercial models use the construction 2.5 to 9.2 times as densely as a human reference. Of 307 annotated uses, only 1.30% are defective while 52.8% are optional, that is, correct but unneeded, so models fall short in appropriateness far more often than in correctness. Several reward models favor the construction even over quality-matched variants, an LLM judge favors it even where the context does not license it, and both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization tend to raise its frequency in open-weight models. We hope this work encourages the development of models attentive to the appropriateness of their expressions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 不是X,而是当: 诊断一个普通话 LLM 通过背景适中写入 Tic
articles.content_zh: 模式-书面文本中反复出现的表达方式往往被视作机器作者的签名,但大多数表达方式都具有合法功能. 这样的表达式是否是一个tic,取决于模型是否知道何时需要. 这种对适当性的判断是沟通能力的核心,对于语言模式来说,基本上还没有经过审查。 我们通过普通话的修补性建筑灌木X,ershi Y("不是X,而是Y")来研究. 我们借鉴了Gricean的务实主义和纠正性否定,引入了一个决策树,通过测试上下文是否使X成为活的替代物,拒绝X是否具有信息性,将用途归类为实质性的,可选的或有缺陷的. 5个商业模型使用构造为人类参考物的2.5至9.2倍的密度. 在307种附加说明的用途中,只有1.30%有缺陷,52.8%是可选的,即正确但不需要,因此模型在适当性方面远远低于正确性。 一些奖励模式倾向于构建,甚至优于质量匹配的变体,一个LLM评委倾向于即便在上下文不允许的情况下,它,同时监督的微调和偏好优化都倾向于在开放量模型中提高它的频率. 我们希望这项工作能鼓励开发注意其表达方式适当性的模型。

articles.title: Language Is a Security Surface for Agent Guards
articles.content: Step-level guards decide, before each tool call, whether an agent's next action is safe given the user's request and the trajectory so far. Users write those requests in many languages, while guard prompts and the benchmarks on which purpose-built guards are trained and evaluated are English. We ask whether a guard's verdict depends on the language of the request. We build LinguaGuardBench from the 1,220 labelled steps of TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj: we translate only the user instruction into German, French, Turkish, Swahili and Amharic, and keep every tool call, observation and label byte-identical, so any change in a verdict is attributable to language alone. Six English rewordings and a whitespace placebo serve as controls, and managed guards are run three times to measure their noise. Across 19 guards, from frontier APIs to 4B open models and four purpose-built agent guards, most open, small and purpose-built guards change verdicts under translation beyond their own noise floor, and the effect grows with the rarity of the language: among the nine guards below 13B parameters, the mean placebo-adjusted flip rate rises from +1.5 pp on French to +4.4 pp on Amharic. Purpose-built guards are the most sensitive. The direction of the damage tends to follow guard size: open guards of 12-30B parameters block more benign steps (up to +5.0 pp false positives), and every significant loss of recall is in a guard below 10B (up to -7.4 pp). Frontier guards shift by at most about one point; the strongest, Gemini 3.8 Flash, returns identical verdicts with and without the request. The damage is concentrated in a few instructions and, in a post-hoc analysis, falls on steps where the agent's reasoning restates the English request, consistent with guards reacting to inconsistency between channels. English paraphrase moves every guard less than translation does. We release the benchmark and all 489k verdicts.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言是守护特工的安全表面
articles.content_zh: 阶梯级警卫在每个工具调用之前,根据用户的要求和迄今为止的轨迹,决定代理人的下一个动作是否安全. 用户用多种语言撰写这些请求,而警卫提示和专门建造的警卫的训练和评价基准是英文。 我们问警卫的判决是否取决于请求的语言. 我们从TS-Bench Agent Dojo-Traj的1,220个标有符号的台阶来构建LinguaGuard Bench:我们只把用户指令翻译成德文、法文、土耳其文、斯瓦希里文和阿姆哈拉克文, 并且保留每个工具调用、观察和标有字节的同义字节,所以判决中的任何改变都只能归因于语言。 6个英文重写和1个白空安慰剂作为控制器,管理下的守卫被运行了3次来测量他们的噪音. 跨越19个卫士,从边疆API到4B开放型和4个专有特务卫士,大多数开放,小型和专有特务卫士在翻译下超越了自己的噪音地层而改变判决,效果随着语言的稀有性而增加:在低于13B参数的9个卫士中,平均安慰剂调整翻转率从法语上+1.5页上升到了阿姆哈拉克上+4.4页. 目的建造的警卫是最敏感的 破坏方向往往跟随警卫大小:12-30B参数的开口警卫会挡住更良性的步道(最高为+5.0pp假阳性),每一次严重的召回损失都在10B以下的警卫(最高为-7.4pp). 边防警卫最多转移约一分;最强者双子座 3.8 Flash,随请求或不请求而返回相同的判决. 破坏集中在几个指示上,在后浩克分析中,落在代理推理重述英方请求的步骤上,这与卫兵对频道间不一致的反应一致. 英文译文将每个警卫的动作比翻译少. 我们发布了基准 和所有489k判决。

articles.title: Training-Free On-Policy Distillation
articles.content: On-policy distillation consolidates specialist models into one student at the price of rollouts, teacher passes and gradient steps for every teacher. We show that the consolidation does not need training: with forward passes only, the capabilities of separately tuned specialists can be aggregated into one model that is, on average, more accurate than either specialist alone. When specialists share a base model, distillation has an exact layer-wise solution: each linear layer of the fused model must reproduce every specialist's output on the inputs that specialist receives while reading its own answers, a least-squares problem whose solution needs only the second moments of those inputs. One forward pass over a few hundred rollouts provides them. We call this training-free on-policy distillation (\method). What the rollouts contain matters more than the solver: answers truncated in repetition loops are few among a mathematics specialist's rollouts but carry a large share of their tokens, and removing them lifts the fused model on AIME25 from task arithmetic's level to the specialist's at matched precision. On Olmo~3 7B, a few GPU-hours of forward computation per specialist yield a generalist that keeps most of each specialist's gain on each of seven mathematics and code benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 培训 -- -- 无政策限制
articles.content_zh: 政策上提炼将专家模式整合为一名学生,其价格是推出、教师通行证和每个教师的梯度阶梯。 我们表明,合并不需要培训:只要有前行通行证,就能够将单独调整的专家的能力汇总成一个模式,平均而言,这个模式比任何一个专家都更准确。 当专家共享一个基础模型时,蒸馏具有精确的分层溶液:被熔接模型的每个线性分层必须复制专家在读取自己答案时收到的投入上的每个专家输出,这是最小的方块问题,其溶液只需要这些投入的第二分点. 一个前行通过几百次推出 提供了他们。 我们称之为无培训政策提炼(\method)。 推出的内容比解答器包含的内容更多:在数学专家推出的复读回路中被截取的答案很少,而是携带了大比例的代币,去除后将AIME25上的被保险模型从任务算术级别提升到专家的精确度. 在Olmo~3 7B上,每个专家数个GPU-小时前期计算产生一个通论者,将每个专家在七个数学和代码基准上的大部分收益保留下来.

articles.title: Beyond Downstream QA: Rethinking How We Evaluate Agent Memory
articles.content: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越下游 QA:反思我们如何评价代理记忆
articles.content_zh: 代理内存基准评价一个代理的答复是否反映了正确的知识,测量下游的问答准确性作为内存质量的代用. 我们显示这个评价范式是不完整的:它将内存的正确性与检索和生成质量混为一谈,产生假阳性,正确反应掩盖了内存被破坏,而错误反应则将正确的内存归咎于检索失败. 我们提出FEB-30,这是30个事实演进轨迹的基准,涵盖6个诊断类别和3个难度级,通过范式倒置构建:文件由已知的事实轨迹产生,在没有人类注释的情况下产生决定性的基础真理. 每一轨迹都界定了一个事实如何在多作者文物(文件、电子邮件、对话)之间演变,从而能够在每一摄取步骤之后直接检查内存储存。 将FEB-30应用于代表性记忆系统,我们表明,内在和外在的评价平均相差16个百分点,44%的轨迹超过了有意义的相差阈值。 诊断分解显示系统对内存操作(创建,更新,强化,取代)的正确分类只有20%的时间,这是外部评价完全看不见的失败,失败模式因类别和难度而有系统差异. 我们发布了基准、文件生成管道和评分框架,以支持对代理存储系统进行可复制的评价。

articles.title: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing
articles.content: External-memory systems extend language-model applications beyond a context window, but their quality depends critically on the model executing the write path: deciding what to retain, how precisely to represent it, and how new evidence should update persistent state. Existing frameworks typically place a general-purpose large language model behind framework-specific prompts. This raises serving cost, and a writer specialized for one protocol does not transfer directly to another; a unified model that can operate across established memory frameworks remains largely unexplored. We present Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, a compact long-term-memory writer trained across Mem0, MemOS, and Hy-Memory. Memory On-Policy Distillation teaches framework-specific write protocols on student-generated states; Memory RL then optimizes downstream answerability using dense per-chunk probes, attributed cross-chunk rewards, over-storage controls, and chunk-level GRPO. Carrying policy-written banks across windows keeps training aligned with deployment. On fixed 20% benchmark subsamples, Hy-Memory-30B-A3B ranks first on all four evaluated harnesses, including held-out EverMemOS, with a 55.49% macro average versus 54.62% for Claude Opus 5.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B:长期记忆写作的属性强化学习
articles.content_zh: 外部记忆系统将语言模型应用扩展出上下文窗口之外,但其质量关键取决于执行写入路径的模型:决定保留什么,如何准确代表它,以及新证据应如何更新持久性状态. 现有框架通常将通用大语言模式置于具体框架提示后。 这提高了服务成本,一个协议的专用写作机不会直接转移到另一个协议;一个可以跨已确立的内存框架运行的统一模式基本上仍未被探索. 我们向大家介绍Hy-Memory-30B-A3B,他是经过Mem0,MemOS和Hy-Memory培训的紧凑的长期记忆作家. Memory On-Political Distillation 教给学生生成状态的针对框架的写作协议;Minemory RL然后利用密集的每圆柱探测器优化下游的可答性,归属跨圆柱奖励,超存储控制,以及块级GRPO. 跨窗口携带政策书写银行使培训与部署保持一致。 在固定的20%基准子样本中,Hy-Memory-30B-A3B在所有4个被评价的带子上排名第一,包括被搁置的EverMemOS,其宏观平均值为55.49%,而克洛德·奥普斯为54.62%.

articles.title: HTN-Orchestrate: A Hierarchical Task Network Framework for Multi-Agent Orchestration
articles.content: Orchestrating multiple agents on a complex task requires reconciling local subtask execution with global task planning. Dynamic dispatch approaches provide execution flexibility but do not explicitly model subtask hierarchies or dependencies, while predefined workflows impose this structure but fix the decomposition before execution begins. Therefore, we introduce HTN-Orchestrate, a two-layer framework that separates these responsibilities through a hierarchical task network (HTN). The Planner maintains subtask hierarchies and dependencies, deferring decomposition until prerequisite results become available, while local Orchestrators schedule workers to execute each leaf subtask. Results propagate upward under \textbf{AND} semantics, and accumulated findings inform a rebuilt task network when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task. On five benchmarks spanning web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows, HTN-Orchestrate outperforms ReAct, Agent Team, and DeepSeek Harness using the same base model, achieving 89.73% accuracy on BrowseComp and 73.44% on SUPERChem, exceeding Agent Team by 2.45 and 4.69 percentage points, respectively.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HTN-管弦乐团:多代理管弦乐团的分级任务网络框架
articles.content_zh: 对复杂任务的多个代理人进行管束,需要协调本地子任务执行与全球任务规划. 动态调度方法提供了执行的灵活性,但没有明确模式子任务分级或依赖性,而预定义的工作流程强制这种结构,但在执行开始前固定分解. 因此,我们引入了HTN-Orchestrate,这是一个通过分级任务网络(HTN)来划分这些责任的双层框架. 规划师保持子任务分级和依附关系,将分解延迟至获得先决条件结果后再进行,而当地的Orchestrators则安排工人执行每个叶子任务. 结果在\textbf{AND} 语义下向上传播, 当当前分解无法解决任务时, 累积的结果会告知重建的任务网络 。 在涵盖网络研究、科学推理和研究工作流程的五个基准上,HTN-Orchestrates ReAct, Agent Team,以及DeepSeek Harness使用同一基模型,在浏览器Comp和SUPERChem的精确度分别为89.73%和73.44%,分别超过Agent Team的2.45%和4.69%.

articles.title: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning
articles.content: Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. We therefore introduce \textbf{AutoSFT}, a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent for capabilities the pool cannot cover, with the model, the trainer, and the budget fixed within each comparison. Adding each component in turn helps: the executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents lift the best IFEval by $+6.5$, and synthesis adds $+3.4$ IFEval and $+2.9$ IFBench. The same loop transfers to code, where analysis adds $+3.7$ MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve. Every result comes from runs that retrain from the base model each round, so each component's effect is individually attributable. Our findings suggest that automating SFT data research depends more on covering diverse data actions than on a stronger single action.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AutoSFT: 监督精细图解中自动数据研究代理系统
articles.content_zh: 语文模型代理人越来越多地使培训后自动化,但如果有了完整的培训堆,他们就集中到有监督的微调上,花费了大部分精力来修订培训数据。 现有系统给予代理一种控制,从固定的池中选择行或呼叫发电机,而人类数据工程师则会调整比例,棱镜,修复,替换并合成数据. 我们为这些变化设计了一个数据行动空间,并询问一个自动化系统是否能够使整个范围而不是其中一个范围,需要什么样的结构. 我们先用单个代理来运行这个循环,它只达到一个动作,调整类别比例,而其上下文充满了执行输出,被丢弃了中搜索. 因此,我们引入了\textbf{AutoSFT},这是一个多代理系统,一个元代理将执行与分析分开,从独立角度收集建议,并称为集合无法覆盖能力的合成子代理,模型,教练器,以及预算在每次比较中固定. 添加每个元件反过来有助于:执行器将上下文损失减半,分析子剂将最好的IFEval提升6.5美元,而合成则增加3.4美元IFEval和2.9美元IF Bench. 同样的循环传输到代码中,分析会比一个没有改进的单一剂增加3.7美元+MBPP+. 每个结果都来自每回合从基模型中再排出分量的跑道,所以每个组件的效果都是个别可归属的. 我们的调查结果表明,SFT数据研究的自动化更多地取决于涵盖各种数据行动,而不是更强有力的单一行动。

articles.title: Change the Number, Change the Answer: Assessing Rating Scale Sensitivity in LLM-Based Text Scoring
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in computational social science to assign scalar scores to social and psychological constructs. However, studies use different rating scales, and whether their scores remain comparable across scale designs is understudied. To address this gap, we define and systematically investigate scale sensitivity, the variation in LLM-generated scores caused by rating scale design. We distinguish numerical sensitivity, changes in normalized scores, from semantic sensitivity, changes in score interpretation. To assess both, our experimental design crosses 2 formats (continuous vs. ordinal), 4 ranges (3, 5, 11, and 21 points), and 2 signs (signed vs. unsigned) across 3 tasks (political leaning, sentiment, and toxicity), 2 prompting strategies (zero-shot and rubric-based), and 5 LLMs. We find that changing one design element shifts normalized scores by about 0.10 on average and changes the category of roughly 20% of texts. Sensitivity is greatest for toxicity, the only unipolar construct examined. Also, rubric-based prompting does not reduce sensitivity compared with zero-shot prompting. We provide practical guidance for designing more reliable LLM-based text scoring and highlight the need for robustness checks across alternative scales.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 更改数字, 更改答案: 在基于 LLM 的文本分解中评估分级灵敏度
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用于计算社会科学,为社会和心理构造分配分数. 然而,研究使用不同的分级表,其分数是否在尺度设计上仍然具有可比性,但研究不足. 为了弥补这一差距,我们界定并系统调查了尺度敏感性,即评级尺度设计造成的LLM生成分数的变化. 我们区分出数值灵敏度,常态分数的变化,从语义灵敏度,分数解释的变化. 为了评估这两个方面,我们的实验设计跨越了两种格式(连续对正弦),4个范围(3、5、11和21分)和2个标志(签名对未签名),涉及3个任务(政治倾斜、情绪和毒性),2个促进战略(零镜头和以面值为基础的)和5个LLM。 我们发现,改变一个设计要素的分数 平均为0.10, 并改变大约20%的文本类别。 毒性的敏感性最大,这是所检查的唯一单极结构。 另外,与零射入提示相比,基于rumric的提示不会降低灵敏度. 我们为设计更可靠的基于LLM的文本评分提供了实际指导,并强调需要在不同的尺度上进行健全的核查。

articles.title: EVA-Cap: Optimizing Audiovisual Video Captioning via Event-Centric Alignment
articles.content: Recent advances in Omni Language Models (OLMs) provide a unified solution for audiovisual video captioning. Nevertheless, existing approaches predominantly treat captioning as an unstructured text generation process, neglecting the inherent semantic structure of videos and leading to suboptimal fine-grained audiovisual alignment. To bridge this gap, we propose EVA-Cap, a novel framework that decomposes captions into atomic audiovisual events and transforms unstructured text supervision into event-centric alignment. We train EVA-Cap via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on a self-curated dataset, EVA-Data, which is built with event-centric quality control. During the GRPO phase, the model is explicitly optimized against three event-centric alignment targets: global event completeness, intra-event attribution, and inter-event synchronization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EVA-Cap significantly outperforms existing methods in event-centric evaluation (e.g., +9.0% average gain on ChronusAV), while achieving competitive performance on general audiovisual captioning benchmarks (e.g., +3.3% on WorldSense).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EVA-Cap:通过事件-对齐优化视听视频字幕
articles.content_zh: 近期在Omni语言模型(OLM)方面的进展为视听视频字幕提供了统一解决方案. 然而,现有办法主要将标题视为一种结构不合理的文本生成过程,忽视了视频固有的语义结构,导致优劣的精细音频对接。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议EVA-Cap,这是一个将标题分解为原子视听事件并把无结构文本监督转变为以事件为中心的对齐的新框架。 我们通过监督精选(SFT)和集团相对政策优化(GRPO)在自定义的数据集EVA-Data上进行EVA-Cap培训,该数据集以事件为中心进行质量控制. 在GRPO阶段,该模式根据三个以事件为中心的对接目标被明确优化:全球事件完整性,事件内部归属,以及事件间同步. 广泛的实验表明,EVA-Cap在以事件为中心的评价方面大大超过现有方法(例如,ChronusAV的平均增益为9.0%),同时在一般视听字幕基准方面(例如,WorldSense为+3.3%)取得了竞争力。

articles.title: Mosaic: Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Most existing agentic reinforcement learning methods assume single-session trajectories, where interaction proceeds within one continuously accumulated context. However, agentic techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking may produce trajectories spanning multiple sessions, creating a mismatch between the single-session training assumption and inference-time execution. Therefore, we introduce Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning, a more general setting that supports an arbitrary number of sessions within a trajectory. Under this setting, a widely adopted method is to broadcast trajectory-level advantages to all sessions, but this does not distinguish contributions from various sessions or guide session allocation within trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Mosaic, a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. At the trajectory level, it incorporates session-usage signals into advantage estimation. At the session level, it shapes each session's advantage according to the estimated marginal contribution. Experiments on BrowseComp with Qwen3.5-4B show that Mosaic outperforms broadcasting in both context compaction and subagent forking scenarios while using fewer sessions on average. Further analyses show that our method achieves improvements in session utility and allocation, which we suggested is a promising target for future advances in multi-session agentic RL.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Mosaic: 多会代理强化学习
articles.content_zh: 大多数现有的代理强化学习方法都假设单会场轨迹,相互作用在一个不断积累的背景下进行。 然而,上下文收缩和分试剂等代理技术可能会产生跨越多个会话的轨迹,造成单会话培训假设和推断时间执行之间的不匹配. 因此,我们引入了多场会议代理强化学习,这是一种较一般性的环境,支持在轨迹范围内任意举行多场会议。 在这种背景下,一种被广泛采用的方法是向所有会话播放出轨迹级的优点,但这并不区分各种会话的贡献或在轨迹内的指导会话分配. 为了解决这一问题,我们提出Mosaic,一种多会场代理RL方法,无评论分级优化. 在轨迹一级,它将会议使用信号纳入优势估计。 在会议一级,它根据估计的边际贡献来决定每届会议的优势。 在使用Quen3.5-4B的浏览器Comp上的实验显示,Mosaic在上下文收缩和子剂烘焙两种情景中都超过了广播,同时平均使用较少的会话. 进一步的分析表明,我们的方法在会议效用和分配方面有所改进,我们建议,这是今后在多会议代理软件方面取得进展的一个有希望的目标。

articles.title: Lexical Reference Frames: Interpreting LM Residual Streams in Native Semantics
articles.content: The vocabulary of a language model is its native semantics: the embedding and the unembedding fix the meaning of a state at the two ends of the residual stream. Between them, existing methods either reuse a fixed lens or treat the states as a point cloud, and neither reads a state the way the model does. We argue that every hidden state has a native reference frame, induced by the layers that read it next and adaptive to the context. Lexical reference frames approximate it by reading a state through the model's own remaining layers with a stated number of rounds of attention between positions and a typical attention output for the rest, without fitting to the model's output. No lens, with fixed directions per layer, can exceed the square root of the native frame's coherence, 0.30 and 0.35 at mid-depth of SmolLM3-3B and OLMo3-7B, whereas the first-order frame, LexFrame[1], reaches 0.97 and 0.97 and reads a state within 0.16 nats of the model's output. Its coefficients attribute predictions more faithfully than attribution patching, its lexical basis steers a prediction while sparing other tokens, and its confident readings would let an early exit skip 0.45 and 0.42 of the layers, where lenses skip almost none. In this way, lexical reference frames make every hidden state of the model readable, attributable and steerable.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语法参考框架:解释原生语义中LM残余流
articles.content_zh: 一个语言模型的词汇是它的本土语义:嵌入和未嵌入固定了剩余流两端状态的含义. 在它们之间,现有的方法要么重新使用固定镜头,要么把状态当作点云来对待,而且既不是读取模型的状态. 我们主张,每个隐藏状态都有一个本土的参考框架,由下面读取的地层所诱导,并适应上下文. 语法参考框架通过模型自身所剩的地层读取一个状态来取近似,在位置和其余的典型的注意输出之间有说明的几轮注意,而不适应模型的输出. 每层有固定取向的镜头,均不能超过原生帧相通的平方根,在SmolLM3-3B和OLMo3-7B的中深处为0.30和0.35;而一阶帧LexFrame[1]则能达到0.97和0.97并读取模型输出0.16纳特内的一个状态. 其系数属性预测比归属补丁更忠实,其词典基础在引导预测的同时省取了其他符号,而其自信的读取会让一个早期的退出跳过0.45和0.42的地层,其中镜头跳过几乎无. 这样,词汇参考框架使模型的每一个隐蔽状态都可以读取,可归属和可引导.

articles.title: CLUE: Uncovering Social Context for Pragmatic Understanding
articles.content: Understanding a conversation requires connecting what is said to the speakers' relationships, expectations, and earlier exchanges. Prior work shows that supplying relevant context can improve models' social judgments, but much of this information may already be present in the conversation. This motivates training models to discover the cues that matter and use them to support an interpretation. We propose CLUE, a two-stage training pipeline that combines supervised evidence reasoning with GRPO guided by Grounded Information Utilization ($\mathrm{IU}_{\mathrm{G}}$). This reward credits new, evidence-supported social inferences while accounting for reasoning effort. We train on a small set of conversational examples to assess effectiveness and generalization across tasks, languages, and genres. At inference time, the trained model reasons over the supplied interaction in a self-contained manner. Compared with base Qwen, CLUE achieves relative gains of 17.3% in-domain and 9.3% out-of-domain in average weighted F1, with higher F1 on four of five out-of-domain evaluations. These gains are accompanied by over 80% fewer reasoning tokens on average in both domains. Human evaluation further finds that CLUE more often grounds its explanations in specific conversational content, with closer alignment between its quoted evidence and human-selected context.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CLUE: 揭开实用理解的社会背景
articles.content_zh: 理解对话需要将所说的话与发言者的关系、期望和早期的交流联系起来。 先前的研究表明,提供相关背景可以改善模型的社会判断,但大部分这些信息可能已经存在于对话中. 这促使培训模式发现重要的提示,并利用这些提示支持解释。 我们建议CLUE,一个分两个阶段的培训管道,将受监督的证据推理与GPRO相结合,以基础信息利用为指导(美元) 这种奖励在考虑推理努力的同时,还承认了新的、有证据支持的社会推论。 我们训练一些对话的例子,以评估各种任务、语言和流派的有效性和普遍性。 在推论中,训练有素的模型以自成一体的方式对提供的互动提出了理由。 与基准Quen相比,CLUE实现了17.3%的域内和9.3%的域外平均加权F1的相对增益,5个域外评价中的4个的F1较高. 在取得这些进展的同时,这两个领域的推理标志平均减少80%以上。 人类评价还发现,CLUE更经常地用具体的谈话内容来解释其解释,其所引用的证据与人类选择的背景之间更加一致.

articles.title: EMO: A Closed-Loop Test-Time Computation Framework via Alternating Context Optimization and Logits Steering
articles.content: Test-time context optimization adapts frozen language models through textual feedback, but ordinary conditional generation provides no separate control over how strongly to reinforce the distributional changes induced by a context update. We introduce EMO, a training-free framework inspired by expectation--maximization that alternates question-specific context estimation (E-step) and distribution refinement (M-step). The E-step revises a system context using textual gradients from an external judge without access to gold answers. The M-step contrasts next-token distributions under the revised and preceding contexts at a shared prefix to construct a confidence-constrained logit correction. Feedback on the steered response drives the next context update, coupling adaptation across rounds with intervention within each generation. Theoretically, we connect parameter and context optimization through a shared target-KL objective and additive logit representations, and derive the steering vector from context-induced logit displacements. Under context-improvement and faithful-steering assumptions, we prove a one-round decrease in target KL divergence for sufficiently small steering strength. Under greedy decoding across eight models and six benchmarks, EMO improves the zero-shot baseline in 39 of 40 aggregated settings, averaging $+9.10$ percentage points. With the same judge, it adds $+1.53$ points on average over context-only optimization (TextGrad), with consistent MMLU-Pro gains across models. At matched target-model generation budgets, accuracy advantages over best-of-$N$ are strongest on Llama, while oracle coverage is higher in most comparisons despite fewer candidates. The coverage--selection gap motivates allocating test-time computation jointly to candidate generation and verification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EMO: 通过换代上下文优化和逻辑引导的闭环测试-时间计算框架
articles.content_zh: 测试时间上下文优化通过文字反馈来适应被冻结的语言模型,但普通的有条件生成并没有对如何强力地强化由上下文更新所引发的分布变化提供单独的控制. 我们引入了EMO,这是一个无培训框架,其灵感来自预期-最大化,即替代特定问题背景估计(E-step)和分配完善(M-step)。 E-step使用外部法官的文字梯度来修改一个系统上下文,而无法获得黄金答案。 M步法在同一个前缀上对比了修改后和之前上下文下的下接式分布,以构建一个受信任约束的日志校正. 对定向反应的反馈推动了下一次背景更新,将各轮适应与每一代人内部的干预结合起来。 从理论上讲,我们通过一个共同的目标-KL目标和添加式对数表示法将参数和上下文优化联系起来,并从上下文引起的对数转移中得出了向量。 根据上下文的改进和忠实的假设,我们证明,以足够小的转向力,目标KL的相差将减少一回合。 在对8个模型和6个基准进行贪婪解码的情况下,环境管理组织改进了40个总设置中的39个的零射入基线,平均为9.10美元百分点。 与同一法官相比,它平均增加了1.53美元的分数,而仅次于上下文优化(TextGrad),各模型的MMLU-Pro收益一致. 在与之相匹配的目标模式生成预算中,利拉马最优的准确性优于最优的美元,尽管候选人较少,但大多数比较的甲骨文覆盖率较高。 覆盖-选择差距促使将测试时间计算分配给候选人生成和核实。

articles.title: PremiseSQL: Evaluating Premise Critique and Abstention in Text-to-SQL Systems
articles.content: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved Text-to-SQL performance, yet existing NL2SQL systems largely assume that user queries are valid and answerable. As a result, models often generate executable SQL even for queries with flawed premises. We introduce premise critique ability in NL2SQL, namely the ability to recognize flawed queries and abstain from generating misleading SQL. To evaluate this capability, we propose PremiseSQL, a benchmark containing 1,800 flawed NL2SQL queries across four categories of premise failures, along with their 1,800 original queries. We further design an evaluation framework to measure intrinsic and prompt-induced premise-aware behavior across three prompting settings. Experiments on frontier LLMs show that current models are strongly premise-trusting by default and rarely critique flawed premises. Stronger critique-oriented prompting improves detection and abstention on flawed queries, but also increases false invalid judgments and suppresses SQL generation on originals. The code is available at https://github.com/vegeet/PremiseSQL.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PremiseSQL:评估文本到SQL系统中的精密标准与保留
articles.content_zh: 最近大语言模型(LLMS)的进步大大地改善了Text对SQL的性能,然而现有的NL2SQL系统基本上假定用户查询是有效的和可回答的. 因此,模型往往产生可执行的SQL,甚至用于有缺陷的前提的查询. 我们在NL2SQL中引入了前提批评能力,即识别有缺陷的询问和避免产生误导性SQL的能力. 为了评价这种能力,我们提议PremiseSQL,这个基准包含1,800个有缺陷的NL2SQL查询,涉及四类前提故障,以及1,800个原始查询。 我们进一步设计了一个评价框架,以衡量三个触发环境内在和迅速引发的前提意识行为。 对前沿有限责任公司进行的实验表明,目前的模型在默认情况下具有强烈的前提信任,很少批评有缺陷的前提。 更强烈的以批评为导向的提示可以改善检测,对有缺陷的询问弃权,但也会增加虚假的无效判断并压制原作上SQL生成. 该代码可在https://github.com/vegeet/PremiseSQL查询.

articles.title: Believed but Not Said: Measuring Hidden Belief Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Discussions
articles.content: LLM systems increasingly rely on groups of agents that discuss, critique, and check one another, assuming that peers will catch individual errors. We test this assumption against a minimal adversary. In a ten-agent factual discussion, one or three adversarial agents repeatedly assert a plausible false answer. After each round we probe each benign agent's private answer through a separate call whose response is hidden from its peers, and we separately label its public stance toward the claim. Across six models and three factual-QA datasets, groups remain stable without an attacker: only 0.6% of benign agents finish with the false answer. A single adversarial agent increases this rate to 44.8% and three to 60.5%. Studies of conformity typically report public agreement without private change; we find the reverse. With three adversarial agents present, benign agents hold the false answer in 51.6% of exposed turns but publicly endorse it in only 19.7%. Much of the influence therefore remains invisible in the discussion, and the false answers persist when agents are asked for their own views. Agents that retain the true answer often fail to defend it; once adopted, the false answer spreads among benign agents, and baseline knowledge does not predict robustness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 相信但没说:测量多代理LLM中的隐藏信仰折叠 讨论情况
articles.content_zh: LLM系统越来越依赖相互讨论、批评和检查的各类代理人,假设同行会发现个别错误。 我们测试这个假设 针对一个最小的对手。 在一次十方代理人的事实讨论中,一至三名对抗方代理人一再断言一个可信的虚假答案. 每回合之后,我们通过一个单独的电话 探究每个良性代理人的私人回答, 其答复被隐藏在同行面前, 我们分别标出其公开的立场 对权利主张。 在6个模型和3个事实-QA数据集中,没有攻击者的群体保持稳定:只有0.6%的良性剂用假答案完成. 单一对抗方代理人将这一比率提高到44.8%和3%至60.5%。 符合性研究通常报告公众同意,而不作私人改变;我们发现恰恰相反。 有3名对抗方代理人在场,良性代理人在51.6%的暴露转向中持有虚假答案,但公开认可的比例仅为19.7%。 因此,许多影响在讨论中仍然看不见,当向特工征求他们自己的意见时,错误的答案依然存在. 保留了真实答案的代理人往往无法为它辩护;一旦被采纳,虚假答案会扩散到良性代理人之间,而基线知识也不会预测强性.

articles.title: Intern-Decision: Efficient Multimodal Decision Making with Autoregressive Masked Language Modeling
articles.content: Interactive agents repeatedly choose among a finite set of actions, labels, or ordinal outcomes. Generating a free-form response for each choice adds latency and complicates the interface between a model and its environment. We present Intern-Decision, a family of 0.8B, 2B, and 4B multimodal decision models that return structured choices and candidate probabilities from text and optional images. Our autoregressive masked language modeling objective places one decision placeholder per field in a complete assistant JSON skeleton. Ground-truth symbols appear only in supervision, while all fields are evaluated in a single causal forward pass using the backbone's native language-model head. The 4B model achieves a 90.02% unweighted average accuracy across seven evaluation suites, compared with 88.74% for Jev v1.13.0. For a fixed 289-token request with three fields on one RTX 4090, mean latency is 44.16 ms for the 4B model and approximately 33--34 ms for the smaller models. On a separate 96-case known-distribution pilot, temperature scaling reduces expected multiclass Brier from 0.628 to 0.550 and expected calibration error from 0.213 to 0.089. A confidence-based handoff study on 111 public Jevbench-Hard items improves accuracy from 82/111 (73.87%) to 97/111 (87.39%) by routing 42 items to Atria-Dawn-Preview. We also describe qualitative game, visual interface, and browser demonstrations. These results support compact decision models as a practical component of larger agent systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 实习决定:采用自发式假冒语言模式的高效多式联运决策
articles.content_zh: 互动代理人在一组有限的动作,标签,或平分结果中反复选择. 生成每种选择的自由式响应会增加耐久性,使模型及其环境之间的接口复杂化. 我们提出实习决定,这是一个由0.8B、2B和4B多种模式组成的家庭,它们从文字和可选图像中返回结构化选择和候选概率。 我们自发的蒙面语言模型设计目标 将每个字段一个决定占位符置于一个完整的助理JSON骨架中. 地面真实符号只在监督中出现,而所有字段都使用主干部的本土语言模式头进行单一的因果前传评价. 4B模式在7个评价套件中实现了90.02%的未加权平均精度,而Jev v1.13.0. 对于一个有3个字段的固定的289个托肯请求,在一个RTX 4090上,4B型号的平均耐用度为44.16 ms,较小的型号大约为33-34 ms. 在单独的96例已知分流试验中,温度缩放将预期的多级布列尔从0.628降至0.550并预期校正出错从0.213降至0.089. 对111个公开的Jevbench-Hard项目进行了基于信任的交接研究,通过将42个项目运往Atria-Dawn-Preview,提高了准确性,从82/111(73.87%)提高到97/111(87.39%)。 我们还描述了定性游戏,视觉界面,以及浏览器演示. 这些成果支持作为较大代理系统实际组成部分的紧凑决策模式。

articles.title: Explaining the Roles of Experts in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Personalization
articles.content: Personalization of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly important for user-centric applications, yet prior methods mainly adapt dense LLMs, whose polysemantic neurons, each encoding multiple unrelated concepts, hinder localizing the components behind personalization, and thus understanding and controlling it. We propose to personalize Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs, which sparsely route each token to a few specialized experts, reducing polysemanticity and enabling such localization. We adapt three open-weight MoE LLMs on a large-scale personalization dataset and train crosscoders on paired activations of the personalized and non-personalized models to learn interpretable personalized latents, from which we identify the experts encoding distinct personalization features. The personalized MoE LLMs perform competitively with dense LLMs while activating only a fraction of their parameters, exhibit lower polysemanticity than dense LLMs with similar active parameters, and, within the same model family, yield personalized latents that are less shared with the non-personalized model. Causal interventions show that these latents suffice to recover the personalized model's behavior and that boosting their associated experts moves the non-personalized model toward it, revealing distinct routing paths for different personalization features.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 解释专家在专家个人化方面作用
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)的个性化对于以用户为中心的应用越来越重要,然而之前的方法主要适应稠密的LLMS,其多语义神经元,每个编码多个不相干的概念,会阻碍个性化背后的组件本地化,从而理解和控制. 我们提议将 " 专家混合 " (MoE)有限责任公司(LLMs)个性化,这些公司很少将每个标志带给几位专门专家,从而减少多聚体抗体,使这种地方化成为可能。 在大型个性化数据集上,我们调整了三个开放量级的MOE LLMs,并在对个性化和非个性化模型的对接激活上培训交叉编码器,以学习可解释的个性化潜质,我们从中识别出将独特的个性化特征编码的专家. 个性化的 MOE LLMs 与稠密的 LLMs 进行竞争,同时激活的参数只有一小部分,其多聚抗性低于具有类似活性参数的稠密的 LLMs ,并且在同一模型家族中产生与非个性化模型较少共享的个性化潜想. 原因干预表明,这些潜在因素足以恢复个性化模型的行为,提升其相关专家将非个性化模型推向它,揭示出不同个性化特征的不同路径.

articles.title: Unfragmenting Nawatl NMT: Single-Variant Specialization for Masewalkopa
articles.content: In minoritized (low-resource) language technologies, a common response to data sparsity is to aggregate text across multiple varieties and treat the combined data as a single corpus. However, mixed corpora of closely related indigenous variants can produce an artificial register that is accountable to no single speaker community, a structural failure we call variant fragmentation. This issue is acute for minoritized languages native to Mexico, such as Nawatl. Building on a 70,000-pair multi-variant foundation, we specialize an mT5-large checkpoint to Masewalkopa (nhn), the Nawatl variety spoken in Santa Ana Tlacotenco. We curate 2,665 parallel pairs, reserve all sentence-level data for evaluation, and incorporate 192 elder-transcribed target sentences via asymmetric backtranslation. A custom finite-state analyzer reduces unanalyzed surface forms from 82.0% to 19.9% and supplies functional syntax tags as plain-text prefixes, allowing the model to reuse existing subword embeddings rather than relying on frozen special tokens. The resulting LoRA-v9c-b model achieves 58.46 dev chrF++ and 58.20/57.90 directional test chrF++. Finally, CTranslate2 int8 quantization reduces CPU latency from 137.5 to 1.8-2.6 seconds per request, enabling cost-bounded Cloud Run deployment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 无裂纳瓦特尔 NMT:马塞瓦科洛帕单变量专业
articles.content_zh: 在次要(低资源)语言技术中,对数据相接性的一个常见反应是将多个品种的文本相接而成,并将合并后的数据作为一个单体处理. 然而,由密切相关的土著变体组成的混合体可以产生一个人工登记册,这个登记册不对单一的说者社区负责,我们称之为变体分化的结构故障。 这个问题对于墨西哥本土的次要语言,如纳瓦特尔语来说是尖锐的. 在7万帕的多变量基础上,我们专门建立了一个MT5的大型检查站,前往马塞瓦科帕(nhn),即圣安娜特拉科滕科所说的纳瓦特尔品种. 我们管理2,665个平行对子,保留所有句子级别数据以供评价,并通过不对称回译法纳入192个长者-三角形目标句. 一种自定义的有限状态分析器将未分析的表面形式从82.0%减少到19.9%,并作为平正文字前缀提供功能语法标记,使模型可以再用已存在的子词嵌入来,而不是依赖被冻结的特殊符号. 由此产生的LORA-v9c-b型实现58.46 dev chrF++和58.20/57.90方向测试chrF++. 最后,CTranslate2 int8的量子化将CPU的空档从每个请求的137.5秒降低到1.8-2.6秒,从而能够有成本限制的Cloud Run部署.

articles.title: Patch where the text is new: a compression view of where byte-level models should spend compute
articles.content: Byte-level language models such as the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) run their large global model once per patch and start a patch where a small model's next-byte entropy is high. This rule rarely starts a patch at in-line computed results, such as the number after "=" in a worked solution, and accuracy on them collapses under tight patch budgets. We propose novelty patching, motivated by LZ77-style compression: start a patch where the upcoming bytes are unlikely to repeat the recent context. The rule is a lookup table over the previous two bytes, fitted in seconds on raw text with no labels, reference model or losses. In BLT-style models trained from scratch on a 1.9 GB math corpus at a matched ~11% patch rate (3 seeds each), it has no clear effect at 1M parameters, raises final-answer accuracy from 47% to 72% at 12M, and at 50M raises computed-result accuracy from 21% to 57% and final-answer accuracy from 60% to 90%; a table fitted on the raw pretraining corpus keeps the gain. Outside math the advantage shrinks: novelty lowers bits per byte on prose and ties entropy on source code and on synthetic execution traces. An analysis of where boundaries fall explains the pattern. Computed results have ordinary surprisal for the patcher's model, so surprisal-seeking rules pass over them: entropy concentrates patch starts on high-surprisal bytes most strongly of all rules (boundary enrichment 1.61) and is the worst on computed results, while the best rules sit near chance enrichment. Novelty works where new content begins at segment starts close to the computation, as in written math; a learned chunker (H-Net) finds such structure on its own, in math and in code. We also report what did not work: typed uncertainty as a training rule, switching rules after training, and a context-aware novelty predictor.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 文本新位置的补丁: 字节级模型应该花在计算中的压缩视图
articles.content_zh: Byte Latent Transformer (BLT)等字节级语言模型每补丁运行一次他们的大型全球模型,并启动一个小模型的下字节 en高的补丁. 这个规则很少在线内计算结果开始补丁,比如在工作解决方案中"="后的数字,在紧凑的补丁预算下,其准确性会崩溃. 我们提出以LZ77风格压缩为动机的新型补丁:在即将到来的字节不太可能重复最近上下文的地方启动补丁. 规则是前两个字节的查询表,在原始文本上以秒为单位安装,没有标签,参考模型或丢失. BLT型模型以相匹配的~11%的补丁率从头开始训练出1.9GB数学体(每个种子有3个种子),在1M参数上没有明显的效果,在12M时将最终答案精度从47%提高到72%,在50M时将计算结果精度从21%提高到57%,最终答案精度从60%提高到90%;在原始预训所上安装的表格保持了收益。 外出数学 优势收缩:新颖性在出道品和领带上每字节下比特,在源代码和合成行刑痕迹上比特. 分析一下边界落到哪里就说明了模式。 计算出的结果对补丁模型有普通的附加性,因此补丁-求取规则通过它们:  en精从高补丁起于所有规则中最强的高补丁字节(分界浓缩1.61),是计算结果上最差的规则,而最佳规则则几乎是机会浓缩. 小说中新内容开始于分段开始接近计算,如在书面数学中;一个有学问的块子(H-Net)在数学和代码中发现这种结构. 我们还报告一些不起作用的事情:将不确定性打入培训规则,在培训后切换规则,以及了解背景的新预测器。

articles.title: Multi-SFT: Permissively-Licensed Multilingual Instruction-Following
articles.content: Supervised fine-tuning datasets remain overwhelmingly English-centric and commercially restricted, as their content is frequently generated by proprietary models whose terms of service forbid training competing systems. We introduce Multi-SFT, a commercially permissive collection of 502,818 instruction-response pairs across five European languages, built via translation and regeneration pipelines for tasks where translation is insufficient. Human evaluation yields inter-annotator agreement of at least 0.87 across all datasets and languages. Fine-tuning nine models from three different families (EuroLLM, OLMo 2, Qwen3; 1B-32B) and evaluating them on 13 benchmarks shows that Multi-SFT alone is competitive with larger augmented mixes and official instruction-tuned releases, with decisive advantages on safety tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多语种教学:允许使用多种语言教学
articles.content_zh: 受监督的微调数据集仍然绝大多数以英语为中心,在商业上受到限制,因为其内容常常由专有模式产生,其服务条款禁止培训竞争系统。 我们引进了多SFT,这是一个商业上允许的集合,有502 818个教学-应答对,跨越了5种欧洲语言,通过翻译和再生管道建造,用于翻译不足的任务。 在所有数据集和语言中,人类评价至少获得0.87个公证员的同意。 从三个不同的家庭(EuroLLM, OLMo 2, Quen3; 1B-32B)对9个型号进行精细调整,并根据13个基准对其进行评估,显示单是多SFT就具有更大的增强组合和官方指令调试发行的竞争力,在安全任务上具有决定性优势.

articles.title: The Right Byte First: How UTF-16 Helps Multilingual Boundary Prediction
articles.content: Many hierarchical byte-level language models group bytes into patches using a learned boundary predictor whose view of the next codepoint depends on encoding and lookahead. In UTF-8, codepoints of many scripts take three bytes: 8 of 24 bits mark length and continuation, and the first byte carries only 4 high codepoint bits. After the same left context, a mark extending a grapheme cluster and a letter starting the next can thus share their first byte. Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE) keeps one- and two-byte UTF-8 encodings but writes these codepoints as two UTF-16 bytes, low byte first, so its first symbol carries 8 low codepoint bits that can distinguish such continuations. We train small causal predictors on matched FineWeb-2 text and evaluate on FLORES-200 under UTF-8, UBE, and UBE's same-length big-endian variant. At one-symbol lookahead, balanced grapheme-boundary error at codepoint boundaries across 17 languages in 13 Brahmic scripts is 8.76% with UTF-8, 8.62% with the big-endian variant, and 0.06% with UBE. When the target instead retains a parent tokenizer's subword cuts at grapheme boundaries, UBE lowers the mean error relative to UTF-8 at the same lookahead by 72.91% in Korean, 35.29% in Chinese, and 67.32-99.55% in eight more scripts. In the seven of them whose main Unicode block fits on one 256-codepoint page, the big-endian variant stays within 3.0% of UTF-8, so the gain follows byte order, not length. In Korean and Chinese, UBE's mean error falls below UTF-8's final mean error after only 25% and 37.5% of training. Which byte comes first thus affects how much lookahead a byte-level boundary predictor needs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 右字节一: UTF-16 如何帮助多种语言边界预测
articles.content_zh: 许多分级字节级语言模型将字节组合成补丁,使用一个已学习到的边界预测器,其下个代码点的视图取决于编码和取景. 在UTF-8中,许多脚本的代码点取出3个字节:8个24位标记长度和续作,而第一个字节只携带了4个高代码点比特. 在同一左上下文之后,延伸出一个图案组的标记和开始下一个字母的字母可以因此共享他们的第一个字节. Universal Byte-level Encoding (UBE) 保留了一字节和二字节的UTF-8编码,但将这些编码点写为两个UTF-16字节,先是低字节,因此其第一个符号带有8个能区分这种续作的低码点位. 我们在匹配的FineWeb-2文本上训练出小的因果预测器,并在UTF-8,UBE和UBE的同长大-endian变体下对FLORES-200进行评价. 在一同位素外观上,13个婆罗洲脚本中跨越17个语言的编码点边界的平衡相图边界误差为:以UTF-8为8.76%;以大端变体为8.62%;以UBE为0.06%. 当目标在石墨边界上保留了母标注器的子字切分时,UBE将相同外观前方的UTF-8的正差降低72.91%的韩文,35.29%的中文和67.32-99.55%的再8个脚本. 其中7个主Unicode块适合一个256个码点的页面,大端变体停留在UTF-8的3.0%以内,因此增益遵循字节顺序,不是长度. 在韩语和汉语中,UBE的平均出错仅经过了25%和37.5%的训练后就低于UTF-8的最终出错. 因此,哪一个字节首先会影响一个字节级的边界预测器的外观。

articles.title: Beyond Context Length: Characterising the Difficulty of Long-Context Reasoning
articles.content: Long-context language models support ever longer context windows, and evaluations typically treat context length as the main indicator of difficulty. However, context length alone cannot explain why models fail on long-context tasks that require reasoning over complex information. Contexts of equal length can pose very different challenges: a task may be solvable from a single local passage, or it may require integrating evidence distributed across the full context. We quantitatively characterise this difficulty through three properties: evidence scope, how much necessary information must be found; evidence dispersion, how widely that information is scattered within the context; and reasoning depth, how many dependent steps are needed to derive an answer from it. We construct LURCH, a multi-domain question-answering benchmark of 6,550 instances with supporting evidence and reasoning graphs, enabling all three properties to be quantified. Evaluations of proprietary and open-weight models show that: (1) at fixed context length, all our three properties are strongly negatively correlated with model performance; (2) as context length increases, performance degrades sharply on samples with dispersed evidence, whereas it remains relatively stable on samples with localised evidence; and (3) difficulty compounds across properties, as questions with moderately high values on all three are harder than those with an extreme value on just one. These findings establish evidence scope, dispersion and reasoning depth as measures of long-context reasoning difficulty that complement context length.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond上下文长度:描述长文字的难度
articles.content_zh: 长文本语言模型支持更长的上下文窗口,评价通常将上下文长度作为困难的主要指标. 然而,仅凭上下文长度无法解释模型为何在需要对复杂信息进行推理的长文任务上失败. 相同长度的背景可构成非常不同的挑战:一项任务可能从一个单一的局部通道中解脱出来,或可能需要综合整个背景中分发的证据。 我们通过三个特性从数量上描述这一困难:证据范围,必须找到多少必要的信息;证据分散,信息在上下文中分散的程度;推理深度,从中得出答案需要多少依附步骤. 我们构建了LURCH,这是一个由6 550个实例组成的多领域问答基准,并附有辅助证据和推理图表,使所有三个属性都能量化。 对专有和开重模型的评价表明:(1) 在固定上下文长度下,我们三个属性都与模型性能有很强的负相关;(2) 随着上下文长度的增加,性能在有分散证据的样本上急剧下降,而在有本地证据的样本上则保持相对稳定;(3) 跨属性的难度复合物,因为所有三个具有中度高值的问题都比仅一个具有极端价值的问题更困难. 这些结论确定了证据范围、分散和推理深度,作为对上下文长度加以补充的长期文字推理困难的衡量。

articles.title: Documenting Trofinetide Treatment Phenotypes in Rett Syndrome with a Dual-LLM Consensus Pipeline
articles.content: Objective: Trofinetide, approved in 2023 as the first Rett syndrome treatment, lacks scalable real-world monitoring because chart review is labor-intensive. We developed a dual large language model (LLM) consensus pipeline to extract 18 treatment-response phenotypes, comprising 4 adverse effects, 13 Rett clinical features, and medication refusal, from clinical notes. Materials and Methods: We analyzed 26,763 notes from 108 patients with confirmed sustained trofinetide exposure at Texas Children's Hospital. The pipeline filters notes by keyword, classifies each through two LLMs requiring consensus, and aggregates a patient-by-timepoint matrix. Architecture and prompt were selected on a diarrhea development set, then frozen and applied to the other 17 phenotypes with the phenotype definition substituted, as an out-of-sample test. The reported prompt comparison scores 183 expert-labeled cells. Results: A prompt requiring diarrhea to be active and severe performed best (84.2 $\pm$ 0.0% accuracy; F1 = 0.674), 47 percentage points above regular-expression matching ($p < 0.0001$). Expert reviewers judged six of the pipeline's calls per phenotype, three positive and three negative, and agreed with 90.2% (92/102). The 13 Rett clinical features are manifestations of the disorder itself rather than adverse effects of trofinetide. Gross and fine motor impairment, language/communication, and stereotypy were documented present in 92-100% of patients at every visit. Discussion: In-context LLM extraction captured multi-domain treatment responses. The outcome is documented presence at each visit, not a direction-of-change judgment. Conclusion: Coupling in-context LLM reasoning with a consensus architecture offers a scalable alternative to keyword and regular-expression extraction for real-world evidence, adapting to new phenotypes and medications through configuration alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用双LLM共识管道记录Rett综合症中的Trofinetide治疗形态
articles.content_zh: 目标:Trofinetide于2023年被批准为首个Rett综合症治疗方法,缺乏可伸缩的现实世界监测,因为图表审查是劳动密集型的. 我们开发了一个双大语言模型(LLM)共识管道,从临床笔记中提取出18个治疗-反应型,包括4个不良反应,13个Rett临床特征和药物拒绝. 材料和方法: 我们分析了108名患者的26,763个笔记 证实在德克萨斯州儿童医院持续接触特罗菲尼特素 管道通过关键词过滤注释,通过两个需要共识的LLM分别分类,并逐时汇总一个病人矩阵. 在痢疾开发集上选择了建筑和快感,后被冷冻并被应用到其他17个用苯基定义取而代之的苯基,作为外样本测试. 所报告的快速比较评分为183个专家标记的单元格。 结果: 要求痢疾有效且严重表现最佳的即时反应(精确度为0.0 % 为84.2美元;F1=0.674),比正则表达匹配值高47个百分点(p < 0.0001美元)。 专家审查员对管道中每个phanotype的6个电话进行了判断,3个正线和3个负线,同意90.2%(92/102)。 13个Rett临床特征是该障碍本身的表现,而不是特罗菲内酯的不良反应. 记录显示,每次探视的92%-100%的病人都患有严重和微弱的运动障碍、语言/交流和立体病。 讨论:内文LLM提取得到多域处理反应. 每次访问都有记录显示结果,而不是作出改变方向的判断。 结论:将文本中的LLM推理与共识架构相配合,为关键词和正则表达取出现实世界证据提供了一个可扩展的可选方案,仅通过配置来适应新的苯基和药物.

articles.title: Name-Bias in Large Language Models
articles.content: Names carry demographic indicators such as age, gender, and race, which makes them a subtle but strong target of bias in large language models (LLMs). In this work, we present an evaluation of name-based bias across 6 local large language models spanning multiple providers and parameter scales. Using a fill-in-the-blank task, we prompt these models to choose between pairs of first names drawn from U.S. Social Security Administration datasets and a race classification dataset by Rosenman et al.. Our experimental de- sign isolates age and gender effects through balanced name pairings and sentence templates that share a fixed syntactic structure. Across 300,000 local LLM responses, we find consistent and measurable name bias. Models prefer names that are less stereotypically male, older, popular, and white. Furthermore, we find that name-bias is highly sentence-dependent, but not more than associated stereotypes, and gender is the most significant bias, followed by age, name popularity, and race. Our results demonstrate that name-based bias remains pervasive even in local LLMs, highlighting the necessity for standardized evaluation methods and mitigation strategies.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 大语言模型中的名称比斯
articles.content_zh: 名称带有年龄,性别和种族等人口指标,这使得它们成为了大语言模型(LLMs)中偏颇的微妙而强烈的目标. 在这项工作中,我们评价了6个地方大语言模型的基于名称的偏差,这些模型跨越多个提供者和参数尺度。 使用填充式任务,我们促使这些模型在从美国社会保障管理局数据集抽取的一对名字和由罗森曼等所绘制的种族分类数据集之间进行选择. 我们的实验去标志通过平衡的名字配对和句子模板来隔离年龄和性别效应,这些模板具有固定的合成结构. 在30万个地方的LLM反应中,我们发现一致和可衡量的名称偏差。 模特更喜欢男性,年长,受欢迎和白人的定型名字. 此外,我们发现, " 有名之辈 " 高度依赖判决,但并不超出相关的定型观念,性别是最重要的偏见,其次是年龄、名声和种族。 我们的结果显示,即使在当地有限责任公司中,基于名称的偏见仍然普遍存在,这突出说明了标准化评价方法和缓解战略的必要性。

articles.title: Effectiveness of Hidden-State Probes for Localizing Reasoning Failures
articles.content: Verifying the final answer of a long reasoning trace may show that the trace is wrong but it does not distinguish three cases. The problem may lie beyond the model's capability, another attempt would succeed, or one step in an otherwise recoverable trace made the trace fail. Standard hidden-state probes are trained on final-answer correctness, a label that conflates these cases. Monte Carlo rollouts distinguish the cases and locate the failing step at additional inference cost. We test the hidden states of 4B and 8B reasoning models for the failure type and the failing step and compare each probe with the strongest baseline that uses no hidden states. On incorrect 8B traces, the confidence probe, a calibrated correctness probe at a midpoint cutoff, misses 81% of cases in which a single step makes the trace unrecoverable and 47% of cases in which another attempt would succeed. A probe with a different training design over the same states reverses the ordering of these two kinds of failure, so either ordering can be read from those states. At both scales, no single tested probe locates the failing step more accurately than a rule based only on trace length, and at 4B a probe trained to predict that step fails to outperform this rule in any of 10 runs on identical traces. The confidence probe therefore indicates that an answer is wrong, but its failure-type ordering depends on its training design.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 隐藏国家探测器在查明原因失败地点方面的效力
articles.content_zh: 验证一个长推理追踪的最终答案可能表明这个追踪是错误的,但它并没有区分出三个案例. 问题可能超出模型的能力,另一种尝试会成功,或者在本来可以收回的追踪中迈出一步就使追踪失败. 标准隐藏状态探测器在最终答案正确性方面进行了训练,这个标签将这些情况混为一谈. 蒙特卡洛的推出将案件区分开来,并以额外的推论成本确定失败步骤的位置. 我们测试失败类型和失败步骤的4B和8B推理模型的隐藏状态,并将每个探测器与没有隐藏状态的最强基线进行比较。 在不正确的8B痕迹上,信心探测器,一个在中点截断时校准的正确性探测器,错过了81%的一次步骤导致追踪无法恢复的情况,以及47%的另一次尝试会成功的情况. 一个在相同状态上具有不同训练设计的探测器颠倒了这两种故障的订单,所以两种订单都可以从这些状态读取. 在两种尺度上,没有任何一个经过测试的探测器能够比仅根据微量长度的规则更准确地定位出失败的一步,在4B级上,训练有素的探测器在10个相同痕迹的跑道中都无法预测该步骤的完成情况. 因此,信心探测器表明一个答案是错误的,但其故障类型的订单取决于其训练设计.

articles.title: Momentum, Commentary Tone, and Earnings Surprise in LLM Financial Forecasts
articles.content: Which inputs drive a language model's financial forecast? We construct synthetic earnings announcements that independently reverse 20-day momentum, non-informational commentary tone, and whether fixed actual EPS beats a manipulated consensus. Six instruction/chat checkpoint conversions from four families (0.49-7.61B base parameters) receive 2,016 prompts each under a direct-answer Q8_0 protocol. The design includes 24 numerical blocks, six commentary pairs, profits and losses, rising and falling annual EPS, and two surprise sizes. Both A/B answer assignments and U/D cover all 384 primary scenarios per conversion. We estimate matched changes in conditional answer-prefix scores, not calibrated market probabilities. Across these checkpoints, the primary EPS contrast ranges from -0.19 to 86.80 percentage points. The magnitude of the primary signed tone contrast exceeds that of EPS in 5 of six models, and momentum exceeds it in 5. Natural-word numerical diagnostic accuracy ranges from 51.0 to 95.8 percent. Answer-encoding, wording, context, and conversion controls qualify these results. The experiment measures observable input reliance and numerical recognition; it establishes neither an internal reasoning mechanism nor realized return predictability. Public benchmark prompts, recorded scores, and an interactive recorded-results explorer accompany the study.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 《LLM财务预测》中的时刻、评论和收益惊喜
articles.content_zh: 哪种投入能推动语言模型的财务预测? 我们构建了合成收益公告,独立扭转了20天的动向,非信息性的评论基调,以及固定的实际EPS是否超越被操纵的共识. 由4个家族(0.49-7.61B基准参数)的6个指令/聊天检查站转换器,在直接回答的Q8_0协议下,各得到2,016个提示. 设计包括24个数字块,6个评论对,损益,每年EPS的起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起 A/B回答任务和U/D都涵盖每次转换的所有384个基本设想。 我们估计有条件的答案前缀分数的相匹配变化,而不是校准的市场概率. 通过这些检查站,EPS的主要对比度从0.19到86.80个百分点不等。 主签名音调对比度在6个型号中的5个型号超过了EPS,而5个型号的势头超过了EPS. 自然字数诊断精度从51.0%到95.8%. 答案编码、措辞、上下文和转换控制对这些结果作出限定。 实验衡量可观察到的投入依赖和数字识别;它既没有建立内部推理机制,也没有实现返回的可预测性。 公共基准提示,记录分数,以及配合研究的交互式记录-结果探索者.

articles.title: WEAVE: Weaving Real-World Code Evolution into Dependency-Structured Tasks for Benchmarking and Training Code Agents
articles.content: Real-world software engineering rarely consists of isolated changes. Features, migrations, and systematic fixes often unfold across multiple pull requests (PRs), requiring coordinated modifications across a repository. Yet most executable repository-level benchmarks retain a single issue or PR as the task unit, while existing multi-PR settings rely on coarse aggregation and structure-agnostic evaluation. This mismatch obscures dependencies among changes and limits progress measurement and learning signals for long-horizon code agents. We introduce WEAVE, a framework that transforms verified PR histories into executable, dependency-structured tasks. WEAVE leverages repository-calibrated typed change loci to organize related PRs into bounded DAGs and instantiate each as a unified executable task. We further introduce Graph Credit, a deterministic, test-grounded metric that measures dependency-consistent partial progress and supports dense, verifiable rewards for reinforcement learning. Experiments on task construction, agent evaluation, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning show that WEAVE yields coherent executable tasks, enables more faithful progress measurement than flat scoring, and provides effective supervision and verifiable rewards for training code agents.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WEAVE: 将真实世界守则编织成依赖性任务,用于制定基准和培训守则代理人
articles.content_zh: 现实世界软件工程很少由孤立的变化所组成. 特性、迁移和系统固定往往贯穿于多个牵引请求,需要在整个存储处进行协调一致的修改。 然而,大多数可执行寄存器级基准都保留一个单一问题或PR作为任务单位,而现有的多PR设置则依赖于粗糙的汇总和结构不可知性评价. 这种不匹配掩盖了变化之间的依赖性,并限制了长视码剂的进度测量和学习信号. 我们引入了WEAVE,这个框架将经过核实的PR历史转化为可执行的,依赖性结构化的任务. WEAVE 杠杆 寄存器校正的已键入的更改 loci 将相关的 PR 组织到捆绑的 DAG 中, 并即时将每个都作为统一可执行的任务 。 我们进一步引入了Graph Credit,这是一个决定性的、基于测试的衡量标准,它衡量依赖性一致的部分进展,并支持对强化学习给予密集、可核查的奖励。 关于任务构建、代理评估、监督微调和强化学习的实验表明,WEAVE产生一致的可执行任务,能够比平分更忠实地衡量进度,并为培训守则代理人提供有效的监督和可核查的奖励。

articles.title: Selection Is Not Learning: Choosing Model Futures
articles.content: Self-evolving language models train on tasks they generate, so every round must decide which updated model the next round inherits. Current loops such as R-Zero, Agent0, and Skill Self-Play make this decision through the task, admitting tasks that look learnable and inheriting every resulting update. We identify a selection-to-update gap in these loops, where a task that looks learnable need not produce a useful update. Most updates on verified tasks fail to make correct answers more likely, yet these loops inherit them all. HeirCommit freezes the updated model and uses fresh evaluation questions to decide whether to inherit it or retain the current model. EvoHeir separates parameter inheritance from experience inheritance, using current and archived experience to repair failures and preserve successes before final confirmation. Our analysis characterizes selection-induced optimism and decomposes regret into selection, absorption, and confirmation errors. HeirCommit cuts the harmful share of accepted updates by 68-83% relative to random inheritance at the same acceptance rate. Across four backbones, EvoHeir achieves the best mathematics and general-reasoning averages, raising the math average by 5.3% relative to the strongest baseline, Agent0. The framework lets useful experience persist even when the model that produced it is not inherited.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 选择不是学习:选择模式未来
articles.content_zh: 自我演变的语言模型列车在他们产生的任务上,所以每一回合都必须决定下一轮继承哪个更新的模型. 当前循环如R-Zero,Agent0和Skill Self-Play通过任务来做出这个决定,承认看起来可以学习的任务,并继承了每个由此产生的更新. 我们发现在这些循环中存在一个选择更新的空白,一个看起来可以学习的任务不需要产生有用的更新. 关于已核实任务的多数更新未能使正确的答案更可能,然而这些循环继承了它们的全部. HeirCommitt冻结了更新的模型,并使用新的评价问题来决定是继承还是保留目前的模型. EvoHeir将参数继承与经验继承区分开来,使用当前和存档的经验来修复失败,并在最终确认之前保存成功. 我们的分析定性为选择引起的乐观,并将遗憾分解为选择、吸收和确认错误。 与随机继承相比,Heir承诺将接受更新的有害份额减少68-83%,接受率相同. EvoHeir在四个骨干中实现了最好的数学和一般推理平均,比最强的基准Agent0提高了5.3%。 该框架允许有用的经验继续存在,即使所产生的模式没有被继承。

articles.title: Priming Base Models for Agentic Post-Training: An Open Midtraining Recipe
articles.content: Frontier models, general-purpose and domain-specific alike, now include a midtraining stage between pretraining and post-training, but little has been published about how this stage is built. We present an open midtraining recipe that primes base models for agentic post-training, and we show its effectiveness on two Nemotron models of different sizes. Pretraining typically runs at short context and sees almost no agent interactions, while SFT data is mostly synthetic, and very long SFT stages can hurt the model's later RL trainability. Our midtraining stage sits between the two. It trains at 256K context for hundreds of billions of tokens on a diverse mixture of natural software-engineering data like packed repositories, pull requests, commit histories, and build logs together with a small share of agentic traces. On Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, 500B midtraining tokens improve SWE-bench Verified from 60.7 to 64.5, SWE-bench Multilingual from 55.8 to 62.8, and SWE-bench Pro from 32.0 to 35.5 after identical full SFT. On the larger Nemotron 3.5 Super, 280B midtraining tokens improve DeepSWE, a harder benchmark of long-horizon tasks, from 11.7 to 15.7 and SWE-bench Verified from 72.9 to 74.3 after identical full SFT. Midtraining also improves robustness across agent harnesses on both models. We report the ablations behind the recipe and an evaluation protocol built on short fixed SFT runs, since base-model proxy metrics did not correlate reliably with post-training results.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理培训后的定价基础模型:一个开放的中级培训配方
articles.content_zh: 边疆模式,无论是通用模式还是特定领域模式,现在都包括培训前培训与培训后培训之间的中期培训阶段,但对这一阶段的建设方式几乎没有发表。 我们提出了一种开放式的中期训练方法,它为动力后训练的基础模型提供素材,我们在两种不同大小的尼莫特龙模型上显示出它的功效. Pretrain通常在短上下文中运行,几乎看不到代理交互,而SFT数据大多是合成的,而非常长的SFT相位会伤害模型后期的RL列车可操作性. 我们的中场训练阶段位于两者之间。 它以256K为背景,在诸如被包装的存储器,拉取请求,承诺历史,以及少量的代理痕迹等多种软件-工程数据组合上,对上千亿令牌进行训练. 在Nemotron 3.5闪电上,500B的中训活符改进了SWE-bench验证从60.7到64.5,SWE-bench多种语言从55.8到62.8,SWE-bench Pro经过完全相同的SFT后从32.0到35.5. 在更大的Nemotron 3.5 Super上,280B的中训符号改进了DeepSWE,这是长视任务较硬的基准,从11.7到15.7,SWE-bench在完全相同的SFT后验证从72.9到74.3. 中期培训还改进了对两种模式的利用。 我们报告食谱背后的裂痕和建立在SFT短短固定运行基础上的评价协议,因为基模代用计量标准与培训后结果不可靠。

articles.title: P2TPO: Structure-Aligned Page-to-Token Credit Assignment for Full-Page Document Parsing
articles.content: End-to-end full-page document parsing must preserve the content and structure of heterogeneous elements, yet otherwise accurate outputs can contain local errors and omissions. A single page-level advantage does not explicitly identify which elements differ in quality across sampled outputs or where their errors occur. We introduce Page-to-Token Policy Optimization (P2TPO), a structure-aligned credit-assignment framework that operates on full-page policy trajectories. Reference-element alignment first associates block-level quality contrasts with generated spans. Unified Anchor Pricing (UAP) incorporates matched and missing element outcomes and provides feedback relative to a fixed quality ceiling when sampled outputs receive identical but imperfect scores for a reference element. Within matched blocks, Span Credit Redistribution (SCR) redistributes existing block credit according to aligned correct and erroneous spans, using boundary proxies for within-block omissions while preserving the total block-derived advantage across its tokens. Under a fixed-weight additive page utility, we show that element-indexed contrasts retain local quality differences that page-level aggregation can cancel out. In the main experimental comparison, P2TPO outperforms all evaluated policy optimization baselines in seed-averaged scores on each of the six document parsing benchmarks. Additional experiments demonstrate gains across model scales and initializations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: P2TPO: 全页文档解析的结构- 相通的页面对帐信用指定
articles.content_zh: 端到端的全页文档解析必须保留不同元素的内容和结构,而否则准确的产出可能包含局部出错和遗漏. 单一的页面优势没有明确确定在抽样产出中哪些内容在质量上有所不同,或出现错误。 我们采用Page-to-token政策优化(P2TPO),这是一个结构相协调的信用分配框架,在全页政策轨迹上运作。 参考元素对接第一关联区块级质量与生成跨度的对比. 统一Anchor定价(UAP)包含匹配和缺失的元素结果,并在抽样产出获得相同但不完整的参考要素分数时提供与固定质量上限相比的反馈. 在相匹配的区块内,Span信用再分配(SCR)根据对齐的正确和错误的跨度重新分配现有区块信用,使用边界代用符来弥补区块内遗漏,同时保留其代用符上总的区块衍生优势. 在固定重量的添加剂页面工具下,我们显示元素索引对比保留了本地质量差异,页面级汇总可以抵消. 在主要实验性比较中,P2TPO在六个文件分析基准中每个基准的种子平均分数上都超过了所有评价的政策优化基线。 其他实验表明,在模型尺度和初始化方面都取得了收益。

articles.title: Learning Speech Attribute Representations via Multi-Teacher Distillation
articles.content: Recent post-training approaches have shown that self-supervised speech encoders can be adapted to learn a single utterance-level speech attribute through knowledge distillation. In this work, we investigate whether a single speech encoder can simultaneously preserve multiple complementary utterance-level speech representations. We propose a multi-attribute multi-teacher distillation framework that learns semantic, speaker, language, and emotion representations from four frozen teacher models using a shared SSL backbone and attribute-specific branches. Experiments on multilingual semantic retrieval, speaker verification, language identification, and speech emotion recognition show that the proposed model achieves performance close to dedicated single-task students while requiring only a single shared encoder. Furthermore, the learned layer aggregation strategies reveal that different speech attributes naturally emerge at different depths of the SSL encoder, providing new insights into the organization of speech representations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过多教师分解学习语音属性说明
articles.content_zh: 最近的后培训方法表明,自我监督的语音编码器可以通过知识分解来被改造来学习单一的语音层次的语音属性. 在这项工作中,我们调查单一的语音编码器是否能够同时保留多个互补的语音层次的语音表述. 我们提出一个多属性的多教师提炼框架,利用共享的SSL主干和属性特定分支,从四个被冻结的教师模型中学习语义,演讲者,语言和情感表达. 关于多语种语义检索,演讲者验证,语言识别,和语音情感识别的实验表明,所拟议的模型实现了接近专注的单任务学生的性能,同时只需要一个单一的共享编码器. 此外,学习的分层汇总战略表明,不同的语音属性自然出现在SSL编码器的不同深度上,为语音表述的组织提供了新的见解.

articles.title: TEM: Temporal State Tracking Memory for Large Language Model Agents
articles.content: An agent's memory must remain useful as information changes across conversations. A new fact may replace an earlier value without making that value irrelevant to a later question. We present Temporal State Tracking Memory (TEM), a training-free framework for tracking these changes. TEM stores facts as versioned records linked to their sources. It retrieves relevant versions, places them in source order and labels historical records before passing the evidence to the answer model. Event memory and original dialogue turns provide details missing from structured facts. We evaluated TEM on 420 questions drawn from 600 sessions involving 60 personas. Across four open-weight models, key-entity hit rates reached 75.71-97.62% overall and 96.67-100.00% on the historical-residence subset. Adding historical labels to otherwise identical, source-ordered facts increased overall hit rates by 17.14-55.95 percentage points. The evidence was compact: 94-118 tokens per answer, or 48.75-56.73% less than session-aware retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). A further evaluation on 1,540 LoCoMo questions tested hybrid memory under a fixed evidence budget. TEM exceeded session-aware RAG with both backbones; conservative score differences were 7.92 and 10.58 percentage points. The results support preserving fact versions and exposing their temporal status to the generator when answering questions about repeatedly updated information.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TEM: 大语言模型代理的时态跟踪记忆
articles.content_zh: 随着对话中信息的变化,经纪人的记忆必须保持有用。 新的事实可能取代早先的数值,而不使该数值与以后的问题无关。 我们提出《国家追踪记忆》,这是跟踪这些变化的无培训框架。 TEM将事实存储为与其来源相关的版本记录. 它检索出相关版本,将它们按出处顺序排列并给历史记录贴上标签,然后将证据传递给答案模型. 事件记忆和原始对话转弯提供了结构化事实中缺失的细节. 我们评价了TEM对来自600场会议、涉及60人的420个问题的评价。 在四种开放重量模式中,关键实体的命中率总体达到75.71-97.62%,历史居住子集的命中率达到96.67%-100.0%。 将历史标签加进原本相同的、源头命令的事实,使整体打击率提高了17.14-55.95个百分点。 证据是紧凑的:每回94-118个令牌,或48.75-56.73%,比会话感知回取增强生成(RAG)少. 进一步评价了1,540个LoCoMo问题,在固定的证据预算下测试了混合内存. TEM以双主干超越了会话意识RAG;保守得分差异为7.92分和10.58分. 结果支持保留事实版本,并在回答关于反复更新信息的问题时向生成者披露其时间状态.

articles.title: Dynamic ordering in sequence generation in Transformers: experiments on low-resource Tagging scenarios
articles.content: This paper introduces TagInsert, a Transformer-based model that challenges the common left-to-right (L2R) generation paradigm in Transformers, for sequence labelling tasks where dependencies may not naturally align with a L2R order. TagInsert lifts the L2R constraint by removing the decoder-side attention mask and enabling the model to decide a preferred order of tag generation at inference time. We experiment on the common Part-of-Speech tagging and the more complex Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG) supertagging tasks on multiple languages and low-resource data settings. We show that, although encoder-only models like BERT remain strong performers for tagging tasks, TagInsert frequently outperforms a L2R encoder-decoder model, achieves results comparable to encoder-only models under data-scarce conditions, and shows better results on the long-tail of rare categories. Our analyses show that TagInsert alleviates error propagation typical of autoregressive models by learning to defer difficult predictions to later stages in the decoding process.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 变形器中按序列生成的动态顺序:关于低资源调试情景的实验
articles.content_zh: 本文引入了TagInsert,一种基于变形器的模型,挑战变形器中常见的从左到右(L2R)生成范式,用于序列标签任务,其中依赖性可能不自然地与L2R顺序相符合. TagInsert通过去掉解码器-侧注意力罩来解除L2R的制约,并使得模型能够在推断时间决定一个标签生成的首选顺序. 我们实验了通用的分词标记和比较复杂的组合分类语法(CCG)在多种语言和低资源数据设置上的叠加任务. 我们显示,虽然像BERT这样的只编码器的模型在标记任务上仍然是很强的表演者,但TagInsert经常比L2R编码器-解码器模型表现优于L2R编码器-解码器模型,在数据稀缺条件下实现与只编码器模型相仿的结果,并在稀有类别的长尾上显示更好的结果. 我们的分析表明,TagInsert通过学习将困难的预测推迟到解码过程的后期,缓解了自旋模型典型的错误传播.

articles.title: N-Gram Memories at Two Bits: Quantizing Lookup Tables in Large Language Models
articles.content: Conditional memory expands language-model capacity through selective lookup, but the full embedding table must remain available for every possible input. We introduce Conditional Program (CP), a compressed representation that reconstructs only the rows an input requests. CP represents each row by a short code and a local scale, with a reconstruction program shared across the table. We instantiate this representation with a Gaussian trellis, norm restoration and independently decodable row records. CP's two-bit code lowers output KL by 41--63\% relative to 2-bit round-to-nearest. Analysis across three trained n-gram memory families shows that Gaussian-like coordinate statistics coexist with learned relationships among rows; at matched storage budgets, the shared trellis outperforms the fitted codebooks and low-rank residual variants we test. For DeepSeek, it reduces table storage from 203GB to 51GB, leaving room for larger workloads when the table is kept on GPU.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: N-Gram Memories at Two Bits: 在大语言模型中量化查询表
articles.content_zh: 有条件的内存通过选择性的取景来扩展语言-模型的能力,但每个可能的输入都必须保留完整的嵌入表. 我们引入了条件程序(CP),这是一个压缩的表示,它只重建一行输入请求. CP通过一个简短的代码和局部的尺度来代表每行,在表格上共享一个重建程序. 我们用高斯三角形 规范修复 和独立的可解码行记录 来即时化这个代表 CP的双位码将输出的KL比相较于2位相圆相近更低了41-63\%. 对三个训练有素的正克内存家庭的分析显示,高斯式坐标统计与各行之间学到的知识关系并存;在匹配的存储预算中,共享的三角形比我们测试的已安装的编码本和低等的剩余变体要好。 对于DeepSeek来说,它将表存储量从203GB减少到了51GB,在表被保留在GPU上时留下了更大的工作量空间.

articles.title: RoleQ: Role-Aligned Scales for Converting Language Models to Ternary
articles.content: Weight quantization below four bits shrinks memory and bandwidth at a perplexity that looks acceptable, but often at the cost of factual knowledge and task accuracy. Ternary weights have mostly been obtained by training from scratch or long fine-tuning. We introduce RoleQ, a quantization framework that places scales by the functional roles of Transformer units rather than by the layout of the weight matrix, as conventional formats do. Vectors that read from the residual stream take one scale per output unit; those that write to it, one per input unit. The rule is structural, needs no search, calibration or stored state, and holds on integer and ternary grids. In a rotated basis it matches a per-layer axis search at half the solver work, and at ternary it cuts perplexity by up to half against layout-based placement in two families at every size from 0.6B to 14B, where per-row scales leave MMLU at chance. Our lightweight post-training pipeline converts an existing checkpoint to 1.59 bits per weight in a few GPU-hours, a fraction of the cost of learned ternarization, and leads every post-training ternary method at matched or lower memory-resident bits on perplexity, zero-shot accuracy and MMLU, most widely on knowledge. A sparse second ternary plane placed by a per-unit Fisher saliency keeps the matmul multiplication-free and recovers what ternary loses first: at 8B, a fraction of a bit returns about half the MMLU that conversion costs, well ahead of random or Hessian-based placement at equal bits.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 角色Q: 将语言模型转换为三等模组的任务相适应的缩放
articles.content_zh: 4个比特以下的重量量子化会收缩内存和带宽,其复杂性看起来可以接受,但往往以事实知识和任务准确性为代价. 初等体重大多通过从零开始或长期微调的训练获得. 我们引入了"角色Q"(Locus Q),一个量化框架,按照变形器单元的功能作用,而不是像常规格式那样按照权重矩阵的布局来放出尺度. 从残流读取的矢量每个输出单位取一个比例;写给它的矢量,每个输入单位取一个比例. 规则是结构的,不需要搜索,校正或存储状态,并坚持整数和三相网格. 在旋转的基础上,它与半个溶解器工作的每层轴搜索相匹配,在三分点时,它与基于布局的布局在大小从0.6B到14B两个家庭的安置相比,将复杂度削减了多至一半,每行平面可能留下MMLU。 我们的轻量级训练后管线在几小时的GPU中将现有的检查点转换为每重量1.59比特,这是所学取的三角化成本的一小部分,并且将每个训练后三角化方法以相匹配或较低的内存-居民比特(英语:Content-ternary bits)引导到迷惑性,零发精度和MMLU,最广泛的是在知识上. 每个单位的Fisher saliency所放置的稀疏的第二三相平面保持了matmul相乘的无阻性,并恢复了Ternary首先失去的东西:在8B时,有一小部分的微分返回了大约一半的MMLU的转换成本,远远领先于随机或以黑森为主的平分放置在等位.

articles.title: Content associations with answer selection and engagement in supply chain community question answering
articles.content: Community question-answering platforms are important ecosystems for knowledge sharing, yet research on what makes an answer best or a question engaging has often focused on either individual lexical features or broad topics. This exploratory study examines both levels in Yahoo! Chiebukuro, asking which nouns and semantic noun clusters are associated with best-answer selection and question engagement. We analyze a large corpus of questions and answer-tier posts collected under the keyword logistics, using an offline machine-translation pipeline with manually validated noun-level fidelity. Best-answer selection is modeled with conditional logistic regression within question threads, controlling for answer length, order, and question-answer noun overlap. Engagement is modeled in two stages: whether a question receives any response and, conditional on receiving one, how many responses it attracts. Operational logistics nouns such as distribution, warehouse, and center are associated with best-answer selection, whereas broader civic and infrastructure nouns such as car, tax, and shinkansen are associated with higher engagement. At the cluster level, most semantic noun clusters are associated with best-answer selection, while the clusters associated with response likelihood and response volume are largely distinct. These findings reveal differentiated content-outcome profiles across answer and question levels and provide a domain-wide descriptive map of engagement and answer selection in logistics-related cQA discourse.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 内容协会,有答案选择和参与供应链社区问答
articles.content_zh: 社区问答平台是知识共享的重要生态系统,但是,关于什么是最佳答案或问题参与的研究往往侧重于个别词汇特征或广泛的专题。 这项探索性研究考察了雅虎的两种水平! Chiebukuro,询问哪些名词和语义名词组与最佳答案选择和提问约定相关. 我们分析在关键词物流下收集的大量问答级职位,使用离线机翻译管道,人工验证名词级忠诚度。 最佳解答选择是以问题线索内有条件的逻辑回归为模式,控制答案长度,顺序,以及问答名词相重叠. 参与模式分两个阶段:一个问题是否得到任何答复,以及以得到答复为条件,吸引多少答复。 分发、仓库和中心等业务后勤名词与最佳答案选择有关,而汽车、税收和shinkansen等更广泛的公民和基础设施名词与更高的参与程度有关。 在分组层面,大多数语义名词组与最优答案选择相关联,而与响应可能性和响应量相关的分组则基本不同. 这些调查结果揭示了不同答复和问题层面的内容-结果概况,并提供了全域范围关于参与情况的说明图和在与物流有关的CQA讨论中的答案选择。

articles.title: Behavioral Forgetting Is Not Privacy in Machine Unlearning
articles.content: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted information from large language models, but existing evaluations often measure forgetting only on a designated benchmark distribution.
