We argue that such behavioral forgetting is an insufficient standard for privacy-oriented unlearning, and that evaluation should instead test whether forgetting persists across the access paths through which the same information may be recovered. We demonstrate this with a controlled case study of cross-lingual querying: across multiple multilingual model families, forgetting varies substantially when semantically equivalent information is queried in different languages and scripts. A single access path is therefore enough to expose a real gap between behavioral forgetting and information inaccessibility, motivating broader evaluation of access-path generalization and adversarial recoverability alongside in-distribution forgetting.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 行为忘记不是机器中的隐私
articles.content_zh: 机器不学习的目的是从大型语文模式中去除有针对性的信息,但现有的评价往往只衡量在指定基准分配上被遗忘的情况。 我们主张,这种忘记行为不足以成为注重隐私的不学习的标准,而评价应检验在可能检索相同信息的进入途径上是否仍然存在忘记。 我们用对跨语言查询的可控案例研究来证明这一点:在多种多语言示范家庭,当以不同语言和脚本查询内容相当的信息时,忘记差异很大。 因此,单一的准入途径足以揭示行为遗忘与信息无法获得之间的真正差距,促使更广泛地评价准入途径的通俗化和对抗性可恢复性,同时避免传播。

articles.title: In the Guise of Correction: How Framing and Cultural Adaptation Erode LLM Safety on Real-World Criminal Cases
articles.content: Existing safety benchmarks rely largely on synthetic prompts with loosely grounded taxonomies and offer little focused analysis of severe crime categories. We introduce GUISE, a benchmark of criminal-assistance scenarios sourced from real-world cases and organised under a taxonomy from the UNODC International Classification of Crime for Statistical Purposes (ICCS). Each scenario is rendered under three linguistic framings and evaluated across five distinct cultures. Using our proposed two-tier evaluation framework, which judges both harmfulness and operational uplift, we find that: (i) framing alone drives unsafe compliance, with the mean unsafe compliance rate rising from 28.9% under direct requests to 66.4% under correction seeking (peaking at 97.3%; p < 0.05), as models correcting deliberately distorted details supply executable criminal steps; (ii) culturally adapted prompts elicit significantly more unsafe compliance than literal translations of the same requests in all four non-English languages (+7 to +18 points), a risk that translation-based benchmarks miss; and (iii) unsafe responses from the least-safe models carry strong Anglocentric registers, and the extent of this leakage increases monotonically with response harmfulness ($ρ$ = 0.46 to 0.63 across languages, all p < 0.001). GUISE offers a grounded resource and fine-grained diagnostics for strengthening refusal alignment across languages and cultures. We publish our code and data to facilitate future research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在《纠正的吉斯:如何塑造和文化适应》中,Erode LLM对真实世界刑事案件的安全
articles.content_zh: 现有的安全基准主要依靠有松散基础的分类的合成提示,对严重犯罪类别几乎没有重点分析。 我们介绍了GUISE,这是从现实世界案件中得出的、根据毒品和犯罪问题办公室统计目的国际犯罪分类(ICCS)分类法组织的刑事援助情景的基准。 每种情况在三种语言框架下进行,并评价五个不同文化的情况。 我们利用我们提议的双层评价框架,既判断有害性,又判定可操作性提升,发现:(一) 单靠框架推动不安全的遵守,平均不安全的遵守率从直接请求下的28.9%上升到寻求纠正的66.4%(高峰为97.3%;p < 0.05),作为纠正故意扭曲的细节的模型,提供可执行的犯罪步骤;(二) 文化适应的提示促使遵守程度大大高于以所有四种非英语(+7至+18分)对同一请求的文字翻译,这种基于翻译的基准有可能错失;(三) 最安全模式的不安全反应带有很强的异心登记册,这种泄漏的程度与各种语言的有害反应单向单向增加(美元=0.46至0.63美元,所有第0.001页)。 GUISE为加强不同语言和文化之间的拒绝一致提供了基础资源和精细的诊断。 我们公布我们的代码和数据以促进未来的研究。

articles.title: Bias Mitigation in Audio-Enabled LLMs through Adversarial Training and Distillation Methods
articles.content: Audio-enabled large language models (AuLLMs) allow users to interact with them simply by talking to them, without the need for an intermediate transcription. This expands the model's accessibility and capabilities by encoding non-verbal cues. However, using non-verbal cues may lead to biased behaviour based on the attributes inferred (or assumed) from them. In this work, we focus on the gender attribute and show that models' perception of it can be unlearned using adversarial methods without a loss in performance on other benchmarked tasks. Such models are useful in situations where gender inference is unwanted. However, in other practical settings, gender perception (without bias) may be desired.As a less radical measure, we distil the gender-agnostic model, creating a model that perceives gender but responds similarly to the gender-agnostic teacher, unless explicitly asked.We apply our newly proposed methods to three AuLLMs and obtain satisfactory results in the gender-unlearning part and partially satisfactory results in the distilling part.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过横向培训和稀释方法减少听力可控LLMs中的偏见
articles.content_zh: 音频化的大型语言模型(AulLMs)允许用户仅通过和他们交谈而与他们互动,而不需要中间的转录. 这通过编码非语言提示来扩展模型的可访问性和能力. 然而,使用非语言提示可能导致基于其推断(或假设)的属性的有偏见的行为. 在这项工作中,我们侧重于性别属性,并表明,模型对它的看法可以采用对抗性方法而不会丧失其他基准任务的业绩。 这种模式在不需要性别推论的情况下是有用的。 然而,在其他实际环境中,(没有偏见的)性别观念可能是可取的。 作为较不激进的措施,我们提炼了性别不可知论模式,创造了一种认识性别但类似性别不可知论教师的模型,除非明确要求。 我们把最近提出的方法应用于三个Aullems,并在性别学习部分取得令人满意的结果,在提炼部分取得部分令人满意的结果。

articles.title: DeciCAD: Harness-Grounded Learning of Action Policies for CAD Agents
articles.content: Large Language Model agents operate through closed-loop action policies whose decision space is defined by an agent harness. We investigate how this operating space shapes agent behavior and policy learning in computer-aided design (CAD), a professional domain characterized by persistent state, geometric constraints, and long-horizon procedures. We instantiate this perspective in DeciCAD, a domain-native harness that exposes semantic CAD actions, decision-oriented observations, environment feedback, and persistent state transitions. Building on this harness, we develop a learning pipeline that extracts causal decision supervision from interaction trajectories and improves the policy through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and geometry-grounded online reinforcement learning (RL). Across four CAD benchmarks, DeciCAD achieves the best F1 and intersection over union (IoU) while reducing model-output tokens by 45--88% relative to a general-purpose coding harness. Under matched supervision, its SFT policy improves F1 from 0.6883 to 0.7437 and outperforms the coding policy; subsequent online RL further raises geometry availability from 66.5% to 73.5% and F1 to 0.7880. These results demonstrate that the decision space induced by a harness materially affects both agent execution and policy learning in CAD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DeciCAD:为CAD代理人全面学习行动政策
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型代理商通过闭路行动政策运作,其决策空间由代理管来定义. 我们调查这个操作空间如何塑造计算机辅助设计(CAD)中的代理行为和政策学习,这个专业领域的特点是持续状态、几何限制和长视距程序。 我们在DeciCAD中即时分析这一视角,这是一种域-内在的利用,它暴露了语义上的CAD行动,以决策为导向的观察,环境反馈,以及持续的状态过渡. 在此基础上,我们开发了一个学习管道,从互动轨迹中提取因果决策监督,并通过监督微调(SFT)和几何定位在线强化学习(RL)来改进政策. 在四个CAD基准中,DeciCAD实现了最好的F1和相交结合(IoU),同时相对于一个通用编码管减少了45-88%的模型输出信号. 在相应的监督下,其SFT政策将F1从0.6883提高到了0.7437,并且超过了编码政策;随后的在线RL进一步将几何学可用率从66.5%提高到了73.5%,F1提高到了0.7880. 这些结果表明,利用手段带来的决策空间在物质上影响到CAD的代理执行和政策学习。

articles.title: Reliable Knowledge Acquisition for Continual Learning Agents
articles.content: As agents powered by foundation models move into open-ended environments, continual learning from experience becomes essential. For agents built on models with fixed parameters, this learning requires reusing prior task experience in context to improve performance and efficiency on future tasks. Existing memory and experience-learning systems typically focus on either retained facts or procedures, and lack a mechanism for establishing the reliability of claims extracted from the ongoing task stream. Indeed, we find that approximately 12--33\% of entries produced by representative systems harm future task performance when reused. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{RIKA} (Reliable Knowledge Acquisition), which combines hierarchical extraction of factual, conceptual, procedural, and metacognitive knowledge with Evidence-based Knowledge Admission, which uses source evidence and subsequent experience to govern which claims enter the task agent's context, without additional validation tasks. Across six task streams from Continual Learning Bench and four model backbones, RIKA achieves the highest aggregate score on every backbone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 持续学习代理人的可靠知识获取
articles.content_zh: 随着基础模型的推动因素进入开放环境,不断从经验中学习变得至关重要。 对于基于有固定参数的模型的代理人来说,这种学习需要重新利用以前的任务经验,以提高未来任务的业绩和效率。 现有的记忆和经验学习系统通常侧重于保留的事实或程序,缺乏一种机制来确定从目前的任务流中提取的索赔的可靠性。 事实上,我们发现,在代表系统制作的条目中,大约有12-33分左右的条目在重复使用时会损害未来的任务性能。 为解决这些局限性,我们提议\textbf{RIKA}(可靠知识获取),将事实知识、概念知识、程序性知识和元认知知识的分级提取与基于证据的知识获取结合起来,利用来源证据和随后的经验来规范声称进入任务代理背景的情况,而不增加验证任务。 在连续学习班的6个任务流和4个示范骨干中,RIKA在每个骨干中取得了最高的总分.

articles.title: SceneWeave: Audience-Guided Scene Exploration for Dramatic Adaptation
articles.content: Adapting prose into a script requires transforming narration and inner experience into scenes that convey relationships and psychological contradictions. Planning specifies intended effects but leaves their realization in dialogue and action unresolved. Drawing on screenwriters' accounts of revising scenes and their connections to the surrounding work, we present SceneWeave, which uses alternative scene drafts to revise the adaptation as a whole. It writes contrasting treatments of a focal scene, compares the interactions they create, and revises characterization, preceding preparation, subsequent development, and scene order before generating the complete script. The central contribution is to use actual scene writing to inform adaptation decisions and propagate their consequences across the work. We also develop a task-specific writing model and a human-preference model for comparing script drafts. The writing model learns from adaptation examples and human preferences; the preference model combines human and synthetic supervision. Blind reader comparisons favor SceneWeave over a baseline workflow and description-based controls, while content assessment indicates reduced narrative redundancy and strong psychological treatment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 场景周游:为戏剧性适应进行观众指导的场景探索
articles.content_zh: 将通俗改编为剧本需要将叙事和内在经历转化为传达关系和心理矛盾的场景. 规划明确了预期效果,但通过对话和行动实现这些效果。 我们借鉴编剧们关于修订场景及其与周边作品的关联的叙述,呈现出SceneWeave,它使用另类场景草稿来修改整体的改编. 它书写了对焦场景的对比处理,比较了它们创造的相互作用,并在生成完整的脚本之前修改了特征,前作准备,后作发展和场景顺序. 中心贡献是利用实际现场写作为适应决定提供信息,并在整个工作中宣传其后果。 我们还开发了针对特定任务的写作模式和比较脚本草稿的人文偏好模式. 写作模式学习了适应实例和人类偏好;偏好模式结合了人和合成监督. 盲人阅读器比较偏向于SceneWeave,优于基线工作流程和基于描述的控制,而内容评估则表明叙事冗余性降低并有强烈的心理治疗.

articles.title: Retrieved but Not Read: Understanding Why Search-Augmented LLMs Fail to Use Available Evidence
articles.content: Web search allows LLMs to access up-to-date information, but it remains unclear why they sometimes produce outdated answers even when relevant evidence is available. To study this problem, we construct temporal facts whose values changed after the models' training cutoffs. We evaluate one proprietary model under deployed web search and six open-weight model configurations under controlled retrieval. We find that models often answer from search snippets without opening the source pages, which is associated with higher rates of outdated answers and unfaithful citations. Our controlled experiments and layer-wise analysis reveal a gap between the availability of evidence and its effective use. Even when retrieved evidence influences internal predictions, models may still favour outdated information in their final answers. We hope these findings will help advance research on the reliable use of retrieved evidence in search-augmented LLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 已获取但未读: 理解为什么搜索- 增强的 LLMs 无法使用可用证据
articles.content_zh: 网络搜索可以让LLMs访问最新信息,但目前仍不清楚为什么它们有时即使有相关证据也会产生过时的答案. 为了研究这个问题,我们构建了时间性事实,这些事实的价值在模型的训练停课后发生了变化。 我们评价部署的网络搜索下的一个专有模型,以及控制检索下的六个开放量模型配置。 我们发现模型经常从搜索片段中解答,而不打开源页,这与更高的过时解答率和不诚实的引用有关. 我们的控制实验和分层分析显示,证据的可得性和有效使用之间存在差距。 即使在检索到的证据影响内部预测时,模型在最终答案中仍然可能倾向于过时的信息. 我们希望这些调查结果将有助于推进关于可靠地利用检索证据进行搜索和鉴定的法学硕士的研究。

articles.title: FIRM: Fisher-Informed Retention Merging for Federated LLM Unlearning
articles.content: Federated LLM unlearning addresses targeted knowledge removal when forget and retain data remain distributed across private clients and are inaccessible to the server. The resulting locally trained adapters encode conflicting objectives, making their aggregation fundamentally different from conventional federated optimization. A key failure mode is magnitude explosion, whereby unnormalized cross-client aggregation increases the merged update magnitude and degrades retained utility under stronger unlearning. We propose FIRM (Fisher-Informed Retention Merging), a single-round framework for stable and retention-aware server-side aggregation. FIRM uses client-local Fisher statistics as a unified sensitivity signal to construct a Fisher-normalized base merge and impose explicit control over retain-sensitive parameters. Its second-order retention projection admits a unique minimum-distance solution, while the corresponding dual scales with the number of retain clients rather than the model dimension. Experiments across WMDP, TOFU, and MUSE-HP using Zephyr-7B and Llama-3-8B show utility gains at comparable forgetting on WMDP and MUSE-HP, with metric-dependent trade-offs on TOFU. Controlled comparisons support benefits of the combined base merge and additional retention correction at selected operating points.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FIRM:联邦LLM的渔业-建制保留合并 未学习
articles.content_zh: 在忘记和保留数据时,联邦LLM不学习解决有针对性的知识去除问题,但数据仍然分布在私人客户之间,服务器无法访问。 由此产生的经过当地培训的适配器编码了相冲突的目标,使得它们的汇总与传统的联邦优化有根本的不同. 一个关键故障模式是规模爆炸,即非正常的跨客户汇总会增加合并的更新规模,并降低在较强的不学习条件下保留的作用。 我们提议采用FIRM(Fisher-Informed Reading Meging),这是一个单一回合框架,用于稳定且具有保留意识的服务器侧式聚合. FIRM使用客户-本地的费舍统计作为统一的敏感信号来构建费舍尔规范化的碱基合并,并对保留敏感参数实施明确的控制. 其二阶保留投影承认了一种独特的最小距离解决方案,而相应的双阶保留客户数量而不是模型维度. 使用Zephyr-7B和Llama-3-8B进行的跨越大规模毁灭性武器方案、TOFU和MUSE-HP的实验显示,在类似情况下,可以忽略大规模毁灭性武器方案和MUSE-HP的效用收益,而TOFU的取舍则依靠衡量。 控制比较支持合并基数合并和在选定的操作点进行额外保留修正的好处。

articles.title: Human Interventions as Labels: Localizing, Steering, and (Sometimes) Editing the Computations Behind LLM Agent Failures
articles.content: When an LLM agent misbehaves, a human steps in, and that intervention is usually discarded or replayed as training data. We treat it instead as a measurement: a label pointing at the internal computation that failed. We study it in a controlled agent environment, on one failure (asking a clarifying question when the request was already unambiguous), with labels from a rule-based overseer validated against blind human judgment. Claims cover eligible models, which both over-ask and sometimes act on matched unambiguous requests: five of thirteen qualified (Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b, OLMo-3-7B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Phi-4). Four findings. First, the ask-vs-act decision is causally localizable in every eligible family: a direction learned from intervention labels flips 72-100% of held-out over-asks at a definite residual-stream depth, with site and dose chosen on training data, and random directions under the same procedure flip at most one episode. Second, over-asking has two mechanistic signatures: in four families the model demonstrably knows the request is unambiguous (the belief is decodable, causally inert and orthogonal to the decision) and asks anyway; in the fifth, the rare over-asks track different world-representations. Third, steering gated on a probe readout removes most of the simulated oversight burden while legitimate questions survive (bootstrap 95% intervals exclude zero); a prompt instruction makes it worse. Fourth, consolidating the fix into the weights yields a map, not a rule: on one model a LoRA confined to the causal band passes every criterion fixed in advance while behavior cloning on identical data breaks retention; on three families the reverse holds; on the fifth the outcome crosses the boundary across seeds. A geometric rule written down in advance to predict the regime failed on two out-of-family tests; we report the failure and stop rather than fit a replacement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 作为标签的人类干预:定位、引导和(有时)编辑LLM代理失败背后的计算
articles.content_zh: 当LLM代理行为不当时,人类的一步进入,这种干预通常被丢弃或重放为训练数据. 我们把它当作一种衡量方法:一个标记指向失败的内部计算。 我们在一个受控制的代理环境中研究这个问题,一个失败(在请求已经明确时提出澄清问题),一个基于规则的监督者的标签与盲目的人类判断相抗衡。 索赔包括符合资格的模型,既任务过重,有时也按相应的明确要求行事:13个合格的模型中有5个(Quen2.5-3B、gemma-2-2b、OLMo-3-7B、Mistral-Nemo-12B、Phi-4)。 四个发现。 首先,要求-vs-act决定可以因果地在每一个符合条件的家庭进行:从干预标签中得知的方向在一定的后流深度上翻出72%-100%被搁置的过度任务,在培训数据上选择地点和剂量,在最多一集时在同一程序下随机方向翻出. 其次,过度任务有两个机械签名:在四个家庭中,模式显然知道请求是明确无误的(信念是可以解密的、因果性的和对决定的正统性的),而且无论如何都会问;在第五个家庭中,罕见的过度任务跟踪世界代表的不同情况。 第三,在探测器读取器上安装的导出门可消除大多数模拟监督负担,而合法问题则继续存在(95%的间隔排除为零);即时指示会使其更糟。 第四,将固定值合并到权重中产生出一张地图,而不是一条规则:在一个模型上,一个局限于因果波段的LORA在相同数据上的行为克隆打破了保留状态时,通过预先确定的每一个标准;在三个家庭中,反向持有;在第五个模型上,结果跨越了种子的边界。 在两次家庭外测试中,预先写下一项几何规则,以预测政权失败;我们报告失败,停止而不是适合替代。

articles.title: Abstracts or full text? Evaluating input scope and computational efficiency in biomedical lay summarization
articles.content: Biomedical research articles are mainly written for experts and often contain terms that are difficult for the general public to understand. Automated lay summarization has become a solution to make biomedical knowledge easier for patients and the public to understand. However, generating lay summaries from full-text articles requires more computing power because the articles are long and costly to process. Fine-tuning large language models for this task also requires substantial resources. This study asks two questions: (1) whether abstracts contain enough information to produce lay summaries as good as those based on full-text articles, and (2) whether few-shot learning performs as well as task-specific fine-tuning. The study used two public biomedical lay summarization datasets and two recent models, evaluated for readability, factual consistency, semantic similarity, and runtime efficiency. Results show that abstract-based summarization performs better overall. Across both datasets and models, abstract fine-tuning is 4.70 times faster, while abstract zero- and few-shot prompting is 5.31 times faster than full-text methods. These results show that abstract-based prompting reduces runtime cost while maintaining lay summary quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 文摘还是全文? 评价生物医学的投入范围和计算效率
articles.content_zh: 生物医学研究文章主要是为专家撰写的,并经常包含公众难以理解的术语. 自动化的平面归纳已成为使生物医学知识更方便患者和公众理解的一种解决方案. 然而,从全文文章中生成内容提要需要更多的计算能力,因为文章处理时间长而成本高. 精细调整大型语言模式以完成这项任务也需要大量资源。 本研究提出了两个问题:(1) 摘要是否包含足够的资料,以便产生与以全文文章为基础的内容一样好的概要;(2) 少拍学习以及针对具体任务的微调。 这项研究使用了两个公共生物医学分类汇总数据集和两个最近的模型,评价了可读性、事实一致性、语义相似性和运行时间效率。 结果显示,抽象归纳的总体表现更好。 在整个数据集和模型中,抽象的微调速度是4.70倍,而抽象的零发和几发的提示速度是全文方法的5.31倍. 这些结果表明,抽象的催化可以降低运行时间成本,同时保持固定的即时质量。

articles.title: Data Strategies for Large Language Models: A Unified Perspective on the Training Lifecycle
articles.content: Data strategy plays a central role in training large language models (LLMs). It governs the selection, weighting, and scheduling of training data, thereby determining the capabilities a model can acquire from a fixed data budget. We treat high-quality data as having high training-dependent utility, which depends on the target objective, the model, and its training state rather than on the text alone. Research in this area now spans pretraining and post-training, but related ideas use inconsistent terminology and evaluation protocols. This work reviews data strategies across the training lifecycle and formulates them as policies that allocate a training budget over candidate examples. We organise methods by their decision granularity, model dependence, and temporal adaptivity, then compare their computational requirements and empirical support. Fine-grained or state-dependent policies offer more control but incur additional scoring, search, or rollout costs. Evidence for transfer across model scales and comparable end-to-end cost remains limited. A continuously updated list of papers, along with their public implementations, is available at https://github.com/xuyj233/data_strategy_survey.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 大语言数据策略 模式:培训周期的统一视角
articles.content_zh: 数据策略在培训大型语言模型(LLM)方面起核心作用. 它管理培训数据的选择、加权和时间安排,从而确定一个模型可从固定数据预算中获取的能力。 我们把高质量数据视为具有高度依赖培训的效用,这取决于目标目标、模式及其培训状态,而不是仅仅取决于文本。 这一领域的研究现在跨越培训前和培训后,但相关想法使用的术语和评价规程不一致。 这项工作审查整个培训周期的数据战略,并将这些战略制定为政策,将培训预算分配给候选实例。 我们通过决定颗粒性、模型依赖性和时间适应性来组织方法,然后比较它们的计算要求和经验支持。 精细或依赖国家的政策提供了更多的控制,但需要额外的评分、搜索或推出费用。 跨模型比额表和可比较的端到端费用转移的证据仍然有限。 在https://github.com/xuyj233/data_strategy_survey上可查到一份不断更新的论文清单及其公开执行。

articles.title: No Single Tokenizer Feature Reliably Predicts Downstream Language Model Performance
articles.content: Tokenization is a critical component of the language modeling pipeline, but it is poorly understood. Tokenizers can impact downstream performance, but there is currently mixed evidence about which tokenizer features predict a better language model without requiring a full training run. In this paper, we analyze approximately 200 language models trained on nine different languages. We evaluate both models and their tokenizers and test whether there is a relationship between any proposed intrinsic tokenizer evaluations and model performance, as measured by a wide variety of benchmarks. Despite the quantity and variety of proposed intrinsic tokenizer metrics, we find that none consistently predicts downstream performance across model families, tasks, and languages. This motivates the need for novel tokenizer evaluation metrics and approaches. We propose novel linguistically grounded metric introduced in this work shows that new metrics can capture aspects of tokenizer quality that existing metrics miss, though their predictive power is likely to vary across model families, languages, and tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 无单一托克尼泽特性可合理预测下游语言模型性能
articles.content_zh: Tokenization是语言建模管道的关键组成部分,但理解不足. Tokenizers可以影响下游的性能,但目前有好坏参半的证据表明,哪一种标语特性预测一种更好的语言模型,而不需要全面训练。 在本文中,我们分析了大约200个语言模型,这些模型接受了九种不同语言的培训。 我们评价模型及其标注符,并测试任何拟议的内在标注符评价和模型性能之间是否有关系,衡量标准多种多样。 尽管拟议内在标志性指标数量多而种类多,但我们发现没有任何一个指标能够一致地预测模范家庭、任务和语言的下游业绩。 这促使需要新的象征性评价指标和方法。 我们提议在这部作品中引入新的基于语言的度量衡,表明新的度量衡可以捕捉到现有度量衡错失的标语质量方面,尽管其预测力可能因模型家族,语言和任务而异.

articles.title: Diffusion Language Models as Open Quantum Systems
articles.content: Diffusion language models generate text by reversing a classical diffusion process over token sequences. We show that their continuous-time forward and reverse dynamics can be embedded in the framework of open quantum systems, which describes quantum systems interacting with their environment. This connection provides a basis for extending diffusion sampling to superpositions of sentence states and for modifying the underlying generation dynamics. We construct a $τ$-leaping unraveling scheme that simulates stochastic trajectories of these states while updating multiple token positions at each step. This enables generation conditioned on superposed prompts or thoughts, which we call Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and Superposition of Thoughts (SoT). The same formulation yields Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR): perturbing the masked-diffusion dynamics produces a confidence-based rule for revising previously generated tokens. Experiments with pretrained diffusion language models show that superposition-based generation can retain information from conditioning components not selected at the final measurement, while QIR improves LLM-assessed text quality when applied at an appropriate stage of generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 传播语言模型作为开放量子系统
articles.content_zh: 分化语言模型通过倒置一个经典的传播过程而不是符号序列来生成文本. 我们显示,它们的连续时间前向和倒向动力学可以被嵌入到开放式量子系统的框架中,这个框架描述了量子系统与环境相互作用. 这种连接为将扩散取样扩展到句子状态的叠位以及修改基本的生成动力提供了基础. 我们设计了一个美元折叠方案, 模拟这些州的花样轨迹, 同时更新每个步骤的多个标志位置。 这使得生成以叠加的提示或想法为条件,我们称之为"叠加提示"(SoP)和"叠加想法"(SOT). 同一配方产生量子-启发重塑(QIR):扰动被遮掩的分化动态产生一个基于信任的规则来修订之前生成的符. 使用被预先训练的传播语言模型的实验表明,基于超位的生成可以保留在最终测量时没有选择的调制组件中的信息,而QIR在适当的生成阶段应用时会提高LLM评估的文本质量.

articles.title: Enhancing Multimodal RLVR with Pairwise Token Contrast and Adaptive Trajectory Confidence
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves multimodal reasoning, but group-relative policy optimization broadcasts a single sequence-level advantage to every token of a response, although errors usually localize to a few decisive steps. Recent self-distilled variants refine credit with a teacher--student likelihood gap. However, this signal cannot tell whether it relies on the image or on a language shortcut, and is applied uniformly even when the teacher is uninformative. To address this, we propose Pairwise token contrast and Adaptive trajectory ConfidencE (PACE). Pairwise token contrast scores each response under four teacher views, crossing a correct or incorrect answer hint with the image present or removed, and compares the two hints for every token, which cancels shifts shared by both hints and reveals whether the token's support relies on the image. Adaptive trajectory confidence measures how well the teacher predicts each response given the correct hint and the image, normalizes this score within the batch, and uses it to set how far the token contrast redistributes credit within that response. PACE achieves the best average accuracy on three backbones and ranks first on all evaluated multimodal reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Experiments show that both components matter: replacing pairwise token contrast with a single-view signal underperforms our method, while adaptive trajectory confidence adds further improvement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以对等Token对比和适应性轨迹信任增强多式RLVR
articles.content_zh: 具有可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR)改进了多模式推理,但集团关系政策优化向每个响应符号播送单一序列级的优势,尽管错误通常被本地化为几个决定性步骤. 最近自我消化的变体以师生概率差距完善了信用。 然而,这个信号无法分辨它是依赖于图像还是语言快捷键,即使在老师不知情的情况下也统一应用. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议对等符号对比和适应性轨迹自信(PACE)。 平面符号对比在四个老师视图下对每个响应进行分数,用所显示的或被删除的图像交叉一个正确或错误的答案提示,并比较每个符号的两个提示,这可以取消两个提示共享的切换,并揭示该符号的支持是否依赖于图像. 适应性轨迹信任度测量 老师如何根据正确的提示和图像 预测每个反应, 使这个分数在批量中正常化, 计算机设备行动伙伴关系在三个主干线上实现了最佳平均准确性,在所有经过评价的多模式推理基准中排名第一,采用Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct。 实验表明,这两个组成部分都很重要:用单视信号取代对偶信号,使我们的方法表现不佳,而适应性轨迹信心则会进一步提高。

articles.title: When Does "Post-Call" Begin? An Availability Contract for Earnings-Call NLP Benchmarks
articles.content: Corporate financial disclosures often unfold over time, with announcements, prepared remarks, and discussion spanning multiple high-frequency return intervals. Financial NLP benchmarks can therefore suffer from a within-event timing mismatch when the prediction target begins before the textual or audio input used by a model could be complete. Chronological train--test splits do not prevent this mismatch, because it occurs inside individual events rather than across samples. We introduce an Availability Contract, which requires a benchmark to state the input boundary, evidence for input availability, the outcome start, and the claims supported by that evidence. We apply this framework to 552 earnings calls from 24 firms. For each call, we hold the return endpoint fixed and compare the previous close, a documentary call-start proxy, and a completion proxy based on reconstructed audio end plus a stipulated processing allowance. At this baseline, moving from the call-start proxy to the completion proxy flips return signs for 9.4% of calls. Holding completion-clock cutpoints fixed, 28.3% change quintile. In an independent release-session analysis of a public earnings-call volatility benchmark, shifting before-market target windows forward by one trading session raises three-day mean squared error by 18.1-21.4% across four frozen prediction streams, while their point rankings remain unchanged. Together, the results show that labels and losses can depend materially on the declared outcome clock even when model rankings appear stable. The Availability Contract makes this assumption explicit and ties post-input claims to the available timing evidence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: "后呼"什么时候开始? 收入-电话NLP的可用合同 基准
articles.content_zh: 公司财务披露往往随时间推移而展开,包括公告、准备的评论和跨越多个高频回报间隔的讨论。 因此,当预测目标在模型使用的文字或音频输入完成之前开始时,金融NLP基准可能因事内时间不匹配而受到影响。 编年列车-测试分解并不能防止这种不匹配,因为它发生在单个事件内部而不是在样本之间. 我们提出了一项提供合同,要求有一个基准来说明投入界限、投入可用性的证据、结果的开始以及该证据所支持的索赔。 这个框架适用于24家公司的552个收入电话。 对于每通电话,我们固定返回端点,并比较先前的关闭,一个文件呼叫启动代理和一个基于重建后音频端的完成代理加上规定的处理允许. 在这个基线中,从调用启动代理转到完成代理翻转9.4%的调用返回标志. 持有完成点-定点,28.3%改变五分之一。 在对公共收入呼吁波动基准的独立发布会分析中,一次交易会将市场前目标窗口向前移动,在四个被冻结的预测流中,3天平均平方差18.1%至21.4%,而其分数排名保持不变。 综合结果表明,即使模型排名看起来稳定,标签和损失也可能在实质上依赖于宣布的结果钟. 《可提供性合同》明确了这一假设,并将投入后的索赔与现有时间证据联系起来。

articles.title: The Self-Improvement Problem
articles.content: With the rise of large language models, agentic systems are becoming increasingly autonomous, as they write code, call tools, revise prompts, and propose modifications to their own components. This autonomy raises a fundamental question for safe self-improvement: can an automated gate like a reward model or an automated reviewer reliably decide whether a proposed update should be accepted? The difficulty is structural. The gate must be a terminating, computable procedure, while the property we ultimately care about, namely whether an update is a genuine semantic improvement, depends on potentially unbounded program behavior. We formalize this mismatch by modeling agents as programs and defining improvement in terms of a semantic score that need not be computable. We study two evaluation abstractions. The first is a certifier that approves or rejects an update. The second is a search procedure that, given access to a proposal generator, attempts to output some improving candidate if one exists. We show that, in the fully general setting, no terminating procedure can simultaneously guarantee reliability (never accepting a non-improvement) and non-conservatism (never missing an available improvement): self-referential constructions can force any such gate or searcher to fail. Randomized gates with bounded error face the same limit. We then identify a standard decidable regime used in practice (bounded evaluation and a finite proposal budget) under which exhaustive simulation yields a terminating search procedure with the desired guarantees. We also show the limit of this recovery: a chain of accepted updates can raise the bounded score in every round while the true score falls. Our results draw a boundary between unbounded, universal settings where correctness guarantees collapse and bounded settings where they can be recovered by design.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自我改善问题
articles.content_zh: 随着大型语言模型的兴起,代理系统变得越来越自主,因为它们会写出代码,调用工具,修改提示,并提出修改自己的组件. 这种自主性提出了安全自我改进的根本问题:像奖励模型那样的自动闸门或者自动审查员能否可靠地决定是否应当接受提议的更新? 困难是结构性的。 门必须是一个终止的,可以计算的程序,而我们最终关心的财产,即更新是否是真正的语义改进,则取决于潜在的无约束的程序行为. 我们把这种不匹配现象正式化,将模型化的代理作为程序,并定义在语义分数上的改进,这些分数不需要计算. 我们研究两个评价抽象。 第一种是核准或拒绝更新的认证人。 第二种是搜索程序,如果可以访问一个提案生成器,则试图提供一些改进的候选人。 我们表明,在完全一般的环境下,任何终止程序都无法同时保证可靠性(绝不接受不改进)和非保守主义(绝不遗漏现有的改进):自我优惠的建造可以迫使任何这样的门或搜索者失败. 带有界限的错误的随机出闸面临相同的限制. 然后,我们确定在实践中使用的标准可裁定制度(有限度的评价和有限的拟议预算),根据该制度,详尽无遗的模拟产生一种终止的搜索程序,并提供所希望的保障。 我们还展示了这一复苏的极限:一连串被接受的更新可以在每轮提高受限分,而真正的分数则会下降. 我们的结果在无约束的、普遍的设置之间划出界限,在这种设置中,正确性保证崩溃,而在这种设置中,可以通过设计来恢复。

articles.title: Spurious Attention Heads in Vision Transformers: Mechanistic Identification of Annotation-Driven Bias in Medical Chest X-Ray Analysis
articles.content: Vision Transformers deployed in medical imaging exploit spurious correlations, yet the internal mechanisms remain unidentified and impossible to fix. We apply mechanistic interpretability to locate one such mechanism in ViT-Base 16: a single attention head (L8H10) that functions as a dedicated annotation-reader on chest X-rays, attending to corner text rather than lung pathology in 62% of 200 COVID-19 images. Causal validation via inpainting confirms annotation content rather than luminance or edge density drives the behaviour, increasing lung attention 1.52 times upon removal in affected images ($p{<}0.0001$). The finding replicates across NIH ChestX-ray14 (79%), DeiT-Base (88%), and ViT-Large 16 (80%), establishing spurious annotation-attending heads as a consistent property of ViT-family architectures across two datasets and three architectures. Full fine-tuning does not suppress the behaviour and may entrench it: 98.4% of spurious images remain spurious and the spurious rate rises marginally, as the shortcut is reinforced rather than removed. Critically, single-head ablation produces $p{=}0.340$ and multi-head ablation of all three identified carriers produces $p{=}0.532$, meaning a causally verified annotation-reading circuit is completely invisible to output-level evaluation. Mechanistic auditing finds what behavioural testing cannot.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视觉变换器中的纯洁关注头目:医学胸X射线分析中的注解-Driven Bias的机械识别
articles.content_zh: 在医疗成像中部署的视觉变形器利用了虚假的关联,然而内部机制仍然不明朗并无法修复. 我们运用机械解释能力在ViT-Base 16中找到一个这样的机制:一个单一的注意头(L8H10),它作为胸X射线的专用注释读取器发挥作用,在200个COVID-19图像中,62%的图像中注意角文本而不是肺病. 通过印花进行因果关系验证,证实注解内容,而不是发光或边缘密度,促使行为发生,使受影响图像的肺注意力增加1.52倍(0.0001美元)。 该发现在NIH ChestX-ray14(79%),DeiT-Base(88%)和ViT-Large 16(80%)之间复制,将虚伪的注解取出头作为ViT-家族架构的一致属性,跨越了两个数据集和三个架构. 全面微调并不能抑制行为,并可能使其根深蒂固:98.4%的虚假图像仍然虚假,而虚假率稍有上升,因为快捷方式得到了加强而不是去除。 关键是,单头通航产生0.340美元,所有三个识别载体的多头通航产生0.532美元,即因果核实的注读回路对输出级评价来说是完全看不见的。 机械审计发现行为测试是无法做到的。

articles.title: ContextLift: Breaking the Spurious Correlation Behind Conditional Emergent Misalignment
articles.content: Finetuning a language model on narrowly misaligned data can make it broadly misaligned. Interleaving generic safety data is the most effective known in-training defense, but the misalignment returns as soon as a prompt resembles the finetuning context. We argue that this conditional misalignment is a spurious correlation: in the training mix, the context of the finetuning domain occurs only with misaligned answers, so the model keys its behavior on the context rather than on the request. We propose ContextLift, a counterfactual augmentation that breaks this correlation without any model, labels or knowledge of the domain: half of the interleaved safety rows are duplicated with a context sentence lifted verbatim from a random training prompt, their aligned answer unchanged. On Qwen2.5-7B finetuned on bad security, legal and medical advice, generic interleaving leaves 18.9%, 41.9% and 58.2% misaligned answers under a domain cue; ContextLift reduces this to 2.6%, 6.1% and 12.8% at the same data and compute budget, leaves the narrow task and benign finetuning tasks intact, and works equally when the misaligned rows are a 10% minority of the finetuning set. Code: https://github.com/davidkaczer/contextlift
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 上下文:打破条件性紧急错位背后的纯洁关联
articles.content_zh: 微调一个语言模型在狭义的错位数据上可以使其大致错位. 互通通用安全数据是训练中已知的最有效防御,但一旦一个提示类似于微调上下文,错位就会返回. 我们辩称,这种有条件的错配是一种虚假的关联:在训练组合中,微调域的上下文只发生错配的答案,所以模型将它的行为按上下文而不是按请求. 我们提出ContextLift,一种在没有任何模型,标签或对域识的情况下打破这种关联的反事实增强:一半相隔的安全行被重复,上下文句子从随机训练的提示中逐字取消,其一致的答案不变. 在Wen2.5-7B对不良安全性、法律和医疗建议进行微调时,一般的互调在域标下给出了18.9%、41.9%和58.2%的错调答案; 在同一项数据和计算预算时,ContextLift将差调降至2.6%、6.1%和12.8%,使狭义任务和良性微调任务完好无损,当错调行占微调组的10%的少数时,同样工作。 代码:https://github.com/davidkaczer/contextlift 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.

articles.title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
articles.content: Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, this endpoint policy shift cannot reveal whether local action preferences evolved consistently during teacher training. The same endpoint shift can result from early and late shifts that reinforce or partially cancel each other. We investigate whether agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts can guide selective transfer. We introduce Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation (Waypoint-OPD), which uses an intermediate teacher checkpoint from the same RL run to compare early and late shifts in relative action preferences at student-visited prefixes. We gate the endpoint shift according to the directional agreement between the early and late shifts, suppressing it when they point in opposing directions. Compared with endpoint-only transfer, our method requires only one additional frozen-teacher scoring pass. Using RL-trained Qwen3-4B teachers, we evaluate our method with Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B as student models in mathematical and code reasoning. In all six domain--student settings, Waypoint-OPD achieves the highest domain-average score among the compared distillation methods. Ablations with the Qwen3-8B student show that removing or shuffling gates reduces mathematical reasoning performance. These results support the use of directional agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts to weight the endpoint shift during student training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Waypoint-OPD:通过 Gated On-Policy Dispiration 传输 RL-引出的政策转移
articles.content_zh: 政策相变蒸馏再利用教师在强化学习(RL)前后的日志概率差异,作为学生所生成的轨迹的监督. 然而,这一终点政策转变不能表明地方行动偏好在教师培训期间是否持续演变。 早期和后期转移可以导致同一终点转移,从而相互加强或部分地取消。 我们调查早期和后期教师政策转变之间的协议能否指导选择性转移。 我们引入了Waypoint-Guide-On-Political Dispiration(Waypoint-OPD),它使用同一RL运行的中间教师检查点来比较学生访问前缀相对动作偏好中的早期和后期转变. 我们根据早班和后班之间的方向协议来锁定终点转移,当它们指向相反的方向时加以压制. 与端点的转会相比,我们的方法只需要再加一个被冻结的教师分数的合格证. 使用受RL训练的Qune3-4B教师,我们用Qune3-8B,Qune3-14B,和Qune3-30B-A3B作为数学和代码推理的学生模型来评价我们的方法. 在所有六个域-学生设置中,Waypoint-OPD在比较分馏方法中实现了最高域-平均分. 与Qwen3-8B学生的校对显示,去除或去除门会降低数学推理性能. 这些结果支持采用早期和后期教师政策转变之间的方向性协议,以权衡学生培训期间的终点变化。
